entries.scope: For every unrestricted relative-linear unit-pivot correction C in SL2(K[x,y]), the actual descended potential is f(x,y)+2*(gamma*C) dot (r,s), with Hessian determinant16*J(gamma*C)^2. Its local Jacobian is -2 at zero, so nonzero constant Hessian is equivalent to J(gamma*C)=-2 and gives determinant64. The cotangent gradient is polynomially invertible exactly when G=gamma*C is; any collision of G lifts by solving the two invertible dual linear systems. By HC4MYOR1, the unrestricted counterexample problem in this class is exactly the oriented singleton-zero plane Keller problem: (G1,G2)=(x,y), J(G)=-2, but G not an automorphism. This is a restricted plane gate, not an asserted equivalence with all JC2. Writing D=C0^(-1)*C gives G=(y,2*x)*D; degree(D)<=99 implies degree(G)<=100 and hence invertibility by Moh. This normalized region includes every old degree(C)<=89 case and strictly extends it, with explicit degree109 C and degree99 D. It does not improve a plane degree frontier. For any Keller G in this orbit, its finite normal target cover is flat of rank d because it is a normal surface finite over a smooth surface. At zero the source occupies one reduced point, so omitted finite-fibre scheme length is exactly d-1. G is an automorphism exactly when it is proper over a neighborhood of zero; otherwise zero must be nonproper with that missing length. Local ideal equality alone supplies no completeness theorem. As a control, the known F1 three-variable map has literal zero-fibre ideal (x,y,z), while its finite marked-root cubic normalization has lengths1+2 at zero; two exact sheets escape in the fibre family over (-t^2,0,0). Both reconstruction charts and literal ideal certificates are replayed; this is not a plane counterexample. entries.title: Pointed Keller pencil, complete radial divisor budget and Euler deficit identity

entries.scope: For a complex plane Keller map G with ideal(G1,G2)=(x,y) and generic degree d, blowing up source and target at zero gives an etale lift and a smooth line pencil with an exceptional section. A projective completion and Stein factorization with that section prove geometric irreducibility of the generic pencil member, but not rationality or irreducibility of every special member. On the finite normalization of the target blowup, the actual source exceptional divisor has radial ramification e0=1 and degree f0=1 over the target exceptional P1. Every other divisor above that P1 is omitted from the source blowup, and the complete DVR degree identity gives sum_i(e_i*f_i)=d-1. Terms with e_i=1 cannot be silently omitted. For a general line through zero the corresponding omitted zero points have these multiplicities and counts. If the nonproper curve components S_j have degrees m_j, multiplicities mu_j at zero and generic source-fibre deficits delta_j, then sum_j delta_j*(m_j-mu_j)=2*g+r-1 for the general pencil curve of genus g with r punctures. This follows by stratified Euler additivity using the singleton zero deficit d-1; r>=1+sum_i f_i if d>1, so the nonzero-radial deficit budget must be positive. These are necessary complete-boundary gates, not a construction or universal exclusion. The known F1 source-A3 control has a fully parametrized slice over (t,t,t): completed curve P1, degree3, seven punctures, zero deficit2 and three distinct nonzero critical values each with deficit2, giving chi=-5 and nonzero budget6. That exact calibration uses F1's retained full simple-projective-root model; it is not a plane example and does not apply the surface radial-divisor proof to a threefold. Nguyen Van Chau's published pencil theorem is recorded with its all-member rationality and irreducibility hypotheses intact. The geometric steps are written proofs with explicit imports, not outputs of the finite symbolic checker. The unrestricted singleton-zero Keller gate, mixed/coisotropic HC4 problem and JC2 remain open. No Tang input, new plane degree bound, formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Fixed zero ideal and full Jacobian polynomial with arbitrarily large pencil genus in the oriented row orbit
dependencies: external: Riemann-Hurwitz formula for a smooth double cover of P1
entries.scope: For every integer g>=0, the explicit row H_g=(y+x*y^2+x^(2*g+1),2*x) equals (y,2*x)*D_g for the elementary determinant-one matrix D_g=[[1,0],[(y^2+x^(2*g))/2,1]]. Hence H_g=gamma*C0*D_g lies in the complete retained relative-linear orbit. Literal membership certificates give ideal(H_g)=(x,y), and every row has the same entire Jacobian polynomial -2*(1+2*x*y), with orientation -2 at zero. Its generic pencil H_g1+t*H_g2=0 is birational to W^2=1-4*x^(2*g+2)-8*t*x^2 via W=2*x*y+1. The branch polynomial has degree2*g+2 and is squarefree generically because its t=0 specialization is squarefree in characteristic zero. Riemann-Hurwitz therefore gives genus exactly g, and the inverse y=(W-1)/(2*x) identifies precisely three punctures. Thus first Betti number is 2*g+2. Arbitrary genus is the written parameter argument, not an inference from the checker representatives g=0..8. The retained gamma pencil separately has squarefree branch polynomial v*P(v)*Q(v) of degree8 and genus3, whereas gamma*C0 has linear genus-zero pencil. Neither gamma nor any H_g is Keller: their Jacobian polynomials are nonconstant. These controls prove that oriented ideal equality, determinant-one row operations and even a fixed full nonconstant Jacobian cannot supply pencil rationality. They do not disprove a rationality consequence using the full Keller condition, produce a plane counterexample or exclude the unrestricted relative-linear class. No formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Pointwise radial intersection and canonical gates; all-length sole-degree-one chain exclusion

entries.scope: For a singleton-zero plane Keller map of generic degree d, let N be its finite normal target cover and resolve each omitted point q so that the actual radial ideal (G1,G2) is invertible. Include every exceptional curve, with negative definite intersection matrix Q, positive radial multiplicities e, and direction degrees f, setting f_i=0 on radial vertical curves. Restriction of the pullback exceptional line bundle gives Q*e=-f. Splitting the completed finite-flat algebra pointwise and applying the DVR degree formula proves the omitted local fibre length ell_q=e^T*f=f^T*(-Q)^(-1)*f=-e^T*Q*e; their sum is d-1. For actual source-volume-form canonical orders k_i, horizontals satisfy k_i=2*e_i-1 and verticals satisfy k_i>=2*e_i. Compare these with a canonical vector from the complete source boundary, not an isolated block missing its attachments. Compute that A2 boundary vector before blowing up the actual source origin; its subsequent disjoint exceptional curve has coefficient1 and leaves the omitted blocks unchanged, but the combined boundary is not the connected A2 boundary of A2B1. For any resolved chain with weights -b_i and b_i>=2, define prefix determinants K0=1,K1=b1,Kj=bj*K(j-1)-K(j-2), Delta=Ks. Its cyclic lattice cokernel gives the exact integrality criterion sum_j K(j-1)*f_j=0 modulo Delta. A sole horizontal on C_j must have degree divisible by Delta/gcd(Delta,K(j-1)), which is at least2. Thus every chain length with exactly one degree-one radial horizontal and all self-intersections at most -2 is excluded. More generally one exceptional curve with radial degree1 must have e=1, self-intersection -1 and local fibre length1, hence an unramified completed normalization factor. These are all-length written geometric and lattice proofs supported by finite representative checks; they do not assume that a minimal surface resolution already resolves the radial ideal. No classification of all omitted blocks, new plane degree frontier, formal verification, external review, Tang import or novelty priority is claimed. The unrestricted singleton-zero Keller gate and JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Tame-node radial principalization in every degree and the odd-degree extra-blowup control
entries.scope: For every n>=2, reuse the retained PF2K1TN1 finite normal cover N_n={u*v=w^n}->A2_(u,v), free of rank n, and its minimal (-2) chain with charts u=a^(i+1)*b^i, v=a^(n-i-1)*b^(n-i), w=a*b. The new calculation resolves the radial ideal (u,v) and computes its complete labels. For even n=2m it is already principal on the minimal resolution: e_j=min(j,n-j), only the middle component is horizontal, its direction degree is2 by residue map v/u=b^2, and e^T*f=n. For odd n=2m+1 the middle chart has ideal a^m*b^m*(a,b), so one more blowup is necessary. The new exceptional curve has e=n, f=1 and self-intersection -1; its adjacent components become -3, every original component is vertical, and the full graph satisfies Q*e=-f and e^T*f=n. All chart determinants and canonical-order tests are explicit: the old components have target-volume order n-1 and the new horizontal order 2*n-1. The n=2 case has e=1,f=2 and shows why weakly unramified radial divisors must be counted. The n=3 resolved chain is (-3,-1,-3), with e=(1,3,1), f=(0,1,0); applying the all-b>=2 exclusion before principalizing its radial ideal would be invalid. Universal parity proofs are written; n=2..12 are symbolic regressions, not degree-bound evidence. The family realizes every local fibre length n>=2 as a normal local cover and calibrates the scope of HC4MYRB1. These singular surface germs are not affine-plane Keller maps and are not asserted to embed in a global omitted boundary. The normal covers and minimal toric resolutions retain their PF2K1TN1 attribution. No new global counterexample, formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Global plane boundary attachment excludes collided tame nodes and forces immersed images for unramified omitted primes

entries.scope: For the finite normalization N of a complex plane Keller map, import Borisov's published Stein-boundary structure, with author-manuscript numbering and source version pinned. The affine omitted boundary primes are disjoint, have unibranch A1 normalizations, and are smooth wherever N is regular. These are explicit external geometric inputs, not consequences of the finite checker. If an omitted prime has generic normal ramification index1, boundary disjointness and purity make the finite map etale along the whole prime. It is smooth and maps immersively into A2. Its finite normalization map over its polynomially parametrized target image is an unramified polynomial map A1->A1, hence has residue degree1. It cannot have an image whose normalization has a finite nonimmersion. At most one analytic ramification branch can occur at each finite normalization point. Therefore the collided normal finite map {u*v=w^n}->(u,v), n>=2, cannot occur: both analytic ramification branches must be omitted, but neither two intersecting boundary primes nor a two-branch germ on one prime is allowed. This globally excludes the attachment of every HC4MYRB2 node-projection control, including the odd-degree extra -1 radial curve, while retaining its local validity. The assertion concerns the finite map germ, not all A_(n-1) surface singularities under other projections. Borisov's Theorem3.1 guarantees some ramified dicritical; it does not prove every omitted prime is ramified. Publisher metadata is online2014, journal issue2015. The global boundary theorem is imported rather than independently reproved; no formal verification, external review of these consequences, novelty priority, JC2 or unrestricted pointed-Keller closure is claimed.

entries.title: Normal-r7 nonimmersion rows force two or three unramified omitted primes with additional immersed target images
dependencies: external: finite-cover Euler characteristic multiplicativity and stratified additivity
external: local transposition monodromy for A1,A2,A5 singularities
entries.scope: Assume a plane Keller map has geometric degree6 and its entire reduced finite-normalization ramification divisor is one prime R of generic (e,f)=(2,1), whose image is one of PF2R7CUSP1's two nonimmersed polynomial curves: A2+A5+8A1 or A2+11A1. This is an explicit ramified-row hypothesis, not an assumption that the missing boundary has only one prime. By PF2BATT1 the distinct normalization parameters of every two-branch target singularity remain distinct on R in N. Their local ramified orbits are disjoint two-sheet orbits; the old purely local S3 A5 excess option is globally forbidden. At the single ordinary cusp the transposition braid relation allows a two-sheet or three-sheet ramified orbit; write epsilon=0 or1 accordingly. If s=9 or11 is the number of two-branch singular values, normalization gives chi(C)=1-s and chi(C_smooth)=-2*s. The complete finite-cover Euler ledger is chi(N)=6*s+5*(-2*s)+4*s+(5-epsilon)=5-epsilon. Every omitted prime has Euler characteristic1 and the primes are disjoint. Since the actual source has chi1, there must be exactly t=3-epsilon additional boundary primes, hence two or three. All have generic e1; PF2BATT1 forces residue degree1 and an immersive image, so none can map onto the classified cusp curve. At least one additional nonproper target image is necessary; the two or three primes are not asserted to have distinct images from each other. Thus a complete nonproper locus consisting solely of either classified curve is excluded even if arbitrary unramified missing rows over it were allowed. entries.scope: For the extension in FINSOL1 and any nonzero finite torsion-free A-module M, a nonzero A-linear R-to-M map exists if and only if R is finite over A. If R is not finite, every finite-order k-linear differential operator relative to the A-module structures R-to-M vanishes, for any subfield k of A. The proof embeds M in a finite free module and inducts on commutators. Ordinary source differential operators into Frac(R) with image in A are consequently excluded too; their converse is not asserted. No characteristic restriction, no construction of a functional and no closure of JC2 or HC4. Written universal proof and finite controls, with no formal or external verification or novelty priority claim.

entries.title: Every proper birational extension of a normal Noetherian base has zero finite-target dual and finite-order differential maps
entries.scope: If B is Noetherian normal and B is properly contained in a domain R inside Frac(B), R is nonfinite over B. Every B-linear R-to-M map and every finite-order differential operator relative to B into any finite torsion-free B-module M vanishes. This applies to the actual marked Wright inclusion B=C[Y,XY,X^2Y,X^3Y+X] in C[X,Y], in all degrees, using its proved normality and omitted-prime chart. In particular no nonzero ordinary finite-order source differential operator, including rational coefficients, sends all source polynomials into B. The pole proof also excludes every fixed nonzero scalar multiplier. Torsion targets and nonlocal or unbounded-order maps are excluded from the theorem's scope. This restricts regularization constructions, not Keller-pair existence or finite-map realization; no JC2 or HC4 closure, formal verification, independent whole-proof replay, external review or novelty priority claim.

entries.title: All-degree no-plane obstruction for dual substitutions with matching traces on two divisors
entries.scope: For the scaled Meng--Yang family over any characteristic-zero field with L*N nonzero, let (p0(P,Q),q0(P,Q)) have nonzero constant plane Jacobian. For every polynomial E,H,R in x,y,P,Q, substituting p=p0+x*(1+xy)*E, q=q0+x*(1+xy)*H, r=R yields a potential with no jointly affine constant vector two-plane. The full base-dependent dual substitution need not be Keller or invertible. The x=0 slice confines any x-invisible affine direction to a pure-dual line; the invertible Jacobian of the trace pair forces adapted traces p0=a*T+d0 and q0=k*S+h(T). A hypothetical plane transports f_S=N*k*y to N*k*(y-eta*x), while the second divisor 1+xy=0 and polynomial S-degree force f_S=2*N*k/x. The impossible identity eta*x^2+3=0 excludes the entire plane. This covers arbitrary-length alternating dual shears congruent to the identity modulo x*(1+xy), composed on either side with any base-independent Keller substitution. More generally, with only the first trace fixed, a hypothetical plane requires the second q trace to be -L*x*Vstar^2/(2*N)-k*(1+eta*x^2)*S/2+Hstar(x,T), where Vstar=-x^3*R(x,-1/x,T,S)+(M-5*N/x^2)/(2*L). This is a necessary boundary gate, not sufficiency for a plane. Universal identities, nontriangular word controls, a non-Keller interior control, and an x-only shear outside the sufficient class are exactly replayed. Direction exhaustion, degree and arbitrary-length arguments are written proofs. No Tang input, degree bound, JC2 assumption, formal verification or external review is used for this elementary result.

entries.title: All-degree gradient invertibility for the matching-two-divisor graph class
entries.scope: Every polynomial potential in HC4MYGD1 with nonzero constant Hessian determinant has a polynomially invertible gradient, by its elementary no-plane theorem and the reproduced external Tang structural alternative HCTANG2. Polynomial invertibility descends from C to any characteristic-zero coefficient field using the unique formal inverse. This closes the arbitrary-degree collision route for p=p0+x*(1+xy)*E, q=q0+x*(1+xy)*H, r=R, including arbitrarily long base-dependent alternating shears that preserve both trace divisors. It does not require an inverse for the trace Keller map or a Keller hypothesis on the full dual substitution. Retaining the particular v2 ambient collision still requires point containment and equality of the pulled-back p covectors; vanishing on the two proof divisors does not automatically preserve the marked points or their jets. Unrestricted base-dependent words with different second traces, nonlinear base changes, other graph charts, rational/mixed pivots and general coisotropic reductions remain outside this sufficient exclusion. Unmarked unit-Hessian existence, general HC4 and JC2 remain unresolved. No formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Complete seven-term degree-seven Keller collision exclusion
entries.scope: Over every characteristic-zero field, every three-variable Keller map in the collision frame F(0)=F(e_1)=0 and JF(0)=I, with raw coordinate degrees at most seven, has at least eight nonlinear monomial occurrences counted with coordinate multiplicity. The unimodular-axis necessity reduces all candidates to 90 minimal-axis-exponent shards. Complete determinant-bucket closure leaves 1876 seven-term support orbits and 450 six-term regression orbits. Every exact-support coefficient-torus ideal is (1) over Q in both Singular and SymPy. A separate standard-library implementation reconstructs the entire support cover using an unsharded traversal and an independent Leibniz determinant expansion, with exact set equality; an independent derivative-level compiler verifies every coefficient ideal, including all collision equations and rho*product(c)-1. entries.title: First-slice affine-plane rigidity and the explicit triangular gradient inverse
entries.scope: Over a characteristic-zero field with L*N nonzero, let p0(P,Q),q0(P,Q) be a base-independent plane Keller pair. For any polynomial f with complete trace f(0,y,P,Q)=L*p0^2+M*p0+4*N*y^2*p0+N*y*q0, every jointly affine constant vector two-plane forces, after a constant linear source change, f=N*k*Y*S+X*U(Y,T)+V(Y,T), with nonzero constant k. Exact slice directional coefficients and the invertible polynomial trace Jacobian confine the x-invisible direction to a pure-dual line and force adapted traces p0=a*T+d0,q0=k*S+h(T). The whole plane transports its S derivative to N*k*(y-eta*x), a linear component. The Hessian determinant is (N*k)^2*U_T^2, so a nonzero constant determinant makes U=alpha*T+beta(Y), alpha a nonzero constant. The four-step polynomial gradient inverse is given explicitly and both compositions are exactly replayed for arbitrary beta,V. This implication is elementary, unbounded in degree, and uses neither Tang nor JC2. It classifies a surviving plane rather than claiming that none exists. A literal polynomial Meng--Yang substitution p=P+x*E,q=Q+x*H,r=R realizes L*P^2+M*P+4*N*y^2*P+N*y*Q+kappa*x*P, with nonzero constant Hessian determinant, a genuine fibre plane and a polynomial closed embedding, using the retained HC5T1 frames. No formal verification or external review is claimed.

entries.title: All-degree gradient invertibility for arbitrary first-trace-preserving substitutions
entries.scope: Every polynomial with the complete trace specified in HC4MYGF1 and nonzero constant Hessian determinant has a polynomially invertible gradient. A hypothetical nonautomorphic gradient would have an affine fibre plane by the reproduced external structural alternative HCTANG2; HC4MYGF1 supplies its explicit triangular inverse, giving a contradiction. This covers every scaled Meng--Yang substitution p=p0+x*E,q=q0+x*H,r=R with arbitrary polynomial E,H,R and any base-independent plane Keller pair p0,q0. Neither a Keller hypothesis on the full dual substitution nor any matching second-divisor trace is required. Arbitrary-length base-dependent alternating dual shears congruent to identity modulo x, composed on either side with a base-independent Keller map, are therefore covered. The old second-trace square equation is not an open unit-Hessian counterexample gate under this first-trace hypothesis. An actual polynomial unit-Hessian control with a fibre plane prevents strengthening this to no-plane or nonexistence. Marked ambient collisions still require matching pulled-back p covectors. Characteristic-zero descent uses a finitely generated coefficient field and the unique formal inverse. There is no degree bound or JC2 assumption. Genuinely y-dependent first traces, nonlinear base changes, other graph charts, and mixed/coisotropic reductions remain outside the theorem. General HC4 and JC2 remain unresolved; no formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Universal plane-Keller encoding at the y-dependent first-trace boundary
entries.scope: For every plane Keller pair F(P,Q),G(P,Q) over a characteristic-zero field, the retained HC5T1 polynomial completion and C0 normalizer give explicit polynomial substitutions p,q,R with A=F,B=x*F+y*G. Thus the Meng--Yang pullback is L*F^2+M*F+N*(x*F+y*G), with Hessian determinant N^4*J(F,G)^2. Its first traces p0=F,q0=G-4*y*F form a Keller pair over K[y]. A polynomial source change in the two affine fibre variables factors the gradient as (N*F,N*G) times identity, so gradient invertibility is equivalent to invertibility of the plane pair. Over C, universal gradient invertibility for arbitrary polynomial substitutions with y-dependent Keller first traces is therefore equivalent to JC2; the converse uses HCTANG2. This is a boundary reduction, not a proof of either conjecture. The encoding full dual Jacobian is J(F,G)*(pbez*C0_11+x^3/2), a nonconstant polynomial. It is not a dual automorphism, and no closed embedding is asserted for an unknown plane Keller pair. Consequently this reduction does not establish the same equivalence or close the remaining route for genuinely invertible dual reparameterizations or embedded graphs with y-dependent traces. All identities and the nonconstant Jacobian are exactly replayed; product-map equivalence is a written algebraic proof. No formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Finite quadratic Gaussian classification and sharp mixed cutoff
entries.scope: For every centered complex quadratic P=X^T A X+l^T X-tr(A) in Gaussian covariance rank N>=1, with A symmetric, the first 2N+1 zero pure moments imply A^N=0 and l^T A^j l=0 for 0<=j<N. Conversely these identities imply all positive pure moments vanish, and E(QP^m)=0 for m>floor(N/2) deg(Q). The local source audits Liu v3 Theorems 2.1 and 2.2 and gives explicit circular chains attaining this mixed bound in every rank N>=2 and every multiplier degree. The optimality of the pure threshold 2N+1 in all ranks is reported separately from Liu and is outside this registered local proof audit. Rank zero is deterministic; rank one admits only the zero moment-null quadratic. The checker verifies finite examples independently, not the universal classification or realization theorem.

entries.title: Input-sensitive quadratic Gaussian mixed cutoff
entries.scope: For a classified moment-null quadratic in covariance rank N>=1, let nu>=1 be the nilpotency index of A (nu=1 for A=0), and s=dim span{l,Al,...} (s=0 for l=0). Every multiplier Q of degree d satisfies E(QP^m)=0 for m>s*d+floor(d/2)*max(0,nu-1-2*s). The bound follows by maximizing the Wick partition degree from the polynomial tilted mean and covariance, is at most floor(N/2)d, and is not asserted optimal for each input. The proof is written; the independent rational regressions cover explicit examples only. No literature-priority claim.

entries.title: Complete ternary quadratic Gaussian moment-null normal form
entries.scope: Every complex polynomial of degree at most two in three standard real Gaussian variables with all positive pure moments zero has, in a complex orthogonal circular frame, the form P=Z*(a*Z+b*T+c), with E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1 and the other pairings zero. Conversely all such forms are moment-null and satisfy E(QP^m)=0 for m>deg(Q). The proof uses the dimension-one isotropic Krylov space and the rank-one or Jordan-(3) self-adjoint nilpotent cases; complex orthogonal invariance is invariance of the Wick functional. Equality is attained by P=Z,Q=W^d at m=d. This closes the quadratic layer only and does not exclude dense cubic failures or settle ordinary-Laplacian lifting.

entries.title: Long compact connected group Mathieu classification audit
entries.scope: Long arXiv:2609.16178v1 proves that the kernel of normalized Haar integration on representative functions of a compact connected Lie group is Mathieu--Zhao if and only if the group is a torus. The local audit reviews the homogeneous phase-balanced Hopf pair, invariant radial-measure transfer, fundamental-weight root doublet projection, descent through every central form, and pullback from an adjoint simple quotient. entries.title: All sixteen marked noncontact candidates lift through the full next-normal equation, with a finite remaining source-Jacobian gate
entries.scope: For every one of the sixteen noncontact pole(6,9) common-nonic candidates, actual global sections in the fixed Wright inclusion with leading symbolsH^2,H^3 satisfy Jac_uv(P,Q)=u+O(u^2), with a nonempty open clean singleton ordinary cusp and birational boundary locus. This simultaneously solves the three high and eleven lower consistency conditions of PF2RULED23 as a lifting problem; no marked candidate is removed. On the complete PF2RULED22 affine31+85 first-cusp-jet family, the u coefficient J1 has degree<=48 by PF2RULED23 and is linear in Q for fixed P. In both irreducible degree-eight candidate fields a specified P makes ker(L|V8)->K[v]_(<=48),U->J1(P,U) surjective of rank49. Exact inverse-matrix circuits construct Q with J1=1. Their characteristic-zero validity is proved by a written local-ring unit argument: at prime1009,y=990, all input denominators and cusp/output pivot determinants are units; the49-by49 output minor residues are796 and285. These circuits define finite global sections overK, and irreducibility transports them to all eight complex embeddings of each sector. This is exact modular nonvanishing plus algebraic lifting, not a bounded-search theorem or a numerical embedding test. The selected singleton-cusp resultant residues38 and240 prove nonzero characteristic-zero resultants. The full equation2h(P2q-pQ2)+lambda^2(pq_prime-p_primeq)=1 forces gcd(p,q)=1 and nonzero ordinary cusp wedge, with singletonness open. Over a nonempty open P-space the normalized Q fiber has dimension36; allowing nonzero kappa gives a pair chart of dimension68 and data throughu^2 of dimension32, with36 invisible directions. Rank-drop strata are retained and not classified. The following coefficient J2=3(P3Q0_prime-P0_primeQ3)+2(P2Q1_prime-P1_primeQ2)+P1Q2_prime-P2_primeQ1 remains unsolved; the circuit witnesses have a nonzero J2 already modulo1009 and hence are not Keller pairs. Exact rational complete-Cox kernels invisible throughu^2 have third-coefficient images span{(v^2-1)^2,v(v^2-1),v^3(v^2-1)} forV5 and all polynomials of degree<=17 forV8, with ranks3/18 and further hidden dimensions0/15. Their J2 correction3h(Aq-pB) has rank21 by gcd(p,q)=1 and degp22>degA5, and degree<=40. The intrinsic source Jacobian D=-Jac_uv/u is regular on N by the first cusp equation. The H^2,H^3 leading cancellation and the pole-three source volume give D inV12. After J1=1, D+1 vanishes onE, so its first normal coefficient and hence J2 have degree<=43. An exact complete247-section V12 restriction kernel has dimension198 and first-jet image all polynomials of degree<=43. Thus the complete following-normal test has at most3 immutable coefficients41..43, the cusp valueJ2(s), and19 lower membership conditions in degrees<=39: at most23 conditions, not asserted independent or solved. Furthermore12B-9E=3C0-3f has no sections; the complete first-nine-jet matrix ofV12 has rank247. Hence J1=kappa!=0 together with J2 throughJ9 equal zero is equivalent to the full source Keller identity in this family. The eight further coefficient equations are unsolved; the finite criterion supplies no existence or exclusion and does not remove the separate degree/finiteness obligations. All later coefficients,15 remaining hidden directions, contact cases, other height-nine pairs, higher heights, all-height pole-four coordinates, field degree4, surface finiteness and actual compatible embedding remain open. entries.title: Mathieu property for all compact Lie groups via component trace separation
entries.scope: For any compact Lie group G, connected or disconnected, the kernel of normalized Haar integration on its complex representative-function algebra is Mathieu--Zhao if and only if the identity component G^0 is abelian, equivalently a torus including the trivial torus. Restriction to the finitely many components identifies the algebra and functional with a product of representative-function algebras and their equal Haar average; zero extension is finite-type by the explicit finite-index induced-representation construction. For toral identity component GVC2FTS forces componentwise pure moment vanishing, and Duistermaat--van der Kallen gives a common eventual mixed cutoff over the finite component set. For nonabelian identity component, zero extension of Longs connected witness retains its nonzero mixed moments up to the component-index factor. This internally written deduction closes the virtually toral remainder described in Liu 21689760 v2.2s public record. It makes no priority claim, does not use that papers unaudited proof and does not cover non-Lie compact groups or minimal witness degree. Independent finite checks cover the opposite-component support example and the retained digit-separation regression, not all Lie theory.
dependencies: external: Duistermaat--van der Kallen constant-term theorem

entries.title: Affine Keller inertia fixes a sheet and point stabilizers normally generate
entries.scope: For a polynomial Keller self-map of affine space over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, every affine target prime divisor has a source divisor dominating it with ramification index one. Geometric divisorial inertia in the generic Galois closure fixes a sheet. These inertia groups normally generate the geometric monodromy G by purity and simple connectedness of affine space; consequently the point stabilizer H normally generates G. Equivalently, the generic source field contains no nontrivial intermediate field Galois over the target field. Pullback of divisor groups is a primitive injection, giving an independent Kummer power-injectivity lemma. Written universal proof with finite controls only, not formal verification or independent whole-proof review.

external: SGA 1 Expose XII, Riemann existence comparison and characteristic-zero simple connectedness of affine space

entries.title: All nilpotent and even dihedral monodromy actions are excluded absolutely
entries.scope: KMFI1 excludes every nontrivial regular action and every faithful transitive action of a nontrivial finite nilpotent group. In the natural degree-n action of D_n of order 2n, the normal closure of a reflection stabilizer is <s,r^2>, equal to D_n for odd n and of index two for even n. Hence every even-degree natural dihedral action is excluded in every affine dimension, without restrictions on completion architecture; core-free dihedral stabilizers are trivial or reflections, so even D_n has no faithful transitive absolute realization at all. Both nilpotent and even-dihedral exclusions also have an independent elementary Kummer proof. For affine actions V semidirect A with V abelian, the normal-closure test is V/[V,A]=0. Odd natural dihedral actions pass this necessary test without being constructed; D3=S3 already has symmetric-family realizations. No sufficient action-spectrum criterion is proved.

entries.title: Natural PSL2(11) affine-inertia sieve and the unique genus-zero passport
entries.scope: For PSL2(F_11) on twelve projective points, nontrivial affine-divisor inertia can have only orders 5 and 11; orders 2,3,6 are derangements. A genus-zero degree-twelve cover with this group and fixed-sheet inertia at every finite branch value must have passport 5^2 1^2 | 5^2 1^2 | 2^6, with the order-two branch at infinity. The Riemann--Hurwitz equation 8a+10b+ind(infinity)=22 has the unique solution (a,b,ind)=(2,0,6). An explicit determinant-one matrix triple of orders (5,5,2) generates all 660 projective elements and realizes the passport over C by Riemann existence. This does not classify dessins or imply the genus-zero hypothesis for inverse curves of arbitrary Keller maps. The modular (2,3,11) input cannot put both derangement branch values at infinity. No absolute PSL2(11) map or action-level exclusion is proved.
dependencies: external: Riemann--Hurwitz formula and Riemann existence theorem

entries.title: Van Hoeij--Vidunas F11 rational Keller chart with exact arithmetic and boundary ledger
entries.scope: Over K=Q(zeta_10), the published F11 rational formula has geometric natural PSL2(11) monodromy. Replacing phi by beta=phi/(phi-1) gives finite (5,5) inertia and order-two inertia at infinity. Exact arithmetic in Q[a]/Phi_10 verifies N-D=kR^2, beta'=lambda B^4 C^4/(k^2 R^3), all branch multiplicities and pairwise boundary coprimality; both published dessins are explicitly conjugated to the natural matrix action. Formula-to-dessin identification remains attributed to van Hoeij--Vidunas. Disc_x(N-tQ)=c*t^8*(1-t)^8 with c nonsquare in K; using Aut(PSL2(11))=PGL2(11), arithmetic monodromy over K is PGL2(11), and over K(sqrt(c)) both groups are PSL2(11). The coefficient-field source unit rank is six, geometric rank thirteen, target rank two, and both the target rank-two image and its rank-three extension by the derivative are primitive. Derivative suspension is a determinant-one finite etale chart, not a polynomial self-map of affine space. The moduli-field conic has a real obstruction; the rational input is over the stated extension. No absolute realization or full action classification follows.

entries.title: Complete eight-term degree-seven Keller collision exclusion
entries.scope: Over every characteristic-zero field, every three-variable Keller map in the collision frame F(0)=F(e_1)=0 and JF(0)=I, with raw coordinate degrees at most seven, has at least nine nonlinear monomial occurrences counted with coordinate multiplicity. Complete closure of all 90 minimal-axis-exponent shards leaves 20857 oriented size-eight supports, or 17482 residual-swap orbits. All 17482 size-eight coefficient-torus ideals and 2326 smaller regression ideals are (1) over Q in both Singular and SymPy. A separate global traversal with independently compiled monomials and Leibniz determinant contributions exactly reproduces all 23183 oriented supports through size eight after 1947529 visits. An independent derivative-level compiler verifies every full determinant, collision and exact-support saturation ideal; both rational backends are rerun. The coefficient proof uses no plane theorem. A separate structural classification finds 17435 size-eight univariate-coordinate orbits, 46 elementary-shear-coordinate orbits excluded by the degree-controlled plane reduction, and one hyperplane-normal-factor obstruction F2=y*(1+d*x). Thus eight-term attainment in the normalized raw-degree-at-most-seven range is impossible. GLDC4 subsequently excludes nine-term attainment using coordinate gates and Moh; global degree minima and unrestricted-degree support minima remain unknown. No entire dense profile above maximum degree two is excluded; no formal proof-assistant certificate, external review or novelty priority is claimed.
supersedes_notes: GLDC2's normalized support lower bound eight is strengthened to nine.

entries.title: Degree-ten constant Jacobian pairing exclusion and sharp dimension four
entries.scope: Let F be a three-variable Keller map over a characteristic-zero field with maximum ordinary coordinate degree D. If constant vectors v,w satisfy v^T*JF(X)*w=c nonzero identically, linear source and target changes give an affine-shear coordinate x1+H(x2,x3). A triangular source substitution makes it a parameter and bounds each plane fibre coordinate degree by D*max(1,deg H)<=D^2. Moh's established maximum-plane-component-degree-at-most-100 theorem therefore excludes every collision for D<=10, independently of support. The pairing property is affine-left-right invariant. For JF(0)=I it is exactly nonemptiness of the bilinear incidence v^T*M_alpha*w=0 for every nonconstant Jacobian coefficient matrix and v^T*w=1. A collision in raw degree at most ten must have empty incidence; emptiness is not sufficient for a collision. Univariate own-variable coordinates and nonconstant hyperplane normal derivatives are independently impossible in any degree. Among counterexamples with maximum coordinate degree at most ten admitting this pairing, the minimum dimension is four: dimensions one and two are directly injective, dimension three is excluded by the plane reduction, and the degree-seven foundational map normalized to determinant one and identity-padded has the pairing in dimension four. The checker exactly replays this four-variable collision and determinant, the nonlinear shear chain rule, and the normalized foundational map's 27-equation direction incidence as (1) in Singular and SymPy. The general reduction and dimension coverage are written proofs using Moh; that external theorem is not independently reproved. Unbounded-degree three-variable pairings, unrestricted dimension minima and cubic special-form minima remain outside this corollary. No novelty priority or external review is claimed.
dependencies: external: T.T. Moh plane degree-at-most-100 theorem, J.reine angew.Math.340(1983),140-212; primary author account https://www.math.purdue.edu/~ttm/jacobian

entries.title: Strong quantum residue transport and explicit native-support failure
entries.scope: For the retained order-five degree-five seed, strong restricted dual residues transport under every positional polynomial Weyl shear generated by H in K[X,Q]. The exact fiber-symbol automorphism exp(-ad_star(H)/hbar) carries the correction complex, affine lower lifts and full six-relation defect system; Lambda_H=Lambda composed with the inverse classical shear has the same nonzero period on the transported category. For H in K[X], the boundary valuation (1,-1,-2) is preserved, while the separate Bernstein boxes need not be. The symbolic nonlinear example H=lambda*X^3/3 checks all 614 polynomial current columns, all 945 nonconstant coefficients of the complete affine42 lower family, and35 gauge controls; its period remains -47547660815739/190658. Its 60-term transported functional pairs to -1296*lambda with the native allowed correction X^12*Q^6*Z. Thus unchanged native degree bounds do not preserve this cocycle. Adjoining the corresponding single source direction X^16*Q^6 leaves the full order-five equations inconsistent at the selected lower lift. A separate SymPy implementation verifies core scalar identities, the dual table values and six ambient shear relations, but not all producer columns or the all-degree proof. Full finite-X-Laurent strength is inherited from the retained residue proof. This is an orbit-covariant restricted result, not a cocycle for the sum of transported and native spaces, unrestricted quantization nonexistence or DC2. No formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: All-degree affine-W ternary Gaussian pure-moment classification
entries.scope: For P=W*h(Z)+v(Z)*T^2+u(Z)*T+r(Z) with arbitrary complex univariate polynomial coefficients and circular Wick pairings E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1, all positive pure moments vanish exactly in three branches. If h(0)=0, h is divisible by Z^2 and v,u,r by Z, giving strictly one-sided support and GMC safety. If h=a!=0 is constant, v=0 and r=-Z*u^2/(2a), giving a polynomial Gaussian triangular shear and GMC safety. If h=a+bZ with a*b!=0, v=(h-h^3/a^2)/(2Z), u=h^2*k and r=-(a^2/2)*Z*h*k^2 for an arbitrary polynomial k; then E(Z*P^m)=m!*a*b^(m-1) for every m>=1, so every member fails GMC. No higher-degree h with nonzero constant term is possible: its reduced logarithmic-derivative numerator has a root off h, contradicting the forced polynomial square identity. The proof uses GL1 and rational-exponential rigidity; exact finite regressions test both charts and nonconstant repaired failures, not the universal quantifiers. No global ternary classification or novelty claim.

entries.title: Complete twelve-coefficient cubic Gaussian chart and sufficient twelve-moment gate
entries.scope: In the G3AFFINEW20261114 architecture impose deg h<=2, deg v<=1, deg u<=2 and deg r<=3. All moment-null members are either the strictly one-sided zero branch or P=aW+(c+dZ)T-Z*(c+dZ)^2/(2a), a!=0. Thus this entire twelve-coefficient cubic subarchitecture satisfies GMC and contains no counterexample. Its first twelve pure moments suffice: on h(0)!=0 the rational logarithmic-derivative numerator after t=z/h(z) has degree at most eleven, and on h(0)=0 the numerator has degree at most three, so four moments already suffice there. Twelve is sufficient, not asserted optimal. The omitted monomials are W^2,W^3,W^2Z,W^2T,WT,WZT,WT^2,T^3; they are not proved removable by a change of frame. The global dense ternary cubic question remains open.

entries.title: Sharp mixed Gaussian cutoff for all polynomial triangular shears

The same invariants hold for Z_N for N>=7 by UATRACE1. For either map in its rank range, universality holds over odd F_q whenever q>D_N=N(N-1)/2+4N-13, by a nonzero power-basis determinant polynomial times the four coefficient functions. This bound is sufficient, not sharp; the older p>N,q>4N-13 bound for W_N is retained where stronger. Small-field nonmonogenicity and characteristic two remain outside the universal assertion. Exact examples include characteristic3 over F3(u) and characteristic5 rank7. Written proof and finite controls, not formal or external review or established priority.

entries.title: Canonical rational generator-line correspondences give dense fixed-algebra targets and compatible weak approximation
entries.scope: For each rank-N finite etale algebra A, N>=5 for W_N or N>=7 for Z_N, good generator lines form an open H_A in P(A) or P(ker Tr), of dimension N-1 or N-2. The scaling-invariant generator beta=(d3*d4/(d1*d5))*theta canonically identifies H_A with Isom(B_N,A) over the target chart where w,pi,top coefficient and discriminant are units. This is a finite etale degree-N! torsor under the finite etale group scheme Aut(A), which need not have N! rational automorphisms. The construction is functorial and commutes with base change over Z[1/2]; H_A is smooth surjective over the original base with rational integral geometric fibres. It gives a canonical realization correspondence, etale-local sections in general and Zariski-local sections over infinite residue fields. Over infinite fields each fixed algebra is realized on a Zariski-dense target set; over number fields compatible local realizations of that same algebra admit weak approximation via H_A. This retains choices rather than selecting one canonically. It does not produce a canonical stable-map class or effective gluing receiver; GTND1s clean all-coefficients-nonzero dimension theorem is not transported onto the trace boundary. This is a construction-specific application of established generator and twisting methods, with written proof and no formal, independent whole-proof or external review or priority claim.

entries.title: The entire pi-zero fibre has rank one or three and double depression cannot be real-split universal
entries.scope: For every normalized parameterized quadratic-gauge F_a over a field of characteristic other than two, the complete pi=0 fibre is the quadratic algebra k[S]/(S+b*S^2-c/2) localized at 1+2b*S, plus one rational point when b is nonzero. The two components follow from comaximality of t=1+xy and q. Thus its geometric rank is one for b=0 or 1+2bc=0, and three otherwise, independently of the higher coefficients. In particular no rank-N fibre for N>=5 lies at pi=0. Imposing both a_(N-1)=a_(N-2)=0 in the same compiler cannot realize R^N for N>=7: pi-zero fibres are too small, while a full-rank pi-nonzero fibre would be a squarefree degree-N polynomial with distinct real roots, zero sum and zero second elementary symmetric coefficient, contradicting e2=-sum(root^2)/2<0. This is a global obstruction to this specific next compression, not a general lower bound against every N-3-dimensional universal map. Written exact algebra and representative controls, not formal verification or external or priority review.

entries.title: Global branch-index lcm obstruction for stabilized curve Keller fields
entries.scope: Over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, let k(r)/k(t) be a degree-n rational curve cover and let e_b be the gcd of all ramification indices in branch fiber b, including unramified sheets. Finite branch valuations have orders divisible by n/e_b, all other finite orders are divisible by n, while the order at a chosen unramified infinity is 1 modulo n. Degree zero of the global divisor proves the lcm condition. Positive-genus curve sources cannot become rational by independent stabilization. The explicit degree-eight PSL2(7) curve F(v)=v^7+14v^5+63v^3+70v-7/v has passports (3^2 1^2),(3^2 1^2),(7 1), passes fixed-sheet and every KMFI8 single-fiber test, but fails this global condition. entries.title: Cycle-gcd invariant excludes all natural odd-q PSL2 curve inputs
entries.scope: For a transitive degree-n action define C(G,Omega)=lcm over g in G of the gcd of its cycle lengths. entries.title: All-degree square-axis affine-plane classification
entries.scope: Let f(x,y,P,Q) be polynomial over a characteristic-zero field with f(x,0)=L*a(x,P,Q)^2+M*a(x,P,Q)+2*N*x*r(x,P,Q), L*N nonzero, r affine in P,Q over K[x], and (a(0),r(0)) an affine coordinate pair. Rank one forces f_Q=C0(x-eta*y) with C0(0)=0,C0_prime(0)=2*N; the unit determinant makes C0 linear and the remaining coefficient triangular. Rank two has f=L*U^2+M*U+x*F(U,V)+y*G(U,V), with (F,G) Keller. Comparing the axis square forces F affine by the polynomial-square degree lemma, hence the pair and full gradient invertible. The degree lemma and rank exhaustion are written all-degree proofs, with exact identities and inverse controls, not finite degree inference. No Tang or Rentschler input is required for this conditional theorem, and r being affine on the axis is essential to this proof. No formal verification or independent external review is claimed.

entries.title: Formal sextic-phase reduction for the simultaneous WT/WZ2 cubic chart
entries.scope: For P=W*(a+bZ+dZ^2+cT)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3 and c*d!=0, Gaussian-preserving null rotation, scalar multiplication and diagonal orthogonal scaling normalize the family to W*(alpha+T+Z^2)+G with arbitrary alpha and all ten G coefficients retained. Conditional GL1 and the formal polynomial Gaussian substitution T=F_t(Y)=Y-(b/c)*t*(a+cY)-(d/c)*t^2*(a+cY)^2 give E exp(tP)=E_Y exp[t*G(t*(a+cY),F_t(Y))+(Y^2-F_t(Y)^2)/2]. The phase has Y-degree<=6, t-degree<=7 and zero constant t-section. The identity is coefficientwise via integration by parts, without analytic contour shifts. Neither the cubic-height Airy theorem nor the one-variable GMC theorem directly applies to this nonlinear-in-t sextic phase. No closure of the full chart or global cubic normal form is claimed.

entries.title: Sharp eight-moment exclusion of the complete homogeneous-G3 mixed cubic spine
entries.scope: For every complex a,A,B,C,S, P=W*(a+T+Z^2)+A*Z^3+B*Z^2*T+C*Z*T^2+S*T^3 has at least one nonzero positive pure Gaussian moment among the first eight. The proof exhausts a=0, a*(a^2+3)!=0 with S=0/S!=0, and a^2+3=0 with S=0/S!=0. On the nonzero-S open, an exact Q[w,a,R] inverse-variable cofactor identity equals one; all 303 cofactor monomials are independently multiplied with Fraction arithmetic and its generators are rebuilt from direct Wick moments. No generic-parameter promotion is used. Eight is sharp: for each root of 7a^4+72a^2-45, W*(a+T+Z^2)-(6/a)*Z^3-2Z*T^2 has moments one through seven zero and eighth nonzero. This is only the homogeneous G3 spine of the mixed chart: lower-degree G cannot be removed without proof. No GMC counterexample or full-parent exclusion is asserted.

entries.title: Exact mixed-parent reductions and coefficient controls on every parameter face
entries.scope: In the full eleven-parameter normalized parent W*(a+T+Z^2)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3, the first appearances of r0,r1,r2,r3 in moments 1..4 have coefficients 1,2a,6(a^2+1),24a(a^2+3). On a*(a^2+1)*(a^2+3)!=0 they eliminate those variables, leaving eight exact moment-5..12 equations in six variables over Q(a). The fifth reduced moment J5 is K*u2+F, with K affine in u1,v1, slopes ku=120*((a^2+1)^3-4)/(a*(a^2+1)), kv=720*(a^4+a^2+2)/(a^2+1). Explicit ru,rv satisfy ru*ku+rv*kv=1, giving a determinant-one affine control change (u1,v1)->(K,L) without additional exceptional a values. On K!=0 eliminate u2; on K=0 retain F=0 and u2. The integer moment compiler, full twelve-moment input and completed reduced equations are retained. The first-five reduction and control identities are independently reconstructed exactly. The full generic six-variable standard-basis run reached its input then terminated at the recorded 60-second limit: UNKNOWN. These reductions alone close neither K branch nor the excluded a strata, and the timeout provides no mathematical survivor or exclusion. The later separate proof G3MIXEDFULL20261114 closes the entire parent. The exceptional faces also have exact controls. At a=0, moments 1..3 eliminate r0,u1,r2 with pivots 1,2,6; H=u0+5s controls fourth-moment u2 and fifth-moment r3 with pivots 72H,360H. On H=0 further pivots are 360D,2160(D+1), D=r1+10s*v0+5v1+4; retain D=0,-1. At a^2+1=0, first-four pivots 1,2a,12a,48a eliminate r0,r1,u2,r3; fifth moment is linear in r2 with a coefficient having constant u1 slope -240. At a^2+3=0, first-three pivots 1,2a,-12 eliminate r0,r1,r2; H=u0+2s-a*v0 controls fourth u2 and fifth r3 with pivots -144H,-720H. Every boundary remains separate in this reduction. These quotient-field calculations cover both complex roots; these reductions alone exclude no exceptional full-parent face; the later G3MIXEDFULL20261114 does so by a separate argument.

entries.title: Imported Gwozdziewicz theorem: injectivity on one line for a plane Keller map
entries.scope: Over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, a polynomial plane map with nonzero constant Jacobian that is injective on one affine line is a polynomial automorphism. This is the exact imported implication of Janusz Gwozdziewicz, Injectivity on one line, arXiv:alg-geom/9305008v1, Theorem 1.1. Its Lemma 2.3 includes the case of a Keller map fixing a line pointwise after affine normalization. The primary two-page manuscript was inspected and is retained with SHA256 4cce6a7334640ea47036b1fb8c676e28da7946dbd15d0a48868b30d94c68585a. The manuscript invokes the Abhyankar--Moh theorem and Newton polygon similarity. Our checker verifies the source pin and exact application controls; it does not supply a formal or independent proof of the imported theorem. No claim is made that every singleton-zero Keller map is injective on a line.

entries.title: Critical-coordinate first-base-jet criterion for four-variable gradient invertibility
entries.scope: Let f(s,t,P,Q) be polynomial in characteristic zero. Suppose its base-origin dual trace is H(a(P,Q)), with degree H at least two and (a,b) an actual polynomial coordinate pair. Suppose a nonzero constant base direction d has origin first derivative H_prime(a)*c+lambda*b+mu(a), with lambda a nonzero field constant and c,mu polynomial. Every nonzero-constant-Hessian such f has a polynomially invertible gradient. Under hypothetical nonautomorphy Tang supplies a jointly affine constant two-plane. Rank-zero base projection contradicts the nonlinear coordinate composite. In rank one, the normal form B(T,U)+S*A(T,U)+V*C(T,U) has C(0,U)=0; unit Jacobian makes its residual plane map injective on T=0. In rank two the critical level a=xi, H_prime(xi)=0, makes a base linear combination of the residual Keller pair equal lambda*b+mu(xi). Normalize only that plane map by (a,b), obtaining injectivity on a straight line. HC4MYGL0 makes both residual pairs automorphisms, and the cotangent inverses recover the full gradient. Constant base-linear dual translations preserve the jet identity modulo H_prime(a); no nonlinear four-variable Hessian invariance is assumed. All degrees and all three projection ranks are covered by written arguments; exact algebra and inverse controls are not a formal proof of the imports. Characteristic-zero descent applies. No unrestricted HC4 or JC2 solution or independent external review is claimed.

entries.title: All polynomial base and retained-dual automorphisms closed in the q and r graph charts
entries.scope: For the scaled Meng--Yang family with L*N nonzero, both the q-graph chart with retained p,r and the r-graph chart with retained p,q have polynomially invertible gradient whenever the actual four-variable pullback Hessian determinant is a nonzero constant, after every polynomial base automorphism and every relative polynomial retained-dual automorphism. Graph degrees, coefficient degrees and fibre-preserving word lengths are unrestricted. In fact take any base-only polynomial substitution beta(s,t) with a point mapping to old (0,0) where D beta is invertible, and arbitrary polynomial dual substitutions whose retained pair at that point is an actual polynomial automorphism of the dual plane. No full base or dual inverse away from that point is needed. The exact origin jet is f0=L*p0^2+M*p0 and df0=(2*L*p0+M)*(dp0+3*q0*dx0)+N*q0*dy0+2*N*r0*dx0. For q choose a constant source direction with dx=1,dy=0 and coordinate pair (p0,r0); for r choose dx=0,dy=1 and pair (p0,q0). HC4MYGL1 applies with lambda=2*N or N. This closes the formerly remaining nonlinear q-base and q-dual reparameterizations preserving the fibration, without a straight graph-independent curve or affine residual bound. The merely-Keller specialized pair class is not substituted for the required coordinate pair. HC4MYGB2 subsequently closes both native base-eliminated charts. The nonlinear p singleton-zero properness problem, nonlinear reparameterizations of base-eliminated charts, genuine nonlinear base/dual mixing and uncovered embeddings remain open. Actual Hessian and marked-covector matching hypotheses are retained. Tang and Gwozdziewicz are explicit imports; this proof uses no Rentschler theorem and does not establish general HC4 or JC2, formal verification or independent external review.

entries.title: Higher-power radicand Keller lifts realize every odd natural alternating action
entries.scope: Over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, for every d>=2 and p in {2,3}, an arbitrary-power extension of the beta-Hermite construction gives a polynomial Keller self-map of ordinary affine three-space with determinant -p and generic degree n=d*(p-1)+1. Choose a nontrivial root zeta of integral_1^t(theta^d-1)^(p-1)dtheta, delta=zeta^d-1, and a polynomial g interpolating (1+delta*L)^(1/d) modulo L^p with g(1)=zeta. Set rho=g(L)+L^p*v, Q=(rho^d-1-delta*L)/d and P=(dp/delta^p)*integral_1^rho(theta^d-1-dQ)^(p-1)dtheta. The exact polynomial lift (Q/(L^p*x^p),P/(L^p*x^p),xL), L=1+x^p*y,v=x^p*z, has full quotient Jacobian p*L^(2p-1). Rational inverses prove generic degree; distinct finite critical values give single transposition inertia for p=2 and single-three-cycle inertia for p=3, generating S_(d+1) and A_(2d+1) respectively. A discriminant square excludes parameter-field enlargement for p=3. Thus every odd natural A_n, n>=5, and every natural S_n, n>=3, occurs. Exact birational source and target changes identify these maps with independent stabilizations of tau=w*H_(p,d)(w)^d, H=sum_j binom(p-1,j)*(-1)^(p-1-j)*w^j/(dj+1). The p=d=3 A7 map is replayed over an explicit quartic field. These results do not realize PSL2(11) or classify arbitrary transitive actions.

entries.title: Level-two cyclic cones realize every even natural alternating action and complete A_n occurrence for n>=5
entries.scope: For every d>=3, the level-two cyclic-cone construction of Kistner--Shaska with a=(-3+sqrt(-3*(2d-1)))/(2*(d-2)), b=1-a and phi=a*W^2+b*W^d gives a polynomial Keller map of ordinary affine three-space with determinant -1 and degree 2d. Put L=1+xy,w=xz-1,T=L*w,W=L*w^2, Rprime=2*phiprime/W, Sprime=phiprime*R, with zero integration constants; Q=T+phi(W), P=L+R(W)*T+S(W). The exact quadratic lift equation integral_0^1 phi(W)^2/W^2 dW=0 ensures A=Q/L and B=P/L vanish at (L,w)=(1,-1), so F=(A/x,B/x,xL) is globally polynomial. Bracket cancellation gives Jac(P,Q)=L. Explicit inverse field formulas reduce the degree to the rational pencil Pi=(Y-phi)^2/W+R*(Y-phi)+S, with poles (2d-1,1) and d finite single-three-cycle inertia generators. Coprime degrees deg(S)=2d-1 and deg(phi)=d prove distinct generic critical values; transitive three-cycle generation and a discriminant square prove the full geometric group A_(2d). Exact A6 and A8 models are replayed in quadratic coefficient fields. Together with KMFI14 this realizes every natural A_n, n>=5, on ordinary A3. The cones are attributed constructions; no assertion is made for other transitive actions of the same group, A4, PSL2(11), or a full action classification.

entries.title: Actual alternating Keller field pairs outside every independently stabilized curve presentation
entries.scope: For every a>=3 the actual A_(2^a) natural-action Keller map constructed by KMFI15 has no presentation, even after further common independent stabilization and arbitrary birational source and target changes, as a curve cover k(t,u) subset k(r,u) with t in k(r). In the natural A_(2^a) action the cycle-gcd lcm is 2^(a-1): a full 2^a-cycle is odd and absent, while two 2^(a-1)-cycles attain that gcd. This contradicts the KMFI10 necessary C=n condition for every curve-induced presentation, and further independent stabilization preserves the actual map and group. The explicit degree-eight A8 map over Q(sqrt(-21)) is the first control. Thus the actual affine-space Keller spectrum strictly exceeds the independently stabilized curve spectrum, and C=n is not a necessary condition for general higher-dimensional Keller monodromy. This does not construct or exclude PSL2(11), nor determine the full action spectrum.

entries.title: 48-term normalized Keller frame and two sharp transverse minima
entries.scope: For the foundational three-variable Keller counterexample, the transverse shear S=I+14*E_32 conjugates KFRAME1's 49-term normalized map to a rational map with determinant one, JF(0)=I, F(0)=F(e_1)=0, coordinate degrees (4,6,7), and nonlinear support counts (6,19,23), total48. This improves the broader normalized raw-degree-at-most-seven support interval to [10,48] using GLDC4's lower bound. The value48 is sharp in two specified families over every characteristic-zero field: all boundary collision pairs in KFRAME1 with arbitrary lower triangular transverse completions, and every GL2 transverse basis in the y,z-plane at the fixed pair (0,-2,-16),(1,-2,8). Nonzero column scalings and a column swap reduce the latter class to a product of two unipotent shears, without singular parameter strata. Complete coefficient-curve, leading-coefficient and resultant projections give469 and824 irreducible critical parameter factors. Exact quotient-field root bases cover every specialization. Singular independently verifies all1293 minima, the irreducible projection factors, every resultant and projection factor product, complete coefficient products and coprime root bases. Standard-library rational polynomial arithmetic independently reconstructs both input families and verifies the actual48-term determinant, identity derivative and collision. The discarded v1 field-specialization implementation is explicitly invalidated and preserved; the theorem uses v2 with distinct generators, exact modulus checks and independent Singular replay. Bounded beam exploration is only discovery evidence. Arbitrary transverse x-components, joint variation of the boundary pair with both GL2 parameters, interior pairs and global support optimality remain open. The profile is still exactly (7,6,4), so this is not a strictly lower-profile witness for OP-GLDC. No ordinary-degree improvement, new counterexample mechanism, formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Unrestricted polynomial fiber homotopy and all-rank formal symplectic lifting
entries.scope: For any commutative Q-algebra B with derivation delta, on B[Z] with bracket f_Z*delta(g)-delta(f)*g_Z and canonical pair {S,T}=1, H(F)=(S_Z*integral_Z(F),T_Z*integral_Z(F)) is a polynomial right inverse of d1(u,v)={u,T}+{S,v}. Hence every compatible finite fiber quantum jet extends hbar-adically with polynomial coefficients, and an even jet admits an even extension. No spatial completion or new X poles are needed. At the retained QRT3 seed, exact order-five corrections of Z orders9 and8, with162 and135 terms, cancel the55-term defect and have Lambda_plus(d1)=-1 against defect period1; they escape QRT3's current Z bounds1 and0. Independently, for every full polynomial symplectic endomorphism of A^(2n), the commuting Hamiltonian frame identifies its unrestricted deformation complex with polynomial de Rham cohomology. H2=0 gives simultaneous all-orders formal lifts in every rank, including all six relations at rank two; H1=0 gives uniqueness up to formal Hamiltonian gauge. The Fraction replay and a separate SymPy implementation check the universal fiber calculus identity and the retained finite witness; all-orders induction and the full-frame theorem are written proofs. These statements do not construct a finite Weyl endomorphism, specialize formal series at hbar=1, prove prescribed arithmetic support, admit a missing fourth classical image, or settle DC1/DC2. QRT1-QRT3 remain valid in their restricted categories. No formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Exact affine-direction classification for both native base-graph boundary traces
entries.scope: Over a characteristic-zero field with L*N nonzero put H(z)=L*z^2+M*z. For arbitrary polynomial R0(p,q,r), the trace h_y=H(p)+4*N*p*R0^2+N*q*R0 has a nonzero constant affine direction v, meaning partial_v^2 h_y=0 identically, exactly when v(p)=v(R0)=0. In a linear coordinate along v, moving p makes either the p*R0^2 top degree or the H(p) quadratic uncancellable. Once v(p)=0, degree at least two in R0 is impossible and the degree-one coefficient factors N*k*(4*p*k+v(q)); the nonunit transverse p prevents cancellation. The other trace h_x=H(p+3*R0*q-R0^3*r)+2*N*R0*r has any nonzero affine direction only when R0 is a field constant c, and then exactly when v(p)+3*c*v(q)-c^3*v(r)=0. A positive direction degree m of R0 makes the cubic term dominate and its square have degree at least 6*m. If R0 is direction-independent but nonconstant transversely, its constant-coefficient cubic relation forces v=0. These are complete unbounded polynomial-degree arguments. No Tang, line theorem, search cutoff, formal verification or independent external review is needed for this trace lemma.

entries.title: All-degree affine-plane classification in both native base-eliminated graph charts
entries.scope: For the scaled Meng--Yang potential Psi with L*N nonzero, consider either native graph x=R(y,p,q,r) or y=R(x,p,q,r), with arbitrary polynomial R. If the actual four-variable Hessian determinant is a nonzero constant and the potential has a jointly affine constant two-plane, its gradient is polynomially invertible. The two possible projection ranks to the single free base coordinate are exhausted. In the x chart HC4MYGB0 forces R at y=0 constant and every pure-dual affine direction to annihilate the linear coordinate a=p+3*c*q-c^3*r. Rank one then has a globally constant pure-dual coefficient and singular Hessian; rank zero has a residual coefficient pair constant on the boundary line and singular there. Thus no unit-Hessian affine two-plane survives in this chart. In the y chart rank zero forces the plane ker(dp), R at x=0 to be kappa*p+delta, kappa nonzero, and its residual Keller map injective on a line; imported HC4MYGL0 makes it invertible. Rank one normalizes v(q)=1,v(r)=c and gives R(U,Z) at x=0 with coefficient C=N*R. The complete normal jet forces F=2*N*Z-21*U*(2*L*U+M)*R-89*N*U*R^3-16*N*c*U*R+alpha*(2*L*U+M+4*N*R^2)+beta*N*R. Its residual Jacobian has unique transverse top coefficient -89*N^2*m*k(U)^4 at degree 4*m-1 for every positive transverse degree m of R. Unit Jacobian therefore forces R=kappa*U+delta and the pair is triangular. Cotangent reconstruction gives polynomial gradient inverses. All source changes are constant affine; arbitrary nonlinear reparameterizations of these graphs are not covered. Plane exhaustion and all-degree arguments are written proofs with exact algebra controls, not formal verification or independent external review.

entries.title: Exact degree-three unit rows exclude the degree-eight zero-coefficient stratum and recover the root constant globally
entries.scope: For each of the two irreducible marked degree-eight fields in PF2RULED27, the actual coefficient row(D0,...,D4) of D=(M(s)-M)/h in the complete rooted degree8 affine model generates the unit ideal inK[c4,c5,c6,c7]. Explicit polynomial multipliersCi of degree<=3 satisfy sumCiDi=1 as a full characteristic-zero polynomial identity. The checker reconstructs the actual primaryDi, matches every coefficient moduloP8, multiplies all retained rational field-basis coefficients inQ[y,q] and verifies remainder0 moduloP8. It covers all eight complex embeddings of both fields, not a numerical root or modular-only inference. The entire common-zero/constant-M stratum is therefore empty before any kappa or companion conditions, closing the named unresolved PF2RULED27 stratum. IndividualDi zero values remain fully covered. Setting Zstar=sumCiEi gives polynomial recovery of the root constant on the entire necessary locus without variable denominators or coefficient-pivot charts. Exact identities sumCi(DiZ-Ei)=Z-Zstar and DiZ-Ei=Di(Z-Zstar)+(DiZstar-Ei) prove equality of the old compatibility ideal with(Z-Zstar,E5,DiZstar-Ei). The nonzero conditionMsZ!=0 is preserved by the exact saturation identity(tMsZ-1)-(tMsZstar-1)=tMs(Z-Zstar). Thus the full saved necessary presentation globally reduces to(E5,DiZstar-Ei fori0..4,tMsZstar-1) over four core parameters plus one saturation variable. The known syzygy sumCi(DiZstar-Ei)=0 is retained; independence, dimension, emptiness and solutions are not asserted. Degree bounds are degqZstar<=18 and degq(DiZstar-Ei),degq(MsZstar)<=22. All data remain exact arithmetic circuits, with no need to expand the potentially large recovered polynomial. The producer finds the degree3 row by a175-unknown Macaulay coefficient system; mod1009 only selects independent rows. Restriction of scalars on1,y,...,y7 gives a1400-by1400 rational system solved exactly by FLINT Dixon. The complete polynomial identity, including unselected coefficient rows, is verified before writing the certificates. Slow Groebner/direct number-field attempts are preserved as historical inputs and are not proof dependencies; their orphaned child was identified and terminated. The actual-global-root hypothesis and normalized nonzero boundary-leading amplitude from PF2RULED26 remain explicit. The new four-parameter nonzero-kappa core is still unsolved; actual section lifts, later source-Jacobian ordersu^3..u^9, the general PF2RULED25 determinant locus and its other rank drops without a global root, contact cases, other height-nine pairs, higher heights, all-height pole-four, field degree4, surface finiteness and actual compatible embedding remain unresolved. No source Keller pair or finite map is constructed and no whole marked candidate, pole pair or quartic packet is excluded. Exact sparse rational polynomial arithmetic and universal identities support written ideal and field-embedding proofs, without formal verification, independent whole-proof implementation, external review, new imported theorem or novelty priority. The original full goal remains active.

entries.title: Sufficient 320-moment gate for the complete mixed-W cubic architecture
entries.scope: In the fourteen-coefficient family P=W*(a+bZ+dZ^2+cT)+G(Z,T), deg G<=3, the first 320 zero positive pure Gaussian moments imply all-order pure vanishing and GMC safety. In the c*d!=0 interior at least one of those moments is nonzero. Normalize and use the period-at-infinity exclusion G3MIXEDFULL20261114. The rational phase has actual z-degree d=4,5,6 and t^2*Phi has coefficient t-degree<=3. The normalized connection matrix has common polynomial denominator H=t^3*A^(d), A=t^2*leading_coefficient(Phi_z), with numerator and denominator degree<=B=3d+3. Derivative columns N_j/H^j have deg N_j<=jB. At minimal seed rank q<=d-1, polynomial cofactors give a scalar equation with coefficient degrees<=D=B*q*(q+1)/2. Its zeroth coefficient is nonzero, since otherwise a constant period would exist. A zero prefix of D+q moments forces that nonzero coefficient to have order>D, impossible. The worst sufficient prefixes by actual phase degree are 93,184,320. The completed c=0 and d=0 faces need only 35 and 92, so 320 works for the whole architecture. entries.title: Exact trace-quadric realization criterion for degree-N Keller maps in dimension N-3
entries.scope: For every N>=7, explicit determinant-one maps D_N on A^(N-3) over Z[1/2] are obtained by deleting the penultimate two inverse-polynomial coefficients. Rank seven uses the polynomial section (a4,a5,a6,a7)=(h^3,0,0,h^5) from weights5,8; ranks N>=8 use a4=a5=w. Over an infinite field of characteristic other than two, a rank-N finite etale algebra A is a complete fibre anywhere in the affine target if and only if Tr(theta^2) on ker Tr has a zero outside its radical. A smooth isotropic point makes the trace quadric rational and supplies a primitive generator with every required coefficient nonzero. The trace radical is zero when N is invertible and the scalar line otherwise. All D_N have degree N, arithmetic and geometric monodromy S_N and absolute stable atomicity over every field of characteristic other than two. Their canonical isomorphism-torsor lift spaces are the good opens in projective trace quadrics, finite etale rank N! over the chosen finite target chart and rational exactly when realizable. Over number fields the exact realization criterion is that no real completion of A is completely split; U(k)<=4 is a sufficient fixed-field condition for all A, but is not by itself field-versality over all extensions. A general positive primitive coefficient weight vector admits a polynomial monomial section even without a coprime pair. No arbitrary-field universal N-3 bound is claimed.
dependencies: external: local isotropy of quadratic forms and Hasse--Minkowski

entries.title: Binary trace forms classify field-versality of the double-depressed Keller construction when N is invertible
entries.scope: For N>=7 and char(k) other than two, write N as distinct binary powers n_i. If constants c_i in k are nonconstant and satisfy sum(n_i*c_i)=sum(n_i*c_i^2)=0, then UADOUBLE1 realizes every rank-N finite etale algebra over every infinite extension L/k. The proof reduces an S_N torsor to binary Sylow-two blocks over an odd-degree extension, then applies Springer to the nondegenerate trace form or its quotient by scalars. When N is invertible in k, Brassil--Reichstein Theorem1.3 and Corollary8.1 make this criterion necessary as well, by their generic-extension obstruction. In characteristic zero binary digit count at most two excludes field-versality of D_N over every base; over a quadratically closed base, at least three ones is exactly the positive range. With three binary blocks the constant criterion is that -N*n1*n2*n3 be a square. In modular ranks p dividing N the nonconstant-vector test is sufficient; the r>=5 and r=4 with F_(p^2) hypotheses of Edens--Reichstein supply examples, without a smooth-locus converse being asserted. These classify this compiler, not all Keller maps. Only infinite extension fields are asserted in positive characteristic; finite-field monogenicity and size issues remain separate.
dependencies: external: Brassil--Reichstein Theorem1.3 and Corollary8.1; Springer odd-degree theorem

entries.title: Exact universal Keller target dimension four for S7 over characteristic-zero bases containing sqrt(-14)
entries.scope: For every characteristic-zero field k with -14 in k^(times2), the proposed programme invariant ktdim_k(S7) equals four. UADOUBLE1 gives D7(h,x,y,z)=(h,F_(h^3,0,0,h^5)) with determinant one and ordinary coordinate degrees (1,7,49,47). UABINARY1 applies to binary blocks4,2,1 with constants (3,-4+delta,-4-2delta), delta^2=-14, making its complete rank-seven finite-etale fibre family universal over every extension of k. The compiler-independent essential-dimension lower bound and Duncan Theorem1, ed_k(S7)=4, prove global minimality for this defined target-dimension invariant. This includes k=C and Q(sqrt(-14)). The binary criterion for this particular D7 is also necessary, so D7 is not field-versal over Q or Q(i), even though over Q(i) it realizes every rank-seven algebra over that fixed field. No rank-seven minimum over Q or R, coordinate-degree minimum, global minima in other ranks, formalization or independent external review is claimed.
dependencies: external: Duncan Essential Dimensions of A7 and S7, Theorem1

entries.title: Double-trace compiler choices retain N-6 stable-class parameters for each realizable algebra
entries.scope: In characteristic zero, the UADOUBLE1 compiler has a faithful (N-6)-dimensional family of pairwise stably inequivalent absolutely stably atomic three-dimensional slices for every N>=7. Rank seven has h in G_m and invariant a7^5/a4^8=h; higher ranks have a4=a5=w nonzero, a_(N-1)=a_(N-2)=0 and aN nonzero, with parameter space G_m^2 times A^(N-8). UASPARSE1 separates every parameter including intermediate zero strata. For any fixed algebra satisfying the exact trace-quadric criterion, its rational good-line lift space maps smoothly surjectively to this parameter space with relative dimension three, so the parameters realizing that algebra are Zariski dense. The N-6-dimensional presentation defect survives even on base fields where the rank-seven promoted universal map achieves the global minimum four. This concerns the three-dimensional compiler slices and marked realizations, not variation of the single promoted map, ambient moduli components, or a global obstruction to every different compiler. Quadratic family correspondences supply etale-local choices; residue-field quadratic points alone are not claimed to lift Zariski locally.

entries.title: Bounded formal lifting criterion and automatic Weyl nonsurjectivity
entries.scope: If a noninvertible polynomial symplectic endomorphism of affine2n-space in characteristic zero has a full formal Weyl lift with one finite spatial degree bound on all coefficient polynomials, including after a ramified parameter h=a(t), then it gives a non-surjective A_n endomorphism over C. The finite-PBW generic fiber is a Weyl algebra over K((t)); injectivity of the classical reduction makes the endomorphism preserve coefficient valuation, so a hypothetical generic inverse has no parameter poles and would reduce to a polynomial inverse. Scalar coefficient series need not terminate or specialize at h=1. At fixed degree D, the normalized full-relation scheme has a Zariski-closed automorphism locus, by constant-rank substitution and the field inverse-degree bound D^(2n-1). Artin approximation supplies algebraic coefficient approximants preserving any fixed jet once the common spatial bound is known. Membership of a noninvertible classical point in the horizontal closure of a finite-degree relation scheme is equivalent over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field to a bounded ramified lift, hence sufficient for a counterexample. Exact controls show bounded nonterminating scalar series, an unbounded spatial representative of the identity with a bounded alternative, and different arithmetic center maps for two lifts with the same classical reduction. The conditional criteria, valuation proof, finite-type geometry and all-prime shear formula are written proofs; the checker verifies the control identities and primes5,7,11 only. No spatial bound or horizontal membership is proved for Long's map or the retained seed, and no Weyl counterexample, DC2 solution, formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.
