entries.scope: For a faithful transitive finite G set Omega of rank N>1 over any field of characteristic p, a canonical marked realization by an etale map between torus torsors exists in some dimension exactly when p does not divide N and Sym(Omega) contains an abelian regular subgroup A normalized by G. A need not be contained in G. Every regular etale torus map is a finite monomial isogeny up to translations, so its generic abelian deck group supplies the necessity and every marked fibre has full generic rank. For sufficiency set B=X^*(A), with its actual cyclotomic Galois action, M=Z[B minus zero] and L=kernel(M->B). Multiplicative-type duality gives an Aut(A)-equivariant isogeny T_M->T_L with constant kernel A in dimension N-1. Hol(A) acts by source translations and linear automorphisms; restricting to G and twisting glues the full required torsor fibre effectively. Combined permutation actions make the fieldwise source torus quasi-trivial, hence its torsor trivial by Hilbert90; no canonical origin is inferred. Source and target character lattices may differ, and UATORUSSTABLE1 prevents hiding that difference by identity stabilization. This is the abelian Greither-Pareigis Hopf-Galois normalizer condition applied to torus receivers, with the published group-theoretic input credited. It is not a construction on affine spaces or an unrestricted stable-class-only receiver.
dependencies: external: Milne Algebraic Groups Theorem12.23 and induced tori, Greither-Pareigis1987 Theorem3.1, Hilbert90 and effective etale descent

entries.title: Natural symmetric torus receivers exist exactly in ranks two three and four with sharp dimensions and atomicity boundaries
entries.scope: UATORUSCLASS1 classifies natural S_N torus receivers in every characteristic: S2 exists exactly outside characteristic two with minimum dimension one; S3 exactly outside characteristic three with minimum one; S4 exactly outside characteristic two with minimum two; N>=5 is impossible in every torus dimension. All torus maps are finite, so higher-degree smaller marked fibres cannot evade the obstruction, which also survives arbitrary affine identity stabilization by full-degree generic-monodromy normality. Matching maps are squaring on Gm, cubing on the norm-one torus of k[theta]/(theta^2+theta+1), and squaring on the rank-two product-one torus with V4 translations and S3 coordinate permutations. The cubic source has actual S3 action generated by theta translation and inversion, target action through inversion, and full rational three-point identity fibre over every field of characteristic not three, including characteristic two. Twisting yields canonical cubic and quartic torsor maps with exact full input algebra fibres. Their fieldwise source torsors are trivial: they are killed by three versus quadratic norm-cohomology exponent two, or by two versus cubic norm-cohomology exponent three. No equivariant source origin exists for these actual actions, even after vector-representation identity stabilization. UAFINATOM1 gives strong absolute stable atomicity in ranks two and three. Every quartic torus cover decomposes geometrically into quadratic isogenies in every dimension. These are torus-receiver statements, not unmarked affine-space Keller dimension results.
dependencies: external: normal subgroups of symmetric groups, torus norm cohomology and Hilbert90

entries.title: Frozen resolvents separate fixed torus universality and classify atomicity of the minimal quartic family
entries.scope: Using UATORUSCLASS1 and UATORUSSYM1, a fixed etale torus cover field-versal for natural rank-N symmetric algebras over every extension exists exactly for N=2 outside characteristic two. Every fibre has generic degree, so a larger-degree boundary does not help. Every cubic fibre of one fixed torus cover has the same quadratic sign-resolvent torsor, because translations of its order-three kernel are even. For a V4 quartic kernel its three nonzero kernel elements give one fixed cubic resolvent; a cyclic quartic kernel allows only fibre groups in Hol(C4) of order eight and cannot realize a connected cubic field plus a point. Over k(t), varying quadratic extensions gives forbidden cubic discriminants and quartic cubic resolvents; separable cubic extensions supply the cyclic-kernel countercontrol in every allowed characteristic. For N>=5 even a single full natural S_N fibre is forbidden, and such algebras exist over generic extension fields. Canonical cubic and quartic torus families nevertheless exist by twisting the target torus, so fieldwise source trivialization does not imply one fixed universal map. Every constant finite abelian group instead has a fixed framed field-versal finite torus cover between possibly different torus forms from the permutation-lattice construction and Hilbert90. Constant C3 has a one-dimensional fixed universal self-map [3] on the cyclotomic norm-one torus in every characteristic other than three. UAFINATOM1 gives prime-degree atomicity there. Quartic torus covers with connected cubic resolvent have primitive arithmetic group A4 or S4 and are atomic over that field in the strong normal-affine category, while their geometric V4 group makes them non-absolutely atomic. For the constructed rank-two quartic family in characteristic zero, stable self-map atomicity holds exactly when the cubic resolvent is not fully split; strong atomicity through arbitrary normal affine intermediates holds exactly when it is a field; absolute stable atomicity never holds. The split1+quadratic case is the restriction-of-scalars stable atom of UATORUSSTABLE1, so this exact three-case table does not infer decomposability merely from imprimitive monodromy. In characteristic zero the same fixed-symmetric-universality obstruction holds for every finite etale endomorphism of T times A^r, including arbitrary finite coefficient coupling: UATORUSSTABLE1 reduces it to a torus isogeny times identity after a source automorphism. Nonfinite maps and different source geometries are outside that conclusion.
dependencies: external: quadratic sign resolvents, quartic pair-partition resolvents and norm-torus cohomology

entries.title: Pseudo-plane finite symmetry is cyclic and full cyclic-degree symmetric lifts remain obstructed after stabilization
entries.scope: In characteristic zero every finite subgroup of Aut(S_k), S_k={u+u^2v=w^k}, k>=2, is cyclic: Dubouloz-Palka equation5.12 gives u->lambda^k*u and w->lambda*w+u^2*Q(u), with a torsion-free additive multiplier-one kernel. Thus the same unstabilized surface cannot carry a complete natural marked S_N fibre for N>=3 with actual compatible source and target actions, independently of the map and generic degree. The UAACYCLICRECV1 cyclic construction cannot be extended to full symmetric symmetry on that same source. Every identity stabilization retaining the surface projection is also excluded, even with arbitrary polynomial actions in the added fibres, because the label action still factors through the cyclic surface image. The full-degree finite-chart normalizer step underlying UACANATOM1 applies to any connected normal source and target; consequently generic cyclic degree N>=4 prevents every natural full-rank S_N lift after arbitrary identity stabilization and left-right equivalence, even with projection mixing. A regular C_N group is not normal in natural S_N for N>=4. Cubic cyclic monodromy passes that necessary test, so genuinely projection-mixing cubic stabilizations and other source geometries remain open. No affine-space Galois or automatic-atomicity conclusion is imported to the enlarged receiver.
dependencies: external: Dubouloz-Palka arXiv1701.01425 equation5.12 and finite-chart monodromy fibre functors

entries.title: Explicit marked-root cyclic wreath actions on ordinary affine space
entries.scope: For every n>=3 and m=n-2, Harish marked-root polynomial map on ordinary affine n-space over Q has full constant Jacobian m/2, generic degree n*m and geometric action C_m wr S_n when m is odd, or the subgroup sum(colors)=parity(root permutation) modulo2 when m is even, of order m^n*n!/gcd(2,m). The map is given by all nonfixed coefficients of an explicit polynomial Phi(T) with linear coefficient1. Dense-open marked-root coordinates t=x/(1+xy),a=1/(1+xy) give Phi(t)=0,Phi'(t)=a^m and rational inverse reconstruction; a complete determinant-chain identity extends polynomially everywhere. Independent root coordinates make the generic splitting field rational, and exact pair valuations leave only the stated even derivative-product relation. The construction and geometric group are a source-attributed reproduction of Harish and Fonollosa arXiv2609.33491v1, not a new family claim. Finite controls replay entire expanded-coordinate Jacobians for n3..7, and exact permutation orders for n3..10; these supplement written all-n proofs. The registered witnesses use dimension n, without assuming the separate dimension3 coordinate-descent theorem. No arbitrary nonlinear specialization or full action-spectrum sufficiency is asserted.

entries.title: Exact cyclotomic constants and twisted arithmetic marked-root wreath actions
entries.scope: For the Q-defined marked-root family of KMFI69 with m=n-2, the normal-closure constant field is exactly Q(zeta_m), and arithmetic monodromy has order phi(m)*m^n*n!/gcd(2,m). Its action is (i,j)->(sigma(i),u*j+v_sigma(i)), u a unit modulo m. For odd m there is no additional constraint. For even m, sum(v)=parity(sigma)+chi_n(u) modulo2, where chi is zero for n=0 modulo4 and (u-1)/2 modulo2 for n=2 modulo4. In the latter case4 divides m. The product of marked derivative roots supplies the scalar c with c^2=(-1)^(n(n-1)/2); c=i when needed already belongs to the cyclotomic field. Thus no extra quadratic constant is introduced. Root-marking ratios force all mu_m into the constants, while the explicit arithmetic action bounds the order by geometric order times the cyclotomic degree; equality proves both the full embedded group and absence of further constants. Over any characteristic-zero field k replace the unit group by Gal(k(mu_m)/k), with constants exactly k(mu_m). The n6,m4 control rejects naive root-fixed complex conjugation; a root-transposition lift is required by the color parity. Written universal calculation with exact finite group controls, no formal or independent whole-proof review.

entries.title: Complete divisor block lattice and absolute stable atomicity of marked-root maps
entries.scope: For every marked-root Keller map in KMFI69, over algebraically closed characteristic-zero constants, all proper intermediates are E_d=K(t,a^d), d|m=n-2, with [L:E_d]=d and upper extension L/E_d cyclic. The complete proper blocks through a fixed sheet lie in its root block and have sizes exactly the divisors d of m. The sheet stabilizer fixes that entire root block and is transitive on its complement: any block meeting the complement exceeds half the total degree and is the whole action. Regular cyclic translations classify the remaining blocks, proving the unbounded complete interval. Any polynomial factorization into affine self-maps has Keller factors; a nontrivial inner factor would have one of the forbidden nontrivial Galois extensions L/E_d by KMFI1--2. Degree-one Keller factors are automorphisms, so every member is absolutely and stably atomic, although m may have arbitrarily many divisors. Independent stabilizations preserve the group and interval. This does not decide whether the lower pair E_d/K separately has a Keller model. Exact principal-block closure computations n3..10 supplement the written universal proof.

entries.title: All finite cyclic and abelian geometric generic deck groups have actual Keller witnesses
entries.scope: For every m>=1 the actual marked-root Keller map with n=m+2 has geometric generic deck group C_m, is absolutely and stably atomic, and has trivial polynomial fixed-target source deck group by KMFI47. The geometric sheet stabilizer fixes exactly the m sheets in one root block; diagonal color rotations realize all m possible commuting permutations. Over a coefficient field k the generic rational deck group is mu_m(k), and over Q it has order gcd(m,2), since cyclotomic units act on diagonal rotations. For every finite abelian group product C_(m_i), an independent product of these ordinary-affine polynomial maps has that geometric generic deck group: independent closure fields give product monodromy and stabilizer, and their normalizer quotient is the product of C_(m_i). Work over a number field containing the requisite roots of unity if the whole deck group should be defined over the coefficient field. A nontrivial product is not claimed atomic. These are deck groups and must not be confused with abelian monodromy, which remains excluded by KMFI2. The action group is still the much larger marked-root wreath subgroup. Written universal proofs and exact finite arithmetic-centralizer controls; no formal or independent whole-proof review. Explicitly a deck rotation a->zeta*a sends x->x/zeta and y->y+(1-zeta)/x; every nonidentity rotation has a genuine source pole along x=0.

entries.title: One proper relative Morse component or one global section component forces HC4 gradient invertibility
dependencies: external: Stacks Lemma 29.45.11, finite iff affine proper (01WG)
external: Milne Lectures on Etale Cohomology v2.21 p28, forward finite-etale to finite-topological-cover comparison
entries.scope: Over C let f(s,t,u,v) have nonzero constant full Hessian determinant. For Z=V(f_u,f_v) and its retained projection pi to A2_(s,t), it suffices that one nonempty irreducible component Z0 be proper over the base and that its vertical two-by-two Hessian never degenerate there: then grad f is a polynomial automorphism. No assumptions are imposed on other components. Unit full Hessian makes Z smooth of pure dimension two, so its components are disjoint and open/closed. On Z0 the tangent kernel of pi is the vertical Hessian kernel; thus the restricted map is etale, and affine proper makes it finite. Its nonempty image is open and closed in A2, hence surjective. Finite etale complex covers give finite topological covers; contractibility of C2 makes the connected cover degree one, and normality of the algebraic base gives an isomorphism. More generally one global section component suffices even without a statement about other components. Tang projection rank zero cannot contain such a component, rank two makes the whole critical scheme the retained graph section, and in rank one the section U=h(s,t) is algebraic over C(t) and hence U=h(t), giving an actual affine-line Keller-component and an inverse by HC4MYGR0. Consequently every nonempty relative-critical component of a hypothetical nonautomorphic unit-Hessian polynomial, over every constant two-plane, must either fail properness over its retained base or contain a vertically degenerate point. If the entire nonempty projection is proper and everywhere Morse, its degree must be one, so a higher-degree proper relative Morse cover forbids unit Hessian outright. Finiteness of individual fibres, generic Morse points, an empty critical scheme or unrelated properties on different components do not replace these hypotheses. No general cancellation or full Riemann-existence essential-surjectivity theorem is used.

entries.title: The everywhere-Morse relative critical subclass already encodes every plane Keller map with projection literally equal to that map
entries.scope: For every complex plane Keller map K with J=DK, the actual four-variable polynomial f_M(w,z)=w dot K(z)-K(z) dot K(z)/2 has full Hessian determinant (det J)^2 and invertible gradient if and only if K is invertible. Relative to the free z plane its equations are J^T*(w-K)=0, so its entire relative critical scheme is the graph w=K(z), isomorphic to A2_z. Its vertical Hessian there is -J^T*J, everywhere nondegenerate; the retained projection is literally K, with finite reduced fibres and etaleness but not an asserted finite morphism. Projection properness is exactly properness and hence invertibility of K; for a hypothetical nonautomorphic pair the retained omitted-normalization lengths are the relative critical fibre defects. The full critical scheme is w=0,K(z)=0 and all full critical values are zero. Universal gradient invertibility in the nonempty everywhere-relative-Morse HC4 subclass is exactly equivalent to JC2: JC2 gives HC4 by retained Tang, and this explicit family gives the converse. Neither vertical Morse geometry alone nor a common full critical value is asserted to settle JC2. These are genuine polynomial source potentials, not asserted closed A4-in-A5 embeddings compatible with the fixed quadratic. No nonautomorphic plane pair or either endpoint is constructed.

entries.title: Unimodular polynomial matrices give explicit finite free Fermat maps in every dimension, and finite relative critical projection alone is exactly JC2
entries.scope: Over any field k and any n>=1 let M be an invertible polynomial n-by-n matrix and B=M inverse. For every positive integer N strictly greater than all total degrees of entries of B, the map P(z)=M(z)*(z1^N,...,zn^N)^T is finite free of degree N^n with actual k[P]-module basis all monomials whose individual exponents are less than N. The graph ideal is generated over k[p] by zi^N-sum_j B_ij(z)*p_j. Its leading z monomials are pairwise coprime pure powers and all lower z degrees are below N, so monic overlap reductions commute and give unique global normal forms. Eliminating p identifies the quotient with k[z] and proves injectivity and the free basis without a flatness theorem or a generic-only count. The strict bound is needed uniformly: at equality B=[[1,z1^N],[0,1]] gives P=(z1^N*(1-z2^N),z2^N), contracting the line z2=1. For every complex plane Keller K take M=DK^(-T), N>=2 and N>deg DK, and D_N=-(z1^(N+1)+z2^(N+1))/(N+1). The cotangent potential f_N=D_N+w dot K has full unit Hessian and invertible gradient exactly when K does. Its entire relative critical scheme is the graph w=P(z), with finite free retained projection of degree N^2 and the explicit monomial basis. The zero fibre is Spec C[z]/(z1^N,z2^N), DP(0)=0 and its vertical Hessian is zero there, despite unit full Hessian. Universal gradient invertibility in the nonempty finite-relative-critical-projection subclass is exactly equivalent to JC2, even restricting to these finite free examples. Properness of P does not establish properness of K, and N^2 is not the generic degree of K. No compatible closed ambient graph embedding, nonautomorphic plane Keller pair, endpoint resolution or unrestricted HC4/JC2 proof is supplied.

entries.title: Complete irreducible nodal-leading ternary cubic pure exclusion by an unramified formal frame
entries.scope: Over C in characteristic zero, every ternary cubic whose homogeneous leading projective curve is irreducible nodal has a nonzero positive pure Gaussian moment, for arbitrary lower-degree terms and the full transformed nondegenerate affine Gaussian, including its means. The isotropic-node/conic and F2(node)!=0 coercive alternatives are already excluded. In the remaining nonisotropic-node chart P=T*(uv+h)+a*u^3+d*v^3+b*u^2+c*v^2+e*u+f*v+k, a*d!=0, Q_TT=m!=0 and det Hess Q!=0, the h=e=f=0 critical-line case is covered by G3NODALCENTERALL20261114. For every finite-critical member, a smooth conic coordinate s=uv+h and an exact T shear give P=s*w+R(u); each finite singularity has analytic local type alpha+s*w+y^(mu+1),1<=mu<=6. Explicit formal integration-by-parts recurrences give mu horizontal power-phase characters with exponents1+j/(mu+1),1<=j<=mu, none integer, with exp(alpha*t). The retained1/3/4/5 escaping Morse branches supply formal Gaussian functionals with nonzero exponential factors, even when quartic opposite roots share their positive actions. Their multiplicities and finite Milnor ranks exhaust the full top twisted de Rham rank7. A generic linear form separates finite points and escape roots; a degree<F confluent finite Hermite basis multiplied by the eighth power of the normalized escape-product polynomial, together with degree6 escape interpolation polynomials, gives a full seven-row amplitude frame. Cross-block orders are at least r^(9-F) and r^F, positive for finite rank F<=6, while finite jet and escape Gaussian leading diagonal blocks are invertible. This proves the full formal frame rather than inferring scalar independence from a point count. The escape-product coefficients and finite rows descend to C((1/t)); projecting to the canonical zero-exponential component gives an unramified formal matrix times the finite noninteger character powers at alpha=0. Hence no trivial regular composition factor exists over the base Laurent field; even ramification must not erase that descent condition. Nonzero exponential factors cannot supply a trivial factor either. If all positive pure moments vanished, formal Wick relations would define a nonzero rational horizontal quotient of the differential seed submodule with values1,0,0,... on seed derivatives, yielding a forbidden trivial subquotient of the full module. No seed cyclicity, actual-period extension, convergence of the complete stationary-phase expansion or unidentified global formal Fourier/direct-image theorem is used. Finite critical degeneracies, coincident P-values and every quartic gamma/Xi resonance are included. Exact auxiliary checks cover normal coordinate identities, power/Gaussian recurrences, small confluent interpolation partitions, degree valuations and noninteger residues; completeness, descent and differential-module reasoning are internal written mathematics. No explicit uniform numerical pure prefix, independent specialist replay, external review or formal verification is asserted. General nonhomogeneous cuspidal/reducible-leading cubics, coefficient schemes and lower-power GVC remain open.

entries.title: Under nonautomorphic HC4, every constant quadratic two-plane is the unique jointly affine cotangent plane
entries.scope: Over C let f(s,t,u,v) have nonzero constant full Hessian determinant and let E be a constant two-plane of source directions. If f has degree at most two uniformly along all E translates, equivalently f_uuu=f_uuv=f_uvv=f_vvv=0 in adapted affine coordinates, then either grad f is a polynomial automorphism or f is jointly affine along E. Under nonautomorphy E is exactly Tang unique plane W. Thus a genuinely quadratic uniform two-plane or two distinct constant quadratic two-planes forces gradient invertibility, without any bound on the other two variable degrees or total degree. The proof exhausts W projection rank to the retained base: rank two gives a plane Keller pair of total degree at most two; rank one gives a Keller component affine in one variable; both are inverted by elementary proofs reproduced in the note. For an affine component C=a(t)*U+b(t), subtracting powers of C removes the other component free degree and leaves the unit product a*e prime. For the quadratic plane pair, affine normalization gives z+H2, trace and determinant of DH2 vanish, the homogeneous components are proportional, and its constant-direction shear has inverse z-H2. Only projection rank zero remains and gives joint affineness. These standard plane facts are reproduced, not imported from a general degree classification. One quadratic fibre or one vanishing directional cubic derivative does not replace the four uniform polynomial identities. A jointly affine residual plane still retains its plane Keller problem; no general HC4/JC2 inverse is inferred.

entries.title: Every fibre-affine two-affine quadratic embedding has at most one unit-Hessian critical point and only the two old nonautomorphic endpoints
entries.scope: Over C let Q be any nondegenerate ambient quadratic on A5 and j(s,t,u,v)=(s,t,b(s,t)+A(s,t)*(u,v)^T) a polynomial closed embedding, with arbitrary polynomial base coefficients in the 3-by-2 matrix A and three-vector b. Closed embedding is equivalent to a polynomial left inverse of A: differentiate a source recovery formula in the free variables at their zero, and conversely use the left inverse for actual recovery. Generic matrix rank is not enough. Under actual unit source Hessian, every such potential has at most one full critical point, and its nonautomorphic members retain exactly the unit-ideal or singleton-zero plane endpoints. Cotangent alignment and a base-only helper are conclusions under nonautomorphy, not hypotheses: the potential is free-quadratic so HC4MYHT0 forces W equal to the free plane and A^T*C*A=0 for the constant three-helper Hessian block C. A rank-three block has no isotropic two-plane over C(s,t), contradicting the left-invertible A, so all rank-three members have invertible gradient. In rank two the normalized product of the two linear free rows is identically zero in a domain, forcing one entire helper base-only; rank one similarly forces its square helper base-only. HC4MYHR1 then gives the endpoint classification. Nonautomorphic rank-one members must be singleton-zero; rank two permits both endpoints. Both conditional endpoints have explicit fibre-affine genuine embeddings and global inverses in the note. The unbounded two-shear family has all three helpers genuinely free-dependent, helper degrees 2m+2n+1,2m+1,2m+n+1 for arbitrary positive m,n, exactly two affine retained projections and no third base-only constant ambient combination, while its source potential remains st+uv with unit Hessian. It extends the direct base-only-helper hypothesis but is not asserted to escape the earlier quadratic-symmetry saturation. Arbitrary nonlinear free helpers, nonaligned potentials of free degree at least three, both endpoint properness questions and HC4/JC2 remain unresolved.

entries.title: All polynomial constant-coefficient graphs have constructive affine3 Keller completions
entries.scope: For every n>=3, m=n-2 and arbitrary polynomials h_j(b),2<=j<=n-2, the full inverse image of the target graph lambda_j=h_j(b) under the actual Harish marked-root map is ordinary affine3. The functions v_j=C_j-h_j(A0), with C2=A2, extend to an explicit polynomial source coordinate system fixing x. A different initial step applies the polynomial completion lemma directly to A2-h2(A0) in variables y,z4 over k[z3]: its coefficient of z4 is x^2 and its zeroth y slope is -m/2. Every later coefficient still has x^2 times the highest unused z coordinate, since A0 uses only already transformed source coordinates and is x modulo x^2. The constant slopes are c2=-m/2,c3=1,c_(j+2)=-c_j, so the first-jet completion induction works with arbitrary graph degrees. Restriction v=0 gives a globally polynomial affine3 self-map with full Jacobian (-1)^(n-2)*m/2 and generic degree n*m; its exact generic field is K(t,a), a^m=P'(t), by two-sided marked reconstruction and KMFI74. Concrete sparse witnesses include a quadratic n4 graph and iterated n5,n6 graphs, with their entire expanded affine3 Jacobians checked independently. This extends the constant-parameter descent but does not assert an affine source for arbitrary q,r-dependent graphs. Written universal induction, no formal or independent whole-proof review.

entries.title: A strict weighted coefficient-graph gate forces full marked-root wreath monodromy
entries.scope: For n>=3,m=n-2 and P=q*T^n+r*T^(n-1)+sum h_j(q,r,b)*T^j+T-b with polynomial h_j, suppose every q^a*b^c term surviving r=0 satisfies c+j-1>a*(n-1). Scaling q=epsilon^(-(n-1)),b=epsilon*B,T=epsilon*Z and r=0 makes epsilon^(-1)*P specialize exactly to Z^n+Z-B. Its connected Morse cover has group S_n and n-1 simple discriminant zeros. Unramified epsilon-adic decomposition gives this S_n as a subgroup of the generic root group; base change and the separable r=0 specialization cannot enlarge it, proving full S_n. Lifting one simple discriminant zero supplies a target divisor with q a unit and exactly one double root, hence the pair valuations required for KMFI69 Kummer independence. The marked extension K(t,a),a^m=P'(t), therefore has exactly G_n from KMFI69 and the arithmetic action and constants k(mu_m) from KMFI70. All q-independent polynomial graphs h_j(r,b) pass the strict gate, including every actual b-graph in KMFI73. These classes cannot supply a proper root group such as exceptional PSL2(11). A proper root group from a polynomial graph must have a q-dependent term surviving r=0 that violates the strict inequality, but violation is not sufficient. No affine source or Keller occurrence is asserted for arbitrary graphs outside KMFI73, and the gate is sufficient only, not a necessary condition for full S_n. Written universal deformation and valuation proof with pinned primary decomposition input and exact finite scaling controls.

entries.title: Every finite cyclic generic deck group has an explicit stably atomic affine3 Keller witness
entries.scope: Every actual polynomial b-graph map of KMFI73 has the exact marked-root action of KMFI74, so the complete block and intermediate classification of KMFI71 applies: all proper block sizes are d|m, upper extensions are cyclic and no nontrivial polynomial Keller inner factor can realize them. The maps are absolutely and stably atomic for arbitrary graph degrees. Their geometric generic deck group is C_m, their deck group over k is mu_m(k), and their polynomial fixed-target source deck group is trivial. The source chart fixes x and makes original y polynomial, so the generic deck rotation y->y+(1-zeta)/x retains a genuine pole at x=0. Thus every finite cyclic geometric generic deck group has a constructive atomic ordinary-affine3 witness, and products realize every finite abelian generic deck group on affine3s for s nontrivial cyclic factors. No minimal-dimension result, atomicity of a nontrivial product, or abelian monodromy realization is asserted. These strengthen the dimension-n witnesses of KMFI72 without relying on an unverified general nonlinear specialization.

entries.title: A polynomial graph with rational marked component but a nonconstant unit forbids stable affine source
entries.scope: For every n>=4,m=n-2, set h2=-q*b^(n-2)-r*b^(n-3) and all higher h_j=0. The root polynomial has rational root T=b. Its marked component has a^m=D=1+m*q*b^(m+1)+(m-1)*r*b^m. D has a simple linear q-prime over k(b,r), so X^m-D is Eisenstein and the exact degree-m extension is cyclic over algebraically closed characteristic-zero constants. Both fields are rational, since q is rational in a,b,r. KMFI1--2 exclude this pair as a Keller field pair in any dimension, stabilization or birational affine presentation. In the actual smooth affine inverse-image graph component, t=b gives x=b*p, p=1+xy, and p*(1-by)-1=y*(x-b*p)=0. Thus p is a nonconstant unit, generically1/a, proving the rational source component is not stably ordinary affine space. The graph has exact weight equality c+j-1=a*(n-1), and its scaled polynomial has rational root Z=B, so replacing KMFI74 strict inequality by a weak one is false. This is a specific exact countercontrol, not an assertion that every failed weight gate has a proper group or a bad source. Written all-n factor, Kummer and unit proofs with exact finite controls.

entries.title: Two changed rank-six companion pencils have exact derivative rank37
entries.scope: Fix KCUB3 and form two coordinated triangular quadratic source pencils: E_s changesx5 bys*x2*x3/2 andx11 bys*x2*x4; E_w changesx8 byw*x3*x4 andx12 byw*x4^2. Every pair commutes, has determinant1 and preserves cubic degree ofK E by exact quartic cancellation. For each nonzero parameter the cubic-output rank is6, giving the explicit19-variable standard homogeneous companion with six active cubic outputs; the padded tensor is affine in the parameter. Independent Fraction arithmetic reconstructs both full source compositions, all companion tensor coefficients and cubic rank6, importing only the pinned KCUB3 determinant plus the written companion Schur identity. All37 Laurent-unit Gaussian pivots per pencil and zero residuals are independently replayed from all partial derivatives, proving derivative-space rank exactly37 for every nonzero parameter with no hidden exceptional roots; at zero rank is35. Consequently every nonzero padded tensor needs at least37 scalar linear cubes, over any characteristic-zero field. This is a conditional tensor lower bound, not a global Keller/cubic-linear bound. Full98-cube identities at s=-6 andw=-3/2 are checked coefficientwise, with coefficient-matrix rank19 and normalized pure-tau padding. Uniform100-cube and101-cube identities are checked for both coefficients of the entire s/w affine pencils. Thus the least cube count over nonzero parameters in each specified pencil lies in[37,98], without asserting98 minimal. Complete rational base and19-variable companion collision points are verified at the two selected parameters. These examples do not improve the known18-variable homogeneous construction or89-variable cubic-linear construction, and no dominated98-variable matrix is advertised as a record. Bounded basis exchanges in277/427/271 fixed cube pools stop at98; the two20-second s-pool LRA support queries at88 and97 remain UNKNOWN, not UNSAT. Neither finite-pool optimality, arbitrary pencil/decomposition coverage nor any global dimension/support optimum is claimed. entries.title: Exact volume forces a regular source coordinate in all degrees and closes the entire single-index-two-prime quartic packet

entries.title: The canonical-line functor turns every smooth etale receiver into a volume-preserving receiver without changing its degree or marked fibre

entries.title: Prime-subgroup stabilizer bound for the cycle-gcd invariant of independently stabilized curve actions
entries.scope: For a finite transitive G/H action and prime p dividing |G|, if p^b is the largest p-part of any element order, then v_p(C(G,G/H))<=b. entries.scope: Let P(T,z) have positive z degree m and arbitrary nonzero leading coefficient a(T). entries.title: All-degree unramified marked-sheet bound and pairwise complete-curve exclusions with full source principal parts
entries.scope: For every actual plane Keller finite normalization of degree d and every unramified omitted prime D, its residue-one immersive polynomial image H has a marked degree-one local sheet at every finite point. On a simultaneous target infinity model resolving the full branch union together with H, put eta_H=-K_X.Hbar-2=Hbar^2-2delta_H. If eta_H>0 then(d-1)eta_H<=2delta_H, hence d<=1+2delta_H/eta_H. Its full R and D substitutions have nonzero affine-linear leading equations in t and v; both ends extend to finite points of the actual omitted charts. The projective normalization of any component therefore maps nonconstantly into affine N, impossible because global functions on a proper integral curve are constant. This excludes the ENTIRE simple/simple complementary index-two/unramified sector at every pole order and every lower coefficient, with no finite Keller map needed for this geometric contradiction. Higher-order version: take arbitrary generic index e on R, assume r>=max(2,e), regular coordinate y and smooth affine component open. The normalized finite y root gives entire planes y=z^r,x=z^(e-r)t+h(z), support r-e+1<=j<=q, gcd(r,support)=1 and exact residue c_r=0. The unramified D chart still has simple regular x and pole p, with d1=0. Define j(a)=max support j with r not dividing a*j, S=sum_(a=1)^(r-1)(2q-j(a)) and Delta=r*q-S. P is polynomial with top term x^r*y^q, constant nonzero at y0, and top-column x^(r-1)y^(q-1) coefficient -r*c_r=0. For P0=x^(p-r)P and A0=[y^(q-1)]P0, degA0<=p-2; F=P0-y^(q-1)(A0+D) repairs the entire D column while retaining every R principal-part coefficient. At R, v(partial_x P0)=B=S+2q-pq and M=B+e-r is the first varying chart order. The repair has order at least M+Delta-e and its t variation is higher, so F=z^M(alpha*t+beta+O(z)), alpha nonzero. At D it has the analogous unique affine-linear v leading equation. The preserved R infinity face has multiplicity r exhausted by the r primitive conjugate roots; the D face has multiplicity one. No other infinity branch exists. This again gives a complete source curve in affine N and excludes the configuration. It applies to any e under the stated smoothness, regular-coordinate, r and p conditions, without claiming those are automatic for higher-index primes. In particular at e2, p>=r and gcd(q,r)=1 give Delta=q and exclude all q>=2, including q=r-1 with r>=3; multicharacteristic supports with rq-S>=2 are also excluded. Hence in the quartic packet, complementary coordinates with simple vanishing on D force either r>=2 and p<r, or rq-S<=1 when p>=r, or departure from the complementary-coordinate/simple-D hypotheses. Common or noncomplementary coordinate rulings, higher D order, the r2q1 borderline, and failure of the sufficient defect are not excluded uniformly. The polynomial is an actual source curve, not an asserted global principal divisor on N. Whole charts retain the original embedding and all infinity branches; no affineness/finiteness claim is made after deleting other primes. 209 exact controls check inherited seals, the point-stabilizer degree identity, arbitrary-coefficient simple charts including A and residue countercontrols, full norm/resultant constructions at indices1 through4 with single/multiple characteristics, derivative and top-column identities, preserved infinity-face weights, complete implicit boundary roots and failed-defect controls. entries.title: Keller base change preserves every finite nilpotent Galois target group in every dimension and degree
entries.scope: Let K:A^n to A^n be complex Keller, n>=1, F=C(K), L=C(z), and M/F any finite Galois extension with finite nilpotent group G. Then M intersect L=F, [ML:L]=[M:F], and restriction Gal(ML/L) to G is an isomorphism. There are no monicity, normal-model, ramification-divisor, special-fibre or degree restrictions. The proof uses HC4MYHW0, not a general Galois-case theorem. Every proper subgroup of a finite p-group has strictly larger normalizer by its action on cosets; maximal proper subgroups are therefore normal of index p. A subgroup of a direct product of Sylow groups is the product of its Sylow intersections, by taking primary components as element powers. Thus every proper subgroup J of finite nilpotent G lies in some normal N with G/N=C_p. If the actual source restriction image J were proper, M^N would be a nontrivial cyclic prime-degree extension of F contained in M^J=M intersect L, contradicting HC4MYHW0. Full nilpotent group preservation is proved here; it is not inferred from mere root transitivity. Every irreducible polynomial over F with nilpotent splitting group remains irreducible over L, even for nonmonic or nonnormal models. Every finite intermediate E of L/F with nilpotent Galois closure equals F. In particular a nonautomorphic Keller field extension must have nonnilpotent Galois closure. No conclusion for arbitrary solvable or arbitrary finite Galois groups is asserted. In S3 a proper order-two subgroup surjects onto the abelianization and lies in no normal prime-index subgroup, recording the exact failure of this argument beyond nilpotence.

entries.scope: Let P(T,z) in C[T,z] have positive z degree and arbitrary nonzero leading coefficient. The global free xy basis, generic positive filtration and geometric integrality of every affine height-one target fibre across leading-degree drops are retained from HC4MYHZ2. The generic torsion-free root-divisor lattice has nilpotent action, so HC4MYIA1 applies; equivalently HC4MYIA0 supplies full root-group preservation and transitivity. In particular fix any prime p and any number k of stages q_i=a_i(T)*(z-b_i(T))^(p^e_i)+c_i(T), with a_i nonzero and e_i>=1. Every composition P=q_k composed with ... composed with q_1 closes, with all stage counts, exponents, coefficient and embedding degrees unrestricted. Coefficients may lie in C(T) if the final P is polynomial. This includes every finite composition of arbitrary quadratics in z over C[T], by rational completion of squares. Adjoining every preimage at each level forms a finite Galois p-extension: each kernel injects into a product of cyclic p-power Kummer groups, and the complete radicand set is stable under the previous Galois group. No maximal wreath group is asserted for every composition, and no general mixed-prime or solvable extension is asserted nilpotent. The nonmonic P=T*(z^2-T)^2 has exactly D8 root group: over b^2=-V/T the independent square classes T+b,T-b give splitting degree eight. It is nonabelian and not a translated fourth power, so the new gate strictly exceeds the preceding unconditional abelian gate. Actual closed embedding and independent unit-Hessian controls retain their literal gradient inverses. A remaining nonautomorphic realization in the full family needs both nonnilpotent generic root monodromy and positive localized-unit defect at a leading zero. The finite leading-fibre gate remains independent. Both plane endpoints, other embedding geometries and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Every repeated-line leading ternary cubic is GMC-safe and pure nullity forces a W-linear frame
entries.scope: Over C in characteristic zero, every ternary cubic with nonreduced leading homogeneous form L^2*M or L^3 is GMC-safe. Pure nullity forces a nonzero v with B(v,v)=0,grad F3(v)=0,F2(v)=0, hence a Gaussian W-linear frame. For nonisotropic L=u, arbitrary lower terms give P=Y^T A Y+(p*u^2+q*u+r)^T Y+g(u). Exact quadratic elimination gives determinant prefactor det(I-2tA)^(-1/2) and a degree<=4 one-variable phase. The quartic vanishes identically iff p.p=p.A.p=0, which directly supplies the frame. Otherwise the exhaustive invertible, semisimple rank1, nilpotent rank1 and zero matrix split yields full-degree shrinking, an explicit degree-drop escape model, or a fixed quartic with decaying prefactor. For L^3 the cubic coefficient remains nonzero, and all matrix cases exclude pure nullity. For isotropic L=Z, zero W^2 coefficient supplies the frame; with nonzero coefficient the three leading forms Z^2*W+aZ^3,Z^2*T,Z^3 admit exact generic-t W/T quadratic completion and exhaustive stable-degree or degree-drop exclusions. Determinant prefactors never grow, all bounded zero-exponential periods shrink, and escaping actions cannot cancel the stated scalar orders. The written proof imports the retained complete one-variable cut/local-block and rational seed-to-actual-period arguments; no seed cyclicity or Wick convergence is assumed. The checker verifies exact elimination identities and degree/action/count arithmetic, not analytic completeness. Independent replay, external review and formal verification remain outstanding.

entries.scope: Every complex polynomial P of total degree at most3 in three independent standard real Gaussian coordinates satisfies GMC. Pure nullity is equivalent to BOTH existence of nonzero v with B(v,v)=0,grad F3(v)=0,F2(v)=0 and E(P^j)=0 for j=1,...,888. Pure nullity therefore forces a Gaussian W-linear frame. The squarefree-leading case cover, repeated-line theorem and retained quadratic classification exhaust the degree<=3 space; the complete W-linear theorem then gives E(QP^m)=0 for every polynomial Q and m>3*deg Q. entries.title: A1-rigid bases force cylinder projection and eliminate all finite coefficient coupling
entries.scope: In characteristic zero let Z be smooth geometrically integral affine and geometrically A1-rigid, meaning every geometric A1 map to Z is constant. entries.title: Free boundary class group and effective nontorsion canonical vector of a Keller finite normalization
entries.scope: For a polynomial Keller map X=A^d to Y=A^d over algebraically closed characteristic-zero constants, let Z be the finite normalization of Y in k(X). Zariski main makes X an open subset. entries.title: Every finite Galois intermediate extension of a complex Keller function field is trivial, without a group restriction
dependencies: external: Stacks 0EXQ Lemma 15.113.3, Definition 15.113.7 and the finite-etale criterion in the proof of Lemma 15.113.8
entries.scope: Let K:A^n to A^n be complex Keller, n>=1, F=C(K), L=C(z), and F subset E subset L finite Galois. Then E=F for every finite Galois group, with all polynomial and extension degrees unrestricted. Every target irreducible b has nonconstant square-free pullback and a visible source divisor mapping dominantly to b=0 by HC4MYHW0. The associated DVR has ramification index one. Restriction to E and the explicitly imported DVR multiplicativity force one prime of the finite normalization of the target in E to have index one; its residue extension is separable in characteristic zero. Galois normality makes all primes over that target divisor conjugate, so every missing as well as visible prime is unramified. Prime conjugacy is checked by the Chinese-remainder/norm argument. The retained Stacks 0BSD and 0BMB ramification/purity inputs make this finite normal cover etale over the regular target. The retained forward finite-cover comparison and contractibility of C^n force connected degree one. No properness of the original Keller source or finite-cover status for an arbitrary etale affine map is assumed. This forbids Galois intermediate fields, not arbitrary nonnormal intersections with target splitting fields, and does not assert full preservation of every Galois target group. The nilpotent full-group conclusion of HC4MYIA0 remains separately justified. A nonnormal cubic control has a simple and a ramified place over the same target divisor, showing why a single visible unramified place alone is insufficient.

entries.title: The missing divisors in a plane Keller normalization form an exact free global class basis; factorial normalization forces the inverse
entries.scope: Let K be complex plane Keller, F=C(K), L=C(s,t), and N=Spec A_L the finite normalization of A=C[K1,K2] in L. By the retained Zariski Main input in HC4MYOR2 the polynomial source X=A2 is a dense open in N. If D1,...,Db are the prime divisors omitted from X, then the global Weil class group is exactly Cl(N)=direct_sum_i Z[D_i], with those actual boundary classes a free basis. Every divisor restricts to a principal divisor on the source UFD, giving generation; any principal boundary relation restricts to a rational function with zero divisor on A2, hence a source unit in C*, giving independence. Codimension-two omitted points contribute no class generator. N need not be smooth, locally factorial or globally factorial. There are no missing boundary divisors if and only if K is invertible: in their absence normal Hartogs identifies the regular-function rings of affine N and X, making the open immersion an isomorphism; K is then finite etale and degree one. Consequently a torsion global class group, in particular a finite or zero global class group or a globally factorial normalization, forces the polynomial inverse. A hypothetical nonautomorphic plane normalization must have a nonzero free global class group whose rank equals its missing-divisor count. This is not a statement that local factoriality or local Q-factoriality forces global factoriality. The smooth surface xy=z^2-1 with its explicit open affine-plane chart and one omitted component realizes the nonzero boundary class control, while a finite projection on that chart fails Keller. Removing both components instead gives a nonconstant unit and a boundary relation. The normalization class group is not identified with an ambient generic output class group. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Subnormal divisor-class stabilizers close the filtered output obstruction beyond nilpotent monodromy
entries.scope: In HC4MYHW1 retain the common free target basis, exhaustive positive generic-domain filtration, geometrically integral affine height-one fibres, normal geometric generic ring and torsion-free Weil class group. Allow an arbitrary finite Galois image Gamma on that class group. If every class stabilizer is subnormal in Gamma, the closed stable embedding carrying a plane Keller pair still forces it invertible in every degree and for every r>=0. It suffices to know this for the actual selected source-component class alpha. Its stabilizer S contains the actual source group image J. A proper subnormal S lies in a proper normal subgroup N of Gamma, namely the last proper term of a strict subnormal chain. In the finite Galois field M of the class action, M^N would be a nontrivial finite Galois intermediate field contained in M^J=M intersect L, contradicting HC4MYIB0. Thus S=Gamma; all d conjugate component classes equal alpha, their reduced principal sum gives d*alpha=0, and torsion-freeness makes the components principal. The retained global component-pencil, primitive saturation and smooth minimal-label argument force d=1. This concerns divisor-class stabilizers; the actual component or source stabilizer is not assumed normal. Normal class stabilizers suffice even for nonnilpotent images. An explicit nonnilpotent integral module is the Hurwitz quaternion lattice with the 24 norm-one units acting by left multiplication. Every nonidentity unit fixes no nonzero rational vector, so all vector stabilizers are trivial or the full group and hence normal. Direct sums with trivial modules or more copies retain this property. The nonnormal order-three Sylow subgroup proves the image is not nilpotent. This is a class-module certificate only; no ambient output realizing that module is constructed or asserted. The S3 action on Z^3/Z(1,1,1) has a nonzero class with an order-two stabilizer that is not subnormal, so arbitrary nonmonic cubic roots remain outside this new gate. Both plane endpoints, the positive-unit-defect nonnilpotent branch not meeting another gate, other outputs and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Two-sided full-norm exclusions for arbitrary unramified boundary order and affine common-ruling controls
entries.scope: Let normal affine N contain marked U=A2_(x,y) and disjoint omitted affine lines R,D, with exact source volume of orders e-1 and0. Require smooth affine component opens U union R,U union D and the SAME complementary source coordinate pair with y regular and zero of order r on R and x regular and zero of order s>=1 on unramified D. Other primes are retained. For r>=max(2,e) the whole root charts from PF2RULED48/46 are y=z^r,x=h(z)+z^(e-r)t and x=w^s,y=g(w)+w^(1-s)v, with full negative supports j>=r-e+1 on h and j>=s+1 on g, primitive support gcds and exact c_r=d_s=0. Define contact sums S_R=sum_(a=1)^(r-1)(2q-j_R(a)), Delta_R=r*q-S_R, and S_D,Delta_D analogously; at s1 use S_D0,Delta_D=p. The configuration is impossible if q>=max(r+1,s), p>=r, Delta_R>=e and Delta_D>=s+1. This removes the simple-D-zero assumption from an unbounded all-degree/all-index sector, with higher-index smoothness and regular-coordinate hypotheses still explicit. Put P_R=y^q product_(z^r=y)(x-h), P_D=x^p product_(w^s=x)(y-g), P0=x^(p-r)P_R. Delete from P0 exactly the nonleading monomials x^(p-k)y^(q-l) with l<max(2,k), calling the full band E. Exact trace c_r0 removes k1,l1. Every deleted monomial has k>=2,l<=k-1, hence R order relative to its first chart-varying term is Delta_R-e+q(k-2)-r(l-1)>=0. entries.title: Sufficient720-moment pure gate for all cuspidal-leading ternary cubics
entries.scope: For ternary cubics with IRREDUCIBLE CUSPIDAL leading curve,720 initial zero pure moments suffice. In F3=T*u^2+v^3 coordinates, H2=u^2,G3=v^3. Weights(3,4) give top U=(t^2/2)*u^4+tD*v^3 of weight12 and lower weight<=10, with rank6 basis1,u,u^2,v,uv,u^2v. At most8 reductions use common principal divisor A=a*b of degree<=4, where a=t^2/2,b=tD. Thus H=D^2*A^8,B=34 and prefix34*6*7/2+6=720. D=0 has nonzero rank-one tangent cone; its W-linear frame uses the425 rank-one gate or320 fourteen-coefficient gate. Over C in characteristic zero, with arbitrary lower terms and the full nondegenerate affine Gaussian metric/means retained, the stated initial pure-zero gate implies all-order pure nullity and E(QP^m)=0 for m>3*deg Q. Choose the unique leading singular point as T-axis and write P=alpha*T^2+T*(H2+ell)+G3+g2. Exact principal divisions bound the connection by N/H with numerator and denominator degree<=B. entries.title: Sufficient935-moment pure gate for all tangent line-conic ternary cubics
entries.scope: For ternary cubics with leading curve a LINE TANGENT TO A SMOOTH CONIC,935 initial zero pure moments suffice. In F3=T*u^2+u*v^2 coordinates, H2=u^2,G3=u*v^2. Weights(2,3) give top U=a*u^4+b*u*v^2 of weight8 with a=t^2/2,b=tD nonzero, lower weight<=7,rank5 basis1,u,u^2,v,v^2. Explicit weighted principal divisions use A=a*b^2 of degree<=6 and at most10 corrections; H=D^2*A^10,B=62 and prefix62*5*6/2+5=935. The D=0 rank-one tangent-cone frame uses425 or320. The transverse line-conic class is excluded qualitatively but remains outside this numerical bound. Over C in characteristic zero, with arbitrary lower terms and the full nondegenerate affine Gaussian metric/means retained, the stated initial pure-zero gate implies all-order pure nullity and E(QP^m)=0 for m>3*deg Q. Choose the unique leading singular point as T-axis and write P=alpha*T^2+T*(H2+ell)+G3+g2. Completing T with D=m-2alpha*t!=0 gives normalized prefactor D^(-1/2) and phase U/D with deg_t U<=2,deg_t D<=1. A fixed regular weighted Jacobian symbol sequence gives the full binary quotient basis. Exact principal divisions bound the connection by N/H with numerator and denominator degree<=B. Minimal-seed cofactors give scalar degree<=B*s*(s+1)/2; retained analytic no-constant-period exclusion makes its zeroth coefficient nonzero, so the original formal Wick series has a nonzero pure moment by B*s*(s+1)/2+s on D!=0, even if D(0)=0. The D=0 frame branch is handled by smaller retained pure gates. These are sufficient class bounds, not optimal values or numerical global arbitrary-cubic upper bounds. The checker verifies universal completion/division/weight identities and six exact rational model connections with all30 column certificates; it does not certify universal filtered-Koszul exactness, complete normal/frame choices, analytic period arguments or high-order moments. No independent specialist replay, external review or formal verification is claimed. entries.title: Critical-factor units have precise permitted leading supports and satisfy every subset unit-rank constraint, in all degrees
entries.scope: Let K=(f,g) be complex plane Keller, P(T,z) of z degree m>=2 with leading a nonzero, and suppose P(f,h)+g=0 for a rational h in C(s,t). The retained normalized polynomial label u=a(f)*h has Q(T,U,V)=a(T)^(m-1)*(P(T,U/a(T))+V) monic and J(f,u)*Q_U(f,u)=-a(f)^(m-1)*J(f,g). Write Q_U=m product_i H_i(T,U)^n_i with distinct monic irreducible factors over C(T); Gauss lemma puts H_i in C[T,U]. For S_i={c:a(c)=0,H_i(c,0)=0}, the polynomial localized unit H_i(f,u) has zero divisors only over S_i. At a leading zero Q specializes to U^(m-1)*(U+b_(m-1)(c)); it and its derivative have no common root except possibly zero. Therefore any source zero of H_i(f,u) over that level has u=0 and H_i(c,0)=0. These units are multiplicatively independent even modulo C(f)^*, by the distinct irreducible factors in the transcendental variable u. For every nonempty subset I, |I|<=sum_(c in union_(i in I) S_i)(r_c-1), where r_c is the number of full irreducible f=c components, by the exact localized-unit lattice HC4MYHZ0. This refines the total rank budget and counts irreducible critical factors over C(T), not roots after parameter extension. If gcd(a,H_i(T,0))=1 for any factor, its support is empty and a rational source root is impossible, without any special-fibre irreducibility hypothesis. All degrees and factor multiplicities are unrestricted. In particular P=a(T)z^m+b(T)z^(m-1)+d(T) has no rational source root when gcd(a,b)=1, using the critical factor U+(m-1)b/m. If a has one distinct zero with b_(m-1) nonzero there and Q_U completely splits over C(T), its nonzero specialized critical branch also has empty support. Allowed levels are not asserted actual zeros, and no-rational-root is not promoted to higher-degree irreducibility. No new external theorem, Hall matching theorem or S-unit height bound is imported.

entries.title: Cubic square-critical-discriminant outputs close under an empty-support gcd, allowing arbitrary leading multiplicities
entries.scope: Let P=a(T)z^3+b(T)z^2+c(T)z+d(T), a nonzero, with nonzero square critical discriminant b^2-3ac=H(T)^2. If gcd(a,b-H)=1 or gcd(a,b+H)=1, every closed stable embedding A^(r+2) to A^(r+3), r>=1, carrying a plane Keller pair through (T,xy-P) forces that pair invertible. All parameter, leading-coefficient and embedding degrees are unrestricted, with no special K1-fibre or nilpotent-group hypothesis. The normalized derivative has roots (-b+H)/3 and (-b-H)/3; one has empty permitted support by HC4MYID0. A reducible source cubic would have a rational root, so source irreducibility, root-lattice transitivity and the retained global filtered proof give the inverse. In particular this closes a=alpha*(T-c0)^q for arbitrary q>=1 whenever b(c0) is nonzero and the critical discriminant is a nonzero square. Every sparse cubic a(T)z^3+b(T)z^2+d(T) with gcd(a,b)=1 also closes; b=0 then forces constant leading coefficient and is already monic. The explicit unbounded family P=T^q*z^3+z^2-(2R+T^q*R^2)*z/3+d, arbitrary q>=1 and arbitrary polynomial R,d, has H=1+T^q*R and a critical branch -(2+T^q*R)/3 of empty support. Its generic root group is S3, since the V-discriminant of the z-discriminant is 16*H^6 nonzero; the older square-free-leading, full-leading-drop and critical-genus gates do not close this family. If the new gcd condition fails, the two critical supports S_+={a=0,b-H=0} and S_-={a=0,b+H=0} each require defect at least one and their union defect at least two. When gcd(a,b)=1 they are disjoint, forcing two distinct reducible full f-fibres, one in each support, rather than concentration of defect at one level. The coefficient control a=T*(T-1), b=1, c=-4/3, H=1-2T has both supports nonempty and is not closed by this gate; no Keller realization is asserted. The nonsquare critical-discriminant linear-part case must not be counted as two rational branches. General higher-degree intransitive factorizations, both plane endpoints, other outputs and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Degree-seven cubic-component exclusion leaves12 full profiles
entries.scope: No3D characteristic-zero Keller counterexample of ordinary degree<=7 has a nonzero constant output combination of degree<=3. For the exceptional cubic r=x+x^2y, use B=C[x,y],K=C(r),F=K(u=1/x),D=partial_u and the retained GLDC8/9 obstructions. A universal UFD kth-power-class lemma covers every squarefree fibre, including both zero-fibre factors. Polynomiality of A(r)/x+B(r) forces A,B polynomial and r|A; the formal residue consequently forces every invariant leading coefficient to vanish at r0. Monic rational(4,3) coefficient equations give XY constant and derivative of4X^3/27-eX^2/3-2Y^2/3 equalJ inK*. Rational-map composition degrees5,3 or2 contradict degree1. The invariant-leading(4,2) case reduces to both leading coefficients r. Its rational normal form and polynomiality across the two disjoint zero-fibre components force either an uncancelled pole or a constant coefficient -c^2*alpha1(r)/x+I(r), impossible because alpha1(0) is nonzero. The new quadratic leading pattern(r-c)*ell^2 is handled explicitly: the affine-linear residue forces ell proportionaltox, while a monic cubic/quadratic square condition would require the reciprocal of a nonconstant affine polynomial inr to be a square inK. All21 positive z-degree pairs through6 are covered by these field and fibre arguments, with no reuse of degree bounds after increasing shears. The universal proofs are written, not formalized or fully independently replayed. Exact symbolic rational normal-form, monic coefficient, two-component gluing, mixed-affine, power-class degree and integer-case controls pass. The reviewed degree-independent cubic scalar classification gives either the exceptional scalar or a coordinate completion with inverse degree<=5; plane degrees<=35 are within KPAIR1/Moh100. Thus733,743,753,763 are four further unrestricted full-profile exclusions:62of74 excluded,12 remaining. Every degree<=7 candidate now needs minimum invariant output degree>=4. entries.title: All-degree common unramified coordinate pencil, index-two compatibility and sharp complementary principal parts
entries.scope: For every actual plane Keller finite normalization, all unramified omitted primes have the SAME intrinsic regular source-coordinate pencil, with boundary constants allowed to differ. For any index-two omitted prime and any unramified omitted prime, the intrinsic coordinate pencils are either common or an actual complementary source automorphism pair. No noncomplementary-coordinate case survives, in any finite field degree and with arbitrary other omitted primes retained. The componentwise coordinate existence, smooth affine opens and exact whole charts are the retained PF2RULED38/43/45/46 and PF2OMIT7 results, applied to each component open; the full finite map is not replaced by a deleted open. The geometric proof uses O(N) subset C[U] intersect O_vR intersect O_vD, so that pairwise intersection algebra has transcendence degree2. Xie Theorem1.2, pinned and visually checked in the exact UNNORMALIZED primitive dual-divisor formulation, forces its dual-intersection matrix to be negative definite. This is necessary for the original affine N, not an affineness certificate. For distinct polynomial coordinate pencils f,g define m as their generic affine source fibre intersection number, equivalently degree_x(g) in coordinates(x,f). The full arbitrary-length Jung normal form makes g monic up to constant in x, so v_R(g)=-m*q. On a P1_h times P1_g completion extracting R over g=infinity and D over its finite g value, the cross pairing is exactly checkR.checkD=m*q*p, retaining all chart coefficients and relative automorphism lengths. A full norm curvette of x=h(z)+z^(e-r)t,f=z^r has diagonal checkR^2=-n_R, n_R=S_R+2q-r+e. Here S_R=sum_(a=1)^(r-1)(2q-j_R(a)) is the entire support contact sum, empty when r1. Its two generic curvettes have local intersection q^2+n_R at source infinity, and the orthogonal blowup basis gives the diagonal q^2-I. The D formula is n_D=S_D+2p-s+1. Negative definiteness requires the strict product n_R*n_D>m^2*q^2*p^2. For exact unramified charts the support starts at s+1, giving 0<n_D<=2s*p-s^2-s+2<=p^2. Two distinct unramified pencils would require a strict product larger than m^2*p1^2*p2^2 with m>=1, impossible; thus all unramified primes share their unique coordinate pencil. For index-two R, 0<n_R<=3q^2, with equality allowed at r2q1, while r1 exactness gives q>=2,n_R=2q+1. Hence an index-two/unramified distinct pair requires m^2<3, so m1; monicity then makes(f,g) an actual source automorphism pair. In the complementary sector n_R>q^2 is additionally required. For r1 it forces q2. For r>=2 let g0=gcd(r,q). Exactly r-g0 characters have j_R(a)=q, while the other g0-1 have j_R(a)>=r-1. Thus n_R<=(r+g0)q-g0*r+g0+1. If q>=r+1, g0 divides q-r, and q^2-n_R>=(q-r)(q-g0)-g0-1>=0, a contradiction. The exact residue forbids q=r. Therefore r>=2 forces q=r-1, and the entire R principal part is the sole monomial c*z^(-(r-1)). All higher and multicharacteristic R Laurent sectors are excluded for complementary coordinates, at every D order and pole. For r1 retain the simultaneous A constant and only c2*f^-2. Combining it with PF2RULED48/49 gives: simple R requires q2 and D order s>=3; if D has simple zero, R order2 permits only p2,3,4,5, while every R order>=3 requires p2. These are surviving necessary configurations, not finite Keller realizations. Common-pencilled models, with equal or distinct boundary constants, are not excluded. The actual smooth affine exact-volume common-ruling controls of PF2RULED49 remain valid. A nonexact residue control fails the unramified diagonal bound, and the complementary simple/simple p=q2 matrix is negative definite but its complete curve still prevents affineness. 257 exact controls include actual shared-centre point-blowup matrices, full diagonal and cross pairings, canonical orders, symbolic uniform inequalities and finite arithmetic checks supporting the written universal proof. entries.title: Adler periods and leading divisor obstruction for finite mate admission
entries.scope: For any finite scalar operator S of order n>=2 on a characteristic-zero coefficient curve, write H for its leading coefficient and g=gcd(n,all zero and pole orders of H). If g=1 then every finite T with order[S,T]<=n-2 belongs to C[S], so the entire low-order commutator image is zero and no nonzero constant mate exists. Highest-order commutation forces (n/g)|order(T); when g=1, subtracting a constant multiple of a power of S strictly reduces order until a contradiction. This is independent of every lower coefficient. Fixed-mate trace extends the nonexistence to all finite coefficient covers, although the base centralizer statement is not asserted after covers. In particular every nonconstant squarefree polynomial leading coefficient is excluded for finite differential mates, in every operator order n>=2 and with arbitrary mixed lower terms and partner poles. At prime n over K(v), any surviving leading coefficient is a scalar times an nth power of a rational function. Separately, in the quadratic chart [a,v]=h/v, leading Adler exactness reduces for arbitrary rational H to Qprime-(Hprime/(n*H))*Q=v with rational Q. For squarefree polynomial H, pole and divisibility arguments give Q=H*U and degree U=2-degree H. Thus degree>=3 excludes even bounded-above PDO mates; degree1 passes this leading PDO test, and degree2 passes exactly for centered H=A*v^2+C. Passing the leading test does not supply a finite mate. On delta=v^(1-d)*partial_v the corresponding squarefree leading PDO gate requires degree H<=d, and equality requires H=A*v^d+B. For an arbitrary scalar differential operator S of order n>=2 over a characteristic-zero algebraic coefficient curve, finite leading-root normalization gives a monic formal pseudodifferential root R and a first-order generator E with zero root subprincipal term. The de Rham-valued Adler classes [res_E(R^j)*omega_E] must vanish for every j!=-n if a nonzero constant commutator mate exists, even in the algebra of bounded-above pseudodifferential series. A monomial telescoping formula proves the trace identity. Normalized coefficient trace descends fixed linear mate problems across every finite coefficient cover; nonzero period classes persist. Invertible pseudodifferential conjugation preserves classes, while algebraic first-order generator changes preserve the residue differential exactly. Arbitrary Fourier changes need a completion comparison. With omega_E exact, vanishing of every positive class is necessary and sufficient for a bounded-above pseudodifferential mate: recursive negative-order dressing gives T0=kappa/(n*h)*W*u*E^(1-n)*W^-1. This dressing may have h poles and is not a bounded or regular h-adic quantum gauge. Finite differential mates have the exact established almost-commuting-basis criterion: kappa belongs to the finite constant-linear span of C_j=[S,(R^j)_+], j>=0. The defects have order<=n-2. Highest-order induction eliminates unknown coefficient functions; a finite prefix does not decide all-order nonmembership. For S=G(a)+mu*v, [a,v]=h/v, degree G=n>=2, the local period of (S/g_n)^(2+1/n) is exactly -(2n+1)*(n^2-1)/(24*n^2)*(mu/g_n)^2*h^2, independent of lower G terms. A two-potential, two-contraction selection and symbolic second variation prove the all-degree formula, a characteristic-zero multiple of QPC1 gamma_n. This excludes even bounded-above pseudodifferential mates over all finite covers for that fixed family. It does not identify the residue with QRF2. The harmonic oscillator a^2+u^2 has every positive period exact and a pseudodifferential mate but no finite differential mate by QSO2 and a first-order contradiction. The all-n mixed positive family S=(v^3*a)^n-v^-1, T=-v^3*a has a finite mate and controls the leading-normalization boundary. The Adler trace and almost-commuting basis are established machinery, credited to primary sources; universal statements and the explicit residue bridge have written proofs. Exact controls check five projected fractional roots, a full quadratic density, the universal coefficient identity, trace primitives, conjugation and finite covers, a mixed cubic basis reconstruction, positive mixed pairs and initial harmonic dressing/PDO terms. No arbitrary matrix criterion, finite Long carrier, bounded full lift, all-representative nonlifting, scalar or matrix counterexample, independent theorem replay, formal verification, external review, novelty priority or DC2 solution is claimed.

entries.title: Reduced singleton critical units force constant separation, and the two-level cubic residual reduces to one fixed output model
entries.scope: In the rational-label setting of HC4MYID0, suppose two distinct rational normalized critical branches beta_i,beta_j in C[T] give polynomial units v_i=u-beta_i(f), v_j=u-beta_j(f) which are reduced, with each allowed support a singleton c_i,c_j. Then beta_i-beta_j is a nonzero constant, with all coefficient and source degrees unrestricted. At a zero of v_i, f=c_i and u=0, making v_j the scalar -beta_j(c_i). Reducedness gives v_i dividing v_j plus that scalar; the reverse divisibility also holds. Total degrees force equal degrees and scalar quotients. Writing v_j=lambda*v_i+kappa, algebraic independence of f,u forces lambda=1, so the critical branches differ by a constant. No source embedding rectification or coordinate theorem is used. Consequently for P=a z^3+b z^2+c z+d with a square-free having at most two distinct zeros, gcd(a,b)=1 and b^2-3ac=H^2 with H nonconstant, every closed stable embedding A^(r+2) to A^(r+3), r>=1, carrying a plane Keller pair through (T,xy-P) forces that pair invertible. Constant leading coefficient is already monic; a single leading level or empty support is closed by HC4MYID1. Otherwise the two supports are disjoint singletons. At any source prime of a critical unit, u is zero along that full smooth fibre component, so J(f,u) has valuation at least one. The other critical unit is nonzero there by gcd(a,b)=1. The exact identity 3J(f,u)v_+v_-=-a(f)^2 J(f,g) has right-hand valuation two, forcing that critical unit valuation exactly one; hence both units are reduced. Their separation 2H/3 cannot be constant, contradicting the global pencil conclusion. All parameter and embedding degrees are unrestricted. Repeated leading zeros do not inherit the valuation-two reducedness proof. No claim for all square-discriminant cubic outputs is made. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. The remaining constant-gap branch with two simple leading levels also has one fixed cubic output model. If a has zeros c0,c1 and the populated supports give b(c0)=H0, b(c1)=-H0 for nonzero constant H0, set T=c0+Delta*tau, a=alpha*tau*(tau-1). Then b=H0*(1-2tau)+a*B(tau). The polynomial shift z=Z-B/3 forces the linear coefficient to 4H0^2/(3alpha); rescaling Z=(H0/alpha)*zeta gives P=kappa*P_star+d_tilde(tau), kappa=H0^3/alpha^2, P_star=tau*(tau-1)*zeta^3+(1-2tau)*zeta^2+4*zeta/3. The explicit ambient automorphism Psi=(c0+Delta*tau,kappa*X,Y,(H0/alpha)*zeta-B/3) and target automorphism Theta=(c0+Delta*tau,kappa*V-d_tilde) satisfy Pi composed with Psi=Theta composed with Pi_star. Their polynomial inverses preserve closed embedding data and the Keller/invertibility status of the carried target pair in both directions, with all extra ambient variables fixed. entries.title: Every finite group has an explicit free field-versal affine monomial action on a torus
entries.scope: For every finite constant group F over k with characteristic not dividing |F|, choose one prime-order subgroup H from each conjugacy class, E_H=k(zeta_ell), and coinduce its faithful translation character on Res_(E_H/k)Gm. The product B of these induced tori has a free F action on its entire torus: every prime-order element acts nontrivially on a fixed coordinate in its corresponding factor, and powers exclude all other stabilizers. For every F torsor Q over every extension field, including finite fields, B_Q is a torsor under a quasi-trivial torus and has a point by Hilbert90. Its dimension is sum_H [F:H][E_H:k], without a minimality claim. The action is affine monomial with permutation linear part and is an invariant torus open in the induced linear representation. Cyclic C_m has the smaller base Res_(k(zeta_m)/k)Gm. No roots of unity in k are required, and the fieldwise trivializations are not natural choices. This generalizes the special free S3 base used in UAQUARTSELF1 without claiming publication priority for induced-character geometry.

entries.title: Fixed torus-quotient isogeny self-covers have an exact twisted-H1 universality criterion
entries.scope: Let S be split with linear F action and phi an F-equivariant self-isogeny of degree D, in characteristic not dividing D|F|. With UAFREEBASE1 base B, X=(B times S)/F has a finite etale degree-D self-map induced by identity on B and phi on S; the free group scheme ker(phi) semidirect F makes its target the same X. This fixed group torsor is field-versal exactly when phi_Q is injective on H1(K,S_Q) for every extension K and F torsor Q. Kummer cohomology identifies the possible affine twist classes with that kernel. It is killed by D via the adjugate isogeny and by |F| via restriction/corestriction, so coprimality suffices; a sharper uniform H1 annihilator may replace |F|. UAINFRASELF1 and UAFINATOM1 give strong absolute stable atomicity exactly for an elementary abelian kernel with irreducible holonomy action. UAKANLIFT1 supplies a one-dimensional canonical volume lift preserving degree, complete fibres and monodromy. For nontrivial degree D>1 nonconstant invariant units exclude affine space and persist under lifting; if F is trivial use coordinates of S rather than an empty base B. Constant-group formulations require kernel splitting; otherwise use the actual finite etale group scheme. Universality concerns its specified torsors and associated algebras, not all algebras of degree D or a canonical choice of points.

entries.title: The all-group norm-torus self-cover is field-versal exactly at coprime power and permutation degree
entries.scope: Let F act transitively on r>=2 letters, S the rank-r-minus-one product-one torus and phi=[n], n>=2. Over a base of characteristic not dividing n|F| and containing mu_n for the constant-group version, the fixed ker(phi) semidirect F torsor supplied by UAISOCRIT1 and UAFREEBASE1 is field-versal if and only if gcd(n,r)=1. The twisted norm torus has H1=K*/Norm(R*) of exponent dividing r. Necessity uses the Sylow stabilizer observation from UASYLOWDEF1: for ell dividing n and r, a Sylow ell subgroup has no fixed letter, so its orbit degrees have common ell-power divisor d>1. A generic Sylow torsor and the t-adic norm valuation make [t] have exact order d; [t^(d/ell)] gives nonzero n-torsion, and Kummer lifting obstructs a specified semidirect torsor over an extension of every base. This extends UAS3VERS1 to every transitive group without assuming a cyclic derangement or applying a Sylow-versality converse. For F=S_r and n=p prime not dividing r the augmentation F_p module is irreducible, giving strong absolute stable atoms of degree p^(r-1). In particular all binary even exponents occur in characteristic zero. These are specified group torsors, not arbitrary rank-p^(r-1) algebras.

entries.title: Signed permutation tori give strong atomic fixed self-covers in every odd prime-power degree
entries.scope: Take F=(C2)^e semidirect S_e acting by inversions and permutations on S=Gm^e, e>=1. Every twisted torus is a restriction of scalars of a quadratic norm-one torus, so H1 has exponent at most2. UAISOCRIT1 therefore makes [n] field-versal for the specified S[n] semidirect F torsors exactly for odd n: an even n is obstructed by one quadratic norm class over k(s,t). For n=p odd prime, coordinate sign projections and permutations prove irreducibility of F_p^e, and the faithful affine monodromy is F_p^e semidirect ((C2)^e semidirect S_e). Thus every odd prime-power degree p^e occurs as a fixed strongly absolutely stably atomic finite self-cover, in characteristic not dividing p|F| with mu_p for the constant-group version, or with the genuine group scheme otherwise. UAKANLIFT1 adds a canonical volume dimension without changing fibres or atomicity. UANORMGEN1 separately gives all binary even exponents. Dimensions are not claimed minimal, and none of this supplies full symmetric universality, whole affine-space sources or canonical point selection.

entries.title: Cyclotomic irreducibles and principal primes give exact stable atomicity and geometry tests, with a degree-eight example
entries.scope: For m>=2 let O=Z[zeta_m], S have cocharacter lattice O with C_m multiplication action, B=Res_(k(zeta_m)/k)Gm with free C_m translation, and X_m=(B times S)/C_m. Replacing O by an ideal I gives a quotient geometry geometrically affine-stably isomorphic to X_O iff I is principal; a nonprincipal prime gives a different source/target pair in this architecture. entries.title: Published scheme-versality and Sylow boundaries constrain canonical promotion of field-versal covers
entries.scope: First-Florence-Rosengarten arXiv2401.04458v2 Theorem1.1 and Theorems6.3-6.4 imply that in characteristic zero no fixed torsor for a nontrivial finite group over a quasi-compact scheme realizes all torsors on all smooth affine bases. A rank-N finite etale cover is subject to the same obstruction via its S_N frame torsor. For a quasi-projective receiver of dimension d a missed smooth affine base has dimension at most (N-1)(d+1)+2, using the faithful standard representation. This is a published theorem applied here, not claimed new. For any torsor, base change along a map with section preserves its exact image in H1 on every test scheme; thus UAKANLIFT1 and identity stabilization preserve scheme realizations rather than repair the obstruction. A section BG->Y of a scheme-valued classifying map is independently impossible by inertia; fieldwise existence does not select points naturally. entries.scope: Let P_star(T,z)=T*(T-1)*z^3+(1-2T)*z^2+4*z/3. For every complex plane Keller pair (f,g), P_star(f,Z)+g is irreducible over L=C(s,t), in every source degree.
