entries.title: Sufficient1140-moment pure exclusion for every transverse line-conic cubic
entries.scope: Every ternary cubic with a LINE TRANSVERSE TO A SMOOTH CONIC as leading curve has a nonzero positive pure Gaussian moment by1140. Normalize a!=0,d=0. Its phase coefficients C,A,F at u^2*v^2,u^3,v^2 are nonzero, including c=0 when the other node is nonisotropic. Principal divisor A0=C*A*F and basis1,u,v,u^2,uv,v^2 give depth4,connection bound54,rank6 and prefix54*6*7/2+6=1140. Over C in characteristic zero, arbitrary lower terms and the full nondegenerate affine Gaussian metric/means are retained. An isotropic ordinary node with F2=0 is already pure-excluded by the888 conic gate. Otherwise normalize P=alpha*T^2+T*(uv+h)+a*u^3+d*v^3+b*u^2+c*v^2+eu+fv+k; keep D=m-2alpha*t nonzero. Exact T completion and a volume-one rational translation give phase V/delta,delta=t^2*D,deg_t V<=4,deg_t delta<=3, with no mixed cubic terms and prefactor D^(-1/2). Generic nonzero quadratic values of tP-Q at every leading node give length1 infinity points; projective Bezout and retained coercive/tame comparison yield full ranks7/6/5, including alpha!=0 and D(0)=0. Four divergence-form twisted image operators, including the required -delta*C*v divergence term, give fixed principal projections and full bases by spanning plus this rank count. A degree<=12 phase-coefficient product clears each projection, with strictly smaller ordinary-degree corrections. The normalized connection-source numerator has degree<=6; matrix denominator/numerator bounds and minimal-seed cofactors give the stated prefix. Nonzero zeroth coefficients rely on the retained complete analytic class exclusions, not an ordinary critical Groebner basis. Exact checks verify92 universal principal/divergence identities and all36 columns of six rational Gaussian-normal-form model connections. Uniform rank/normal-form cover, analytic seed assertions and the all-order proof remain written mathematics without independent specialist replay, external review or formal verification. The bounds are sufficient, not optimal. entries.title: Sufficient995-moment pure exclusion for every independent-triangle cubic
entries.scope: Every ternary cubic with THREE LINEARLY INDEPENDENT leading factors has a nonzero positive pure Gaussian moment by995. Its normalized phase coefficients C,E,F at u^2*v^2,u^2,v^2 are nonzero. Principal divisor A0=C*E*F and basis1,u,v,uv,v^2 give depth5,connection bound66,rank5 and prefix66*5*6/2+5=995. Over C in characteristic zero, arbitrary lower terms and the full nondegenerate affine Gaussian metric/means are retained. An isotropic ordinary node with F2=0 is already pure-excluded by the888 conic gate. Otherwise normalize P=alpha*T^2+T*(uv+h)+a*u^3+d*v^3+b*u^2+c*v^2+eu+fv+k; keep D=m-2alpha*t nonzero. Exact T completion and a volume-one rational translation give phase V/delta,delta=t^2*D,deg_t V<=4,deg_t delta<=3, with no mixed cubic terms and prefactor D^(-1/2). Generic nonzero quadratic values of tP-Q at every leading node give length1 infinity points; projective Bezout and retained coercive/tame comparison yield full ranks7/6/5, including alpha!=0 and D(0)=0. Four divergence-form twisted image operators, including the required -delta*C*v divergence term, give fixed principal projections and full bases by spanning plus this rank count. A degree<=12 phase-coefficient product clears each projection, with strictly smaller ordinary-degree corrections. The normalized connection-source numerator has degree<=6; matrix denominator/numerator bounds and minimal-seed cofactors give the stated prefix. Nonzero zeroth coefficients rely on the retained complete analytic class exclusions, not an ordinary critical Groebner basis. Exact checks verify92 universal principal/divergence identities and all36 columns of six rational Gaussian-normal-form model connections. Uniform rank/normal-form cover, analytic seed assertions and the all-order proof remain written mathematics without independent specialist replay, external review or formal verification. The bounds are sufficient, not optimal. entries.title: Global norm-target three-form extension and exact geometric genus3 for the Klein cofactor double cover
entries.scope: For the norm field E of KMFI90, KMFI91 infinity/ordinary-fiber extension is completed over both finite branch fibers0,beta. On q=1, order the cofactor roots through u=s*z,v=s*(s-z),w=-z*(s-z); their cone has this finite double cover, with h=(s*z*(s-z))^2 and r=c-(s^2-s*z+z^2). The normal complete intersection y_i^2=f(u_i)-b maps finitely to E, and the pulled form is a polynomial B=(2z-s)*(2s-z)*(s+z) times its residue generator. The root-cover origin is resolved by a crepant ordinary(2,2) blowup with smooth del Pezzo exceptional surface. Nonzero zero-root axes are smooth/cA by implicit elimination. All nonzero-root configurations with one, two or three participating critical roots are exhausted: smooth or cA cases, a multiset reciprocal-root average excluding an identically singular Morse section, and uniform e2/e3 triple-critical complete intersections with weights(1,1,1,1,1)/(2,2) or(2,2,3,3,3)/(6,6). Both are crepant; every exceptional index-cover point is smooth/A1, with index3 scalar-volume charts handled by finite pole descent. This includes repeated cofactor roots and all three order3 critical points without a special tail-origin restriction. The remaining q=0 projective charts are compound A, an explicit A3 section at q=h=0,b=0, or smooth. Thus the full dualizing sheaf extends at finite b. Of its ten cubic-numerator sections, infinity permits exactly q^3,q^2*r,q*r^2, with exceptional orders2,1,0. A smooth projective model of E therefore has geometric genus exactly3. E is not unirational or stably rational, even after independent stabilization. This is a theorem about this explicit target field, not an absolute exclusion of every exceptional PSL2(11) map. The proof is a written all-configuration resolution with exact finite cover/residue/weighted-chart controls and retained primary cDV input, without formal or independent whole-proof verification.

entries.title: No dominant rational-target degree11 marked descent of the rational cofactor PSL2(11) model
entries.scope: For every normalized Klein polynomial f in either exceptional degree11 PSL2(11) action, the KMFI80 rational-source relative model a^12=f-prime(t)*(1+r*t^2+q*(t^3-c*t^2)), f(t)=b, has no dominant field base change K-prime containing k(b,q,r), rational over the algebraically closed characteristic-zero coefficient field, that selects an eleven-sheet marked component with the full PSL2(11) root action. KMFI90 forces every such K-prime to contain the same norm double-cover field E. KMFI92 proves that E has geometric genus3 and is not unirational. A subfield of a rational function field would be unirational, a contradiction. All complementary color subgroups, arbitrary additional independent target variables and birational coordinate models within this dominant descent are covered. This is an intrinsic target-field obstruction, stronger than the nonconstant unit on the literal original component; it does not assume rationality alone supplies an affine source. Non-dominant specialization, forgetting the marking, genuinely different field architectures, absolute exceptional11 occurrence and the full action spectrum remain unresolved. Written field implication with exact scope controls, no formal or independent whole-proof review.

entries.title: All-degree grouped boundary-value budget, unbounded smooth affine complementary models and primitive monomial finite-map gate
entries.scope: Retain the actual plane Keller finite normalization and every omitted prime. In the PF2RULED50 complementary index-two/unramified sector, group all unramified primes D_i by their finite value lambda_i of the shared intrinsic source coordinate x. Distinct-value primitive dual cross terms are zero. With n_R=-checkR^2, q=-v_R(x), p_i the complementary pole and D_lambda the full within-value primitive block, define A_lambda=-diag(p_i)^(-1)*D_lambda*diag(p_i)^(-1) and E_lambda=1^t*A_lambda^(-1)*1. The full negative-definite matrix forces n_R/q^2>sum_lambda E_lambda, and Cauchy-Schwarz gives E_lambda>=max_i(p_i^2/n_i)>=1. Thus all D_i have ONE coordinate value except R order2,pole1, where at most TWO values occur. This is all-degree, at all D orders and poles, retaining other ramified primes; no common-ruling bound is asserted. If all D_i have simple zero, R order>=3 forces their pole2, one value and n<(r^2-r+1)/(r^2-3r+1): at most6 for r3,2 for r4,1 for r>=5. In the R r2q1 simple-pole2 sector a group of m primes has -D=2(I+J) and energy2m/(m+1). Two groups require sum2m/(m+1)<3: one singleton, or one size2 and the other<=4. There is no unconditional component-count bound from these hypotheses. Actual smooth affine marked controls exist for EVERY n>=1: choose distinct nonzero C,d_i, let h=x^2*y,H=product(h-d_i),T=hH, and B_n=C[h,a=x(h-C),b=yH,z=xyH]. The entire presentation ab=(h-C)z,az=(h-C)T,z^2=Tb is covered by two smooth integral hypersurface charts, h-C invertible giving x^2*b=T, and T invertible giving az=(h-C)T. The source A2 is an open embedding with exact complement one R and n D_i affine lines. R has r2q1 and volume order1, D_i simple zero,pole2,volume order0. The complete C* weight modules are C[h]a^k for k>=0, C[h]b^l for weight-2l and C[h]zb^l for weight-(2l+1). The global regular primitive theta=-2y dx-x dy has dtheta=dx wedge dy. The full primitive matrix has determinant det(-M)=2^n(n+3)>0 and negative definiteness for every n. Euler characteristic n+2 would require actual finite Keller degree n+3 if its sole ramified prime has zero excess; no finite Keller map is supplied. The resonance C=d_i is excluded by a complete source hyperbola. A genuine finite-map lemma proves that any globally regular primitive source monomial x^a*y^b with a,b>0 coprime and EVERY omitted prime vertical at finite monomial values is a primitive element of C(x,y)/C(P,Q). The generic fibre is C*, whose finite etale image normalization is C* by Riemann-Hurwitz; a higher residue degree would produce a weighted root-of-unity deck action fixing the source origin and contradicting the invertible Keller differential. The full norm chi(U)=Norm(U-h) is therefore monic of FULL Keller degree. On B_n it necessarily has chi(0)=H_x^2*H_y, chi(d_i)=J_i*H_i^2 and chi(C)=G_R*J_C^f with f1 or2. Coincident global image supports are allowed; no normal monogenic algebra or linear target pencil is inferred. A tempting two-chart compact-curve exclusion for r>=4 fails because its rational parameterization has r-2 additional infinity ends; these are explicit negative controls. 180 exact controls support the written universal proofs, including actual shared-centre blowup matrices, global presentations and localized smooth charts, volume and source inverses. Imported Xie and Riemann-Hurwitz theorems are not independently reproved. Formal verification, independent full reproof, external review, novelty priority, full quartic/higher-degree exclusion and goal completion are not claimed.

entries.title: Holonomy-twisted self-isogenies have an exact H1 criterion and compatible free bases
entries.scope: UAISOCRIT1 extends from commuting isogenies to phi rho(g)=rho(alpha(g)) phi for any alpha in Aut(F), in characteristic not dividing D|F|. From the UAFREEBASE1 free field-versal base B0, the product of alpha^j relabelled copies and cyclic shift supplies an automorphism b with b g=alpha(g) b. Then (b,phi) gives a degree-D finite etale self-map on the same quotient X=(B times S)/F. Its specified ker(phi) semidirect F torsor is field-versal exactly when phi_Q:H1(K,S_Q)->H1(K,S_(alpha Q)) has zero kernel for every extension field and every F torsor Q. The source twist classes are exactly that kernel, killed by D via a reverse-twisted adjugate and by |F| via restriction/corestriction; coprimality suffices. For C_m the full etale cyclotomic algebra k[z]/Phi_m, with restriction-of-scalars translation base, carries every automorphism z->z^u. The smallest cyclotomic field or a one-coordinate split base may not carry that automorphism and cannot be substituted silently. Constants, actual finite etale kernel group schemes, specified-group universality and the absence of canonical point choices retain their earlier distinctions.

entries.title: Semilinear ideal-class equations bypass the fixed-lattice principal-prime obstruction at prime conductor
entries.scope: Let O=Z[zeta_m], I an ideal lattice and sigma_u a cyclotomic automorphism. An integral intertwiner a sigma_u with image P I exists exactly when [P]=(sigma_u-1)[I] in Cl(O); its cokernel is I/P I. This changes the fixed I=O principal-prime gate of UACYCIDEAL1 without invalidating it. If m=ell is an odd prime and sigma generates the full Galois group, the ordinary ambiguous class formula including infinite ramification gives invariant class number 2(ell-1)/((ell-1)*2)=1, so sigma-1 is bijective on the finite class group. Every prime P above p different from ell therefore admits such an ideal lattice and semilinear self-isogeny, regardless of principality or class number. UAISOTWIST1 makes the quotient a genuine fixed self-cover of degree p^ord_ell(p), strongly absolutely stably atomic and field-versal by coprimality. For ell23, tau the quadratic-residue period, P=(2,tau), I=P and a=(2+tau)/2 give a sigma5(P)=P^2. An exact22-dimensional matrix has determinant -2048, eleven unit and eleven two Smith factors and irreducible degree11 residue. P is nonprincipal by the order-three quadratic-prime norm argument, without a class-number table. This supplies a uniform degree2048 self-map over Z[1/46] in dimension44, and a volume version in45, with F2^11 semidirect C23 monodromy. No claim that every conductor has a solvable class equation or every prescribed affine group is realized is made.

entries.title: Punctured canonical covolumes preserve torus-quotient volume geometry with an exact marked determinant boundary
entries.scope: Restrict UAKANLIFT1 to nonzero canonical covolumes. The resulting etale map K_X^times->K_Y^times remains a base change, preserves the canonical volume, degree and geometric monodromy, and is finite for finite f. For X=T/F a smooth geometric torus quotient, K_X^times=(T times Gm)/F with fibre multiplier det(rho(g))^-1, so this adds one dimension inside smooth affine torus-quotient geometry. UAFINATOM1 preserves strong absolute stable atomicity by unchanged primitive monodromy. Every field-valued target point has a nonzero covolume, so fixed torsor realization images on fields are unchanged and field versality persists. For general test schemes the projection need not have a section and its image can shrink; it never improves, consistently with UAVERSLIMIT1. Under the canonical lifted group action, a nonzero covolume above a fixed target is fixed exactly when its tangent determinant character is trivial. The whole-line zero-section lift has no such restriction. This is the exact boundary of that functor, not an exclusion of every possible alternative action on an enlarged space.

entries.title: The strongly atomic finite self-cover degrees of affine geometric torus quotients are exactly the prime powers
entries.scope: Over every characteristic-zero field k and for N>1, a smooth geometrically integral affine geometric torus quotient has a strongly absolutely stably atomic finite etale degree-N self-map for some source if and only if N is a prime power. UAINFRASELF1 and UAFINATOM1 give necessity from primitive affine monodromy. Every prime power can moreover have a global volume form and a fixed field-versal specified finite etale group torsor. For N=p^e with e>=2, Bang-Zsigmondy supplies an odd prime ell with ord_ell(p)=e except the two classical cases; UACYCSEMI1 solves its prime-ideal class equation and UAISOTWIST1 makes the resulting semilinear map a self-cover on the same quotient. The exceptions use Gaussian C4 multiplication by a Mersenne prime p at e2, and ninth-cyclotomic C9 multiplication by2 for (p,e)=(2,6). Prime degree uses the power map on Gm. UAPUNCTVOL1 keeps the volume map in torus-quotient geometry, explicitly (f,w/N) on X times Gm in these models. A source dimension at most max(2,2N-3) suffices, without optimality claimed. Each construction has a uniform integral model over Z[1/(p m)] and good positive-characteristic fibres; the necessary degree classification is asserted in characteristic zero. Binary kernels are constant over every permitted field; odd-p constant-group statements assume mu_p, otherwise retaining the actual group scheme. Thus every formerly missing odd binary exponent is attained. This does not prescribe every primitive affine group, realize all rank-N etale algebras, alter the symmetric self-universality ceiling4, or solve canonical whole-affine descent. Nonconstant units persist and all-natural point/scheme-family obstructions remain.

entries.title: Complete odd ternary cubic pure-null normal form and sharp mixed cutoff deg Q
entries.scope: For every odd complex ternary polynomial P of degree<=3, all positive pure Gaussian moments vanish iff some complex orthogonal circular frame gives P=Z*(a*Z^2+b*Z*T+c*T^2+d*Z*W+e), with E(ZW)=E(T^2)=1. Equivalently P=(ell.x)*(x^t*A*x+s) with ell isotropic and A*ell proportional to ell, allowing P=0. The same null line divides both homogeneous parts. The pure-null locus is irreducible of dimension6 in the13-dimensional odd coefficient space. Positive circular weight proves E(QP^m)=0 for m>deg Q; coefficient1 is sharp even for genuine cubics via P=Z*T^2,Q=W^D and value D!*(2D-1)!!. This sharpens the general mixed3*deg-Q bound only on the odd subclass. Internal written proof depending on retained analytic classifications, with exact auxiliary harmonic/tensor/Jacobian/Wick checks only. No independent specialist replay, external review or formal verification. Programme archived separately from mathematical state.

entries.title: Normal-affine atomicity of an etale map of nontrivial degree is exactly finite primitive monodromy
entries.scope: For separated dominant etale maps of generic degree M>1 between geometrically integral geometrically normal affine varieties, absolute stable atomicity through arbitrary normal affine intermediate varieties and dominant regular factors is equivalent to finiteness and primitive geometric monodromy. Zariski Main gives a nonfinite map the nontrivial factorization through its affine finite normalization: a non-isomorphic birational open immersion followed by degree M. The completion need not be etale or smooth, so this is explicitly the regular-factor category. UAFINATOM1 handles both finite directions. Combining UAINFRASELF1 and UAPPDEGREE1, allowing arbitrary affine identity cylinders and omitting finiteness at the outset does not enlarge the prime-power existence spectrum in the normal-affine-atomic torus-quotient category. Self-map atomicity of nonfinite maps is a different condition; degree1 and categories requiring both factors etale are not classified here.
dependencies: external: finite normalization of varieties and Zariski Main open immersion

entries.title: Primitive self-map atomicity with constant units and torsion canonical bundle needs no acyclicity
entries.scope: A birational etale endomorphism of any normal finite-type variety is an automorphism in every characteristic: Zariski Main gives a self-open-immersion and Ax injective-endomorphism surjectivity makes it onto. For smooth geometrically integral varieties with geometrically constant units and geometrically torsion canonical bundle, every etale endomorphism of primitive geometric monodromy is therefore absolutely stably atomic among regular self-maps of the same variety, in every characteristic. A trivialized pluricanonical power and the determinant product force arbitrary regular factors etale; primitivity gives a birational factor and the classical self-map lemma makes it an automorphism. Affine identity stabilization preserves the hypotheses. This removes acyclicity from the sufficient self-map criterion UAACYCLICATOM1 while retaining its applications. It does not assert a converse, remove the unit/canonical hypotheses, or make birational maps between different varieties isomorphisms.
dependencies: external: Ax1969 injective endomorphism theorem and Zariski Main
external: primitive monodromy, determinant chain rule and geometric base change

entries.title: Atomic nonfinite endomorphisms of every torus-quotient cylinder have base degree one
entries.scope: In characteristic zero let Z be a smooth geometrically integral affine geometric torus quotient and X=Z times A^r. UA1RIGIDCYL1 and UATORUSDOM1 write every etale self-map as (b times id) composed with H=(z,g(z,v)), with b finite etale, degrees D,h and M=D h. UASELFATOM1 classical birational self-map rigidity and UAFINATOM1 give h1 exactly when H is an automorphism exactly when the total map is finite. Any nontrivial self-atomic map must therefore have h1 or D1: spending degree in both directions is an explicit nontrivial self-factorization. Every nonfinite self-atom has base automorphism, without a restriction on Aut(Z). Conversely a base-automorphism map with primitive geometric monodromy on its generic vertical Keller fibre over an algebraic closure of k(Z) is absolutely stably self-atomic. All regular factors have base automorphisms, fibrewise determinant products make them etale, and relative primitivity plus the self-map lemma gives an automorphism factor. This supplies a sufficient criterion, not necessity or atomicity from one special fibre. The finite branch need not be self-atomic merely from its degree; no self-atomic prime-power classification is asserted.

entries.title: Nonfinite atomic canonical cylinder data restrict to genuine affine fibres on every torus quotient
entries.scope: For characteristic-zero nonfinite self-atomic etale endomorphisms of Z times A^r with Z any smooth affine geometric torus quotient, compatible finite-group source/target actions, fixed target and complete transitive rank-N fibre, UACYLDICH1 makes the base map an automorphism. All marked points lie over its unique inverse of the target base point, and equivariance makes both base points fixed. The restriction is an ordinary polynomial canonical Keller datum A^r to A^r with the exact same complete marked fibre. This removes the metabelian Aut(Z) hypothesis of UAVERTRED1 under atomicity. UAFIXDEFECT1 bounds its generic degree h0 by ambient M; UASYLOWDEF1 gives M>=h0>=N+2+indicator(2 divides N), and UANONLINEARCOST1 makes the affine coordinate count r itself pay the natural S_N dimension bound. UAINFRASELF1 already excludes the finite natural S_N branch for N>=5. In reduced finite-type characteristic-zero families etale-locally trivial with fibre Z times A^r and fibrewise nonfinite atomic maps, the intrinsic base map is an isomorphism and restriction to the uniquely determined base sections glues and commutes with base change. It yields a pair of affine-space forms, not chosen coordinates or an identified fixed affine self-map. Global atomicity is not asserted to descend to each special affine fibre, and original whole-affine canonical landing remains open.

entries.title: Every degree at least three has infinitely many nonfinite atomic volume maps on one fixed fourfold
entries.scope: In characteristic zero normalize any primitive-geometric-monodromy polynomial Keller seed f:A^r to A^r of degree M>1 by f(0)=0 and Df(0)=id. The standard dilation f_a=v+sum_(j>=2) a^(j-1) f_j(v) is polynomial with determinant1, conjugate to f for a nonzero and identity for a zero. On the fixed Gm times A^r choose a_m(t)=product_(j=1,...,m)(t-j). UACYLDICH1 gives absolute stable self-atomicity of F_m=(t,f_(a_m(t))) and its preserved volume is dlog(t) wedge dv. Its generic degree is M but the vertical degree drops to1 at exactly m base points, so it is nonfinite and UANORMAFF1 excludes normal-affine atomicity. UA1RIGIDCYL1 forces every source/target automorphism after identity stabilization to project to Gm, making m invariant under arbitrary polynomial left-right equivalence. Thus infinitely many pairwise stably inequivalent nonconstant atomic families occur at fixed degree and source, for every such seed. UAM1 supplies the retained concrete cubic control. The standard deformation is not claimed new; the generic atomicity and intrinsic-base invariant are the deductions. It supplies no new natural S_N action, arbitrary smaller marked rank, affine-space source or publication-priority certificate. Moreover UAALLATOM1 and UAQTILT1 give constant-profile primitive three-variable seeds over Q in every generic degree N>=3, with no extra promoted coordinates. The SAME fixed fourfold Gm times A3 therefore has infinitely many such nonfinite atomic volume-preserving maps in every N>=3. Its exact nonfinite etale degree spectrum is {3,4,5,...}: degree1 is the classical self-map lemma, and degree2 is either a finite base cover or would give a quadratic vertical Keller map, excluded by UAACYCLICGAL1. Finite self-atoms and finite normal-affine atoms on this particular fourfold instead have exactly prime degree, since every finite map reduces to a power map of Gm. A vertical scaling supplies a finite volume prime-degree model, so absolute stable self-atoms with preserved volume exist in every degree N>=2 on this fixed fourfold. Neither the nonfinite nor finite existence statements assert field universality or canonical symmetry.

entries.title: Coprime source leading coefficients force constant cross-resultants and exclude three factors or two equal factors in every degree and dimension
entries.scope: Let n>=2, K=(f_1,...,f_n) any complex Keller map, B=C[x_1,...,x_n], L=Frac(B), F=C(f_1,...,f_n), and P(T,z)=sum b_i(T)z^i of degree m>=2 with nonzero leading a=b_m. The primitive polynomial S=P(f_1,z)+f_2 defines a smooth hypersurface: its source differential is the nonzero row (P_T,1,0,...,0) times J(K). Its primitive factors F_i in B[z] have disjoint finite zero loci. If their leading coefficients l_i are pairwise coprime, Res_z(F_i,F_j) are nonzero complex constants; a resultant prime with at least one leading coefficient nonzero would give a forbidden finite common root. The target condition gcd(a,a_prime,b_(m-1))=1 guarantees this coprimality for every factorization: square-free pullback prevents two leading factors at a simple a zero, and at a multiple zero two such factors would force the next coefficient to vanish. Normalize Q=a^(m-1)(P(T,U/a)+V), Q_i=a(f_1)^d_i F_i(U/a(f_1))/l_i. Their cross-resultants equal lambda_ij*a(f_1)^(d_i*d_j)/(l_i^d_j*l_j^d_i). At V=infinity every distinct normalized-root difference has valuation -1/m, proved by direct formal recursion after V=tau^(-m),U=tau^(-1)X. Thus ell_i/d_i+ell_j/d_j=1/m for every pair, where ell_i=v(l_i), while sum ell_i=0. Three or more factors force every ratio to be 1/(2m), contradicting the sum; two equal-degree factors give the same contradiction. This excludes all three-factor decompositions and equal two-factor decompositions whenever source leading coefficients are pairwise coprime, in every n and all degrees. In particular under the triple gcd a reducible source polynomial has exactly two irreducible factors of unequal positive degrees. Without that gcd, those excluded patterns require a common source leading prime over a joint multiple zero of a,a_prime,b_(m-1). Two unequal factors are not asserted impossible; no arbitrary-degree full irreducibility or full splitting-group preservation is inferred. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: All square-free-leading quartics close, and the arbitrary-degree plane residual is exactly two unequal factors of degrees at least two
entries.scope: For a complex plane Keller pair K=(f,g) and P(T,z)=sum b_i(T)z^i of degree m>=3, assume gcd(a,a_prime,b_(m-1))=1, a=b_m nonzero. HC4MYIE0 excludes rational source roots, while HC4MYIF0 excludes three or more factors and two equal factors. Hence any reducible P(f,Z)+g has exactly two irreducible factors of degrees 2<=d<e with d+e=m. This is an all-degree factor-pattern obstruction, without a source-degree, parameter-degree or leading-multiplicity bound. In particular every quartic under gcd(a,a_prime,b_3)=1 stays irreducible, since a proper factorization would contain a linear factor or split 2+2. It closes every square-free-leading quartic of arbitrary parameter degree and every quartic with gcd(a,b_3)=1, allowing arbitrary leading multiplicities. No nilpotent-group, critical-discriminant or special-fibre hypothesis is imposed. For every closed stable embedding A^(r+2) into A^(r+3), r>=1, carrying that plane pair through (T,xy-P) in this quartic class, root transitivity and the retained HC4MYHZ2 global filtered proof force K invertible, with all embedding degrees unrestricted. The quartic full irreducibility conclusion uses the plane-only rational-root theorem; it is not asserted for all-dimensional Keller maps. entries.title: Two unequal factors produce a resultant power, an exact Keller field-degree divisor and an explicit nonnormal integral monogenic order
entries.scope: In the n>=2 setting of HC4MYIF0, suppose P(f_1,z)+f_2 has primitive factors of degrees d<e with coprime leading coefficients p,D, so a(f_1)=pD and m=d+e. Let r=e-d and alpha=e(d-1). Their monic normalized factors Q_d,Q_e satisfy R=Res_U(Q_d,Q_e)=lambda*a(f_1)^alpha*D^r for lambda in C nonzero. R and the normalized coefficients are integral over the target A=C[f_1,...,f_n], being symmetric polynomials in integral roots of monic Q. At every extension of the target V=f_2 infinity valuation, v(p)=de/[m(e-d)] and v(D)=-de/[m(e-d)]. Consequently m(e-d)/gcd(de,m(e-d)) divides [L:F], by the integer valuation of Norm_(L/F)(D); all target conjugates have the same infinity value. For d=2,e=3 this requires a Keller degree divisible by five. With N=ceil(alpha/r), zeta=a(f_1)^N D is an explicit source polynomial integral over A, since zeta^r=lambda^(-1)*a(f_1)^(Nr-alpha)*R is integral. It is not in F: the retained visible-divisor pullbacks imply B intersect F=A, so if D were target-rational both D and p would be target polynomials dividing a(f_1), hence in C[f_1], contradicting their nonzero infinity values. Therefore A[zeta] is a finite nontrivial monogenic order which must be nonnormal, by HC4MYHY0: otherwise its irreducible monic minimal polynomial would remain irreducible on source but already has the root zeta. The finite normalization embeds in B, but is not asserted globally monogenic. When d=1, the cross-resultant is the normalized derivative at the root and r=m-2, recovering the derivative-power form. The unequal-factor valuation equations are consistent and are not promoted to a contradiction. No existence of the remaining pattern, arbitrary-degree irreducibility, resolution of either plane endpoint or unrestricted HC4/JC2 is asserted.

entries.title: Complete unbounded A_k local-image classification for both exceptional PSL2(11) actions
entries.scope: For either exceptional11 PSL2(11) Keller action, if the whole reduced normal-closure branch germ is v^2-u^m=0 times a smooth factor, m>=2 (A_(m-1)), the local group is generated by genuine meridians a,b of orders2,3,5 satisfying the alternating Artin relation of lengthm. All184041 ordered pairs fall into295 simultaneous-conjugacy orbits, and every relation is periodic modulo660 because its period divides2*ord(ab). The retained full-period spectra therefore classify every A_k, with no bound onk, including each image subgroup and both common-fixed-sheet marks. At an ordinary cusp m3 there are exactly5049 pairs: C2:55,S3a:330,S3b:330 from inertia2; C3:110,A4:1320 from inertia3; C5:264,A5a:1320,A5b:1320 from inertia5. Thus ordinary cusp images are not automatically S3; C6,F55,G cannot occur there with allowed inertia. Actual fibers inject into common fixed sheets, with equality if no omitted unramified normalization divisors. The two opposite A5 cusp classes, as well as S3, distinguish the actions. The statement is a necessary constraint on actual maps and a complete classification of local group representations, not a global affine realization or an absolute action exclusion. Written local braid/inverse-section proof with pinned Oka input and exact exhaustive finite census; no formal or independent whole-proof review.

entries.scope: Among the allowed-meridian representations in KMFI98, full PSL2(11) image exists iff oddm is divisible by5 or11, or evenm is divisible by4,6,10 or22. Without inertia5 the exact criteria are11|m for oddm, and10|m or12|m or22|m for evenm. A tacnode A3 (m4) is already sufficient at the local representation level:2640 ordered pairs, all with meridian orders5,5 and product order2, generate all660 elements. Without inertia5 the first full-image type is A9 (m10), with3,3,5, and the first irreducible one is A10 (m11), with3,3,11. Completeness follows from all295 pair orbits and the full660-residue period, not a bounded singularity search. Such full local images force the target point outside either exceptional Keller image, since their common fixed-sheet marks vanish. Codimension2 omission is allowed, so these exact local representations neither realize a Keller map nor exclude the global action. No claim is made that every local quotient extends to a global Keller normal closure. Written finite reduction and explicit matrix certificates, without formal or independent whole-proof review.

entries.scope: For a characteristic-zero differential coefficient curve, the rational differential operator division ring Q=Frac(F[a;h*delta]) embeds in bounded-above PDOs Psi=F((a^-1)). Thus any nonzero Adler period excludes rational mates with arbitrary operator denominators, and the universal finite spectral class [h] in D/[S,D] has zero K[u]-annihilator. For L=(G(a)+mu*v)/g_n, [a,v]=h/v, deg G=n>=2 and mu nonzero, every moment j<2n+1 vanishes and the first is -(2n+1)*(n^2-1)/(24*n^2)*(mu/g_n)^2*h^2. Consequently its global spectral class is nontorsion and cannot be killed by scalar spectral localization or a field extension of that scalar spectral field. Arbitrary moving coefficient denominators in v,u are not identified with that localization. For S=G(a) on K(x)[a;h*partial_x], the exact finite spectral annihilator is generated by the monic squarefree critical-value resultant Res_a(Gprime,u-G), including coincident and degenerate critical points; an affine G gives the unit ideal. Highest-order centralizer reduction and differentiation force T=x*H(a)+J(a), with Gprime*H=q(G). A rational mate x*Gprime(a)^-1 exists for every nonconstant G. Fixed rational mate equations descend across every finite algebraic coefficient cover: in a Galois closure the invariant division ring is the base ring, proved using the unique monic generator of the right denominator ideal; Reynolds average is a base-division bimodule retraction. This is a one-derivation fixed linear equation theorem, not nonlinear tuple or general module descent. A rational torus action gives another actual division-ring residue, the Laurent constant-term projection to invariants. It is an invariant-bimodule retraction; if S is central in that invariant algebra then [S,Q] meets it only in zero. In Weyl division rings every rational function of commuting Euler operators is obstructed, in every rank, under actual division automorphisms and identity stabilization. The harmonic oscillator is linearly canonical to an affine Euler operator, so it has no rational mate or rational polynomial reparametrized commutator, even though all its Adler periods vanish and a PDO mate exists. Finite coefficient covers cannot repair it in the one-variable setting by Reynolds descent. A mixed positive control S=v*a^2+h/(2*v)*a has primitive leading divisor and no finite differential mate, but [S,v^2*a/3]=h*S supplies a rational mate, preserving the finite/rational boundary. A rational mate is equivalently certified by finite A,B,C with SB=BC and SA-AC=h*B. All rational conjugates and Darboux transforms of the Adler-obstructed family remain obstructed, including rational multiplication gauges introducing negative-v coefficients. entries.title: Homogeneous smooth cubic graded seed pure exclusion: ternary56 and all-dimension mu*(mu-1)
entries.scope: For every complex homogeneous cubic P in N>=1 standard Gaussian variables whose projective hypersurface is smooth, some positive pure moment is nonzero by mu*(mu-1), mu=2^N. In three variables56 suffices, and the retained homogeneous14 witness bounds the homogeneous-smooth least prefix in[14,56]. Direct graded reduction gives seed coefficient exponents r satisfying r<=3j-d_i<=3r and r==3j-d_i mod2. Hence the constant row has valuation>=j and each nonconstant row valuation>=j+2-d_i. At actual seed rank s, the zeroth cofactor valuation is at least s*(s+1)/2+2*(s-1)-S; combined with its upper degree and the higher-derivative scalar valuations, its polynomial zeroth coefficient has degree<=s*(s-1). The no-constant-period input forces that coefficient nonzero, proving the finite gate. This is a homogeneous smooth class bound; irreducible nodal homogeneous cubics are not covered by56, and the all-homogeneous interval remains[14,1854]. Neither14-moment sufficiency, exact leastness nor global radical generation is claimed. The universal filtration/order proof is internal written mathematics using the retained analytic smooth-leading exclusion. Exact auxiliary evidence checks32 connection columns, all seed columns through8 in four models,12 direct P/P^2/P^3 reductions and128 ternary row subsets; it does not certify the analytic theorem or the universal proof by itself. Independent replay, external review and formal verification remain false. entries.title: An invariant finite fibre can be selected exactly by a whole-affine equivariant Keller filter
entries.scope: Over every characteristic-zero field let F:A^d to A^d be a finite-group-equivariant polynomial Keller map, y a fixed target, E its complete finite etale fibre, and E0 any invariant clopen subscheme defined over the field. Finite-set interpolation and Reynolds averaging lift its characteristic idempotent to an invariant polynomial P. Using the F1/UAM1 normalized cubic K, with the directly proved complete empty fibre at mu=(1/3,-1,2/3) and singleton fibre at0, the map (v,u)->(F(v),K(u)-(1-P(v))*mu) is equivariant, polynomial on the whole A^(d+3), has Jacobian1 and exact complete fibre E0 at(y,0). Its generic degree is3 deg(F), with actual factors of degrees3 and deg(F). Thus for deg(F)>1 it is explicitly non-atomic. Seed identities are proved universally over Z[1/6]; the general averaging assertion here is characteristic zero. No functorial input-wise interpolation choice is inferred; UACANFIB1 instead gives an explicit intrinsic trace selector.
dependencies: external: exact invariants for finite tame groups, Reynolds averaging and finite-fibre interpolation

entries.title: Every finite etale algebra has a canonical all-rank marked Keller self-map of one specified vector bundle
entries.scope: For every N>=2 over R_N=Z[1/(2N)!] and EVERY R_N-scheme B, including nonreduced bases, a rank-N finite etale algebra A canonically determines a polynomial etale SELF-MAP of V_A=A^3 plus O_B^3, rank3N+3, with Jacobian1 and complete marked fibre canonically Spec_B(A). Let L(X)=(3X^2-X)/2, C_A=Tr L(X), lambda_N(T)=-T product_(j=2,...,2N)(T-j)/(2N-1)!, K the normalized cubic, rho=(-1/4,0,0), mu=(1/3,-1,2/3). The formula is (P,u)->(K_A(P),K(u)-(1-lambda_N(C_A(X)))*mu), marked at(rho*1_A,0). UAFILTER1 and its exact split triple fibre retain exactly one p1 and N-1 p0 entries. The resulting natural S_N-set is identified with rank-one idempotents by (e,-3e/2,-1/4+27e/4;0). Unit, multiplication and trace commute with every input isomorphism and arbitrary base change, proving effective gluing and a section over BS_N into this specified polynomial vector-bundle receiver with full inertia. Whole geometric source fibres are affine spaces and source equals target. This forgets the primitive generator line excluded by UAINERT1 rather than descending the UARECV1 atlas. Its larger degree respects UAFIXDEFECT1; its varying bundle does not contradict UAVERSLIMIT1. No generator, basis, torsor point or naturally trivial bundle over every base is chosen. The map is explicitly decomposable and does not establish canonical atomic realization. A frame invariant under all input automorphisms is impossible even after adding trivial identity lines: the split S_N action on A^3 is faithful. This does not exclude noncanonical coordinates or the constructed bundle functor.
dependencies: external: finite etale splitting, trace/base change, restriction of scalars and descent of polynomial vector-bundle morphisms

entries.title: The canonical trace receiver simultaneously realizes every whole subgroup-fixed Keller restriction
entries.scope: For the split UACANFIB1 natural S_N model, in characteristic zero or characteristic p>2N, every subgroup H with s label orbits of sizes n_j has whole source and target fixed schemes A^(3s+3). The actual restriction is the same cubic-product/filter formula with C_H=sum n_j L(x_j); it has Jacobian1 and generic degree3^(s+1). Its complete marked fixed fibre has exactly r=|Omega^H| points, the singleton label orbits: trace weight one permits exactly one singleton orbit labelled p1 and all others p0. Thus all subgroup restrictions and their compatibility occur inside one whole-affine equivariant map, rather than only passing separate necessary tests. Any deranging H has an empty marked fixed fibre; transitive H gives an actual six-dimensional degree9 Keller restriction with empty fibre. UAFIXDEFECT1 and UASYLOWDEF1 remain valid necessary budgets and are respected at the large generic surplus. This closes simultaneous fixed-locus existence for this non-atomic canonical receiver, not atomicity, sharp dimensions or first-surplus attainment.

entries.title: Canonical all-rank affine fibre realization has explicit degree and volume costs and an exact decomposition boundary
entries.scope: The UACANFIB1 receiver has relative dimension3N+3, ordinary coordinate degree4N and geometric generic degree3^(N+1). UAKANLIFT1 applied to the whole relative canonical line gives the same-bundle self-map on V_A plus det(V_A)^*, rank3N+4, with canonical invariant preserved volume, the same complete marked fibre at zero covolume and the same degrees. The added split S_N line is sign and cancels the determinant of the three permutation copies; no punctured-line unit is introduced. UAFILTER1 gives two NONINVERTIBLE canonical equivariant self-factors over every permitted base, of degrees3 and3^N, so the map and its volume lift are non-atomic even equivariantly. That factorization survives constants, identity stabilization and polynomial left-right equivalence. Geometrically the maximum nonautomorphism factor length is exactly N+1: N separate cubic blocks and the translated cubic filter are absolutely stably atomic degree3 factors by UASELFATOM1, while degree multiplication bounds length. Ordered blocks need not descend for nonsplit A, but the two canonical factors always do. No full wreath monodromy, optimality, fixed-scheme all-family universality or atomic canonical receiver is claimed.

entries.title: Reduced rational pencils and one-exception pencils with the stated multiplicity and independence conditions generate relatively algebraically closed fields
dependencies: external: Petravchuk-Iena arXiv:math/0701588v1 Lemma 2(1), equivalence (a)--(c), rational noncomposition equals field closedness
external: retained Stacks 0C1B Riemann-Hurwitz for finite separable P1 maps
entries.scope: Let B=C[x_1,...,x_n], L=Frac(B), n>=1, and let q=N/M be nonconstant with coprime polynomial numerator and nonzero denominator. If every finite pencil member N-lambda*M is nonconstant and square-free, C(q) is relatively algebraically closed in L. A second sufficient test allows polynomial q=H with at most one exceptional finite value lambda_0: every other H-lambda is square-free, and the gcd of the irreducible factor multiplicities of H-lambda_0 is one. Critical points, singular reduced fibres and reducible fixed fibres are permitted. The proof explicitly imports Petravchuk-Iena Lemma 2(1), equivalence of rational noncomposition and field closedness. For q=R(h) with h=H_0/H_1 reduced and deg R=d>1, at most one projective point form ell_c(H_0,H_1) can be constant. Every ramified point of R over a finite value must have such a constant point form under the first test. If R has r distinct poles, retained projective Riemann-Hurwitz gives finite ramification d+r-2, at most d-1 at that one point. Hence r=1 and there is a totally ramified finite point; its pencil member is constant, contradiction. For polynomial H any rational composition can be changed to a polynomial one by moving the sole pole with constant point form to infinity. All critical values of that polynomial must be lambda_0; the derivative root count forces H-lambda_0 to be a perfect dth power, contradicting multiplicity gcd one. All degrees are unrestricted. The constant-member restriction is essential: 1/x^d has square-free nonzero finite members but constant zero member and is composite. These sufficient tests do not characterize all closed rational functions, assert all fixed fibres irreducible or resolve HC4/JC2. A third sufficient test admits rational q=N/M with algebraically independent N,M, all finite members except lambda_0 square-free, and multiplicity gcd one at N-lambda_0*M. Independence forbids every constant projective point form: otherwise H_0,H_1 and the two composed homogeneous forms would be polynomials in one element, making N,M dependent. In a nontrivial composition all finite ramification then lies over lambda_0; Riemann-Hurwitz forces precisely one preimage each of lambda_0 and infinity. The exceptional member is therefore a perfect dth power, contradicting its multiplicity gcd. Independence is essential: (s^3-6s+4)/s^3 is composite via a cubic Chebyshev polynomial, has just one nonreduced finite member 2(s-1)^2(s+2), and has dependent numerator and denominator.

entries.title: Keller pullback preserves full finite-cover monodromy from reduced-pencil rational parameters, extending the filtered class-action criterion beyond polynomial coordinates
entries.scope: Let K be a complex Keller map in any n>=2 and q a rational target parameter satisfying a HC4MYIG0 test. Square-free and coprime divisor pullbacks preserve reduced finite members, numerator-denominator coprimality and the exact gcd of exceptional-fibre multiplicities. Dominance preserves nonconstant members. Therefore C(q(K)) is relatively algebraically closed in the source field L. Every finite Galois extension E/C(q(K)) remains linearly disjoint from L and its full group is preserved: Gal(EL/L)=Gal(E/C(q(K))). Any finite separable parameter cover follows through its Galois closure. This does not assert preservation for arbitrary covers of the full multi-parameter target. Explicit parameters include (V+B(U))/A(U) for arbitrary nonzero polynomial A and polynomial B; Q(U)(V+B(U)) for arbitrary nonzero Q, even with repeated zeros, by the one-exception test; and (Q(U)V+C(U))/D(U) for square-free nonzero Q, nonzero D and gcd(Q,C,D)=1, by the reduced-pencil test. Thus parameters UV and U^2 V with critical points or a critical line are admitted. For plane carried closed stable hypersurface embeddings, retain every HC4MYHX1 filtration, geometric affine height-one fibre, normal geometric generic ring and torsion-free class-group hypothesis. Its finite class action may descend from a finite Galois cover of any such rational q, rather than only a nowhere-critical polynomial parameter. Source and target Galois images on that cover agree, making each source component class invariant, torsion-freeness makes it zero, and the retained global filtered pencil proves the Keller inverse. Pole fibres of q remain in the global target hypotheses; none are deleted. No all-fixed-fibre irreducibility, arbitrary affine-etale finiteness, polynomial-slice local nilpotence, endpoint resolution or unrestricted HC4/JC2 conclusion is asserted. Keller dominance also preserves the numerator-denominator algebraic independence required by the third test. In particular q=Q(U)(V+B(U))/D(U) is admitted for any coprime nonzero polynomials Q,D and polynomial B. Nonzero finite members are primitive linear polynomials in V; at zero the V+B factor has multiplicity one. Constant D uses the polynomial exception test, while nonconstant D gives independent numerator and denominator. Thus q=(V+B(U))/A(U) is regular after every Keller pullback for arbitrary nonzero rational A in C(U) and polynomial B.

entries.title: Rational scalings and rational affine input of fixed one-variable polynomials close all polynomial outputs, including every sparse a z^m+b z^(m-1)+d
entries.scope: Let R in C[z] be any nonconstant polynomial, A,c nonzero polynomials in C[T], and beta,B arbitrary polynomials. For P(T,z)=A(T)R(c(T)z+beta(T))+B(T), the equation P(f_1,Z)+f_2 stays irreducible under every complex Keller base change in any dimension n>=2, with its full target splitting group preserved. Divide by A(f_1), use q=(f_2+B(f_1))/A(f_1), and make the invertible source-field affine change Y=c(f_1)Z+beta(f_1). The irreducible equation R(Y)+q over C(q) keeps its full splitting group by HC4MYIG1. There is no restriction on that group, parameter degree, leading multiplicity, R degree, source degree or affine-substitution degree. A second family is P(T,z)=R(c(T)z+beta(T))/Q(T)+B(T) in C[T,z], with Q,c nonzero polynomials and beta,B polynomial; the displayed polynomiality is required. Multiply by Q(f_1) and use the regular polynomial parameter q=Q(f_1)(f_2+B(f_1)), certified by the one-exception multiplicity-gcd test. The same full irreducibility and group preservation follow. Every closed stable embedding A^(r+2) into A^(r+3), r>=1, carrying a plane Keller pair through (T,xy-P) in either family forces the pair invertible by HC4MYHZ2, with all embedding degrees unrestricted. New unbounded examples include T^(3k)(z^3+z)+B(T), k>=1, with S3 root group and admissible intermediate pole k, and T^k z^m+z^(m-1)+B(T), every k>=1,m>=2, from reciprocal scaling R(Y)=Y^m+Y^(m-1), c=T^k,Q=T^(k(m-1)). The former permits repeated leading zeros outside the triple gcd; the latter removes the unequal higher-factor residual for that sparse family. Arbitrary rational affine-isotrivial coefficient representations are not all asserted covered: the stated polynomial and parameter certificates are required. General coefficient variation not reducible to these families or another retained gate, other output geometries, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. No nonlinear source Hessian invariance is inferred. Both initial families are contained in the stronger all-degree closure P=A(T)R(c(T)z+beta(T))+B(T) in C[T,z], where A,c are arbitrary nonzero rational functions, beta is rational, B is polynomial and R is a nonconstant constant-coefficient polynomial. Final polynomiality and polynomial B are explicit hypotheses. Write A=D/Q in lowest terms and use q=Q(f_1)(f_2+B(f_1))/D(f_1), certified by the third test when D is nonconstant and by the polynomial exception test otherwise. The source-field affine change stays invertible. Consequently every sparse P=a(T)z^m+b(T)z^(m-1)+d(T), m>=2,a nonzero and arbitrary b,d, stays fully irreducible with full splitting-group preservation, and all its plane carried stable embeddings force an inverse. For b nonzero take R(Y)=Y^m+Y^(m-1), c=a/b and A=b^m/a^(m-1); b=0 is the pure-power case. No coprimality or leading-multiplicity restriction remains for this sparse family. The previous warning about arbitrary rational affine-isotrivial representations now concerns cases such as rational output translation B without an established parameter test, not the stronger polynomial-translation closure just proved.

entries.title: Finite centralizer criterion for integral full quantum completion in every rank
entries.scope: For an h-torsion-free h-separated K[[h]]-algebra E with commutative reduction, let actual commuting F1,...,Fm have algebraically independent reductions f_i whose full joint Poisson centralizer is K[f_i], and let actual h-regular individual conjugates T_i satisfy [F_j,T_i]=h*delta_ij. In every rank the actual joint centralizer B is commutative and its translation derivations nabla_i=-ad(T_i)/h act on the unique completed polynomial expansion as coordinate partials. Then B module-finite over K[[h]][F] is equivalent to B[h^-1] module-finite over K((h))[F], and each is equivalent to B=K[[h]][F]. The integral proof uses derivative-stable Fitting ideals, finite Taylor coefficient extraction and the absence of translation-invariant escaping support, without misapplying Nakayama to a polynomial ring. The generic proof makes B[h^-1] finite etale by Fitting-local-freeness and relative differentials; the external characteristic-zero affine-space covering theorem makes it a constant extension, and completed horizontal constants exclude every nontrivial constant field extension. Valuation and classical algebraic independence recover the integral polynomial algebra. Polynomial de Rham homotopy then removes every mixed curvature [T_i,T_j]/h inside the actual algebra. Corrections can be h-small if the classical conjugates already form the prescribed flat tuple. For scalar Weyl E, algebraically independent Bernstein leading symbols with full polynomial Poisson centralizer module-finite over their generated ring give a finite filtered certificate for the generic hypothesis. In rank two the primitive can have spatial degree at most deg(T1)+deg(T2)-2+deg(F1), using that filtration and independent leading symbols. Long satisfies the classical centralizer hypothesis by QSC1; finite corners with scalar classical reduction meet the algebra hypotheses, while arbitrary partial modules and idealizer filtrations require separate checks. A scalar certificate supplies QFL2's bounded full lift; a full finite corner can instead feed QMC1's matrix criterion. Finitely generated algebra centralizers, polynomial completed centralizers and finite fraction-field degree do not suffice. Rescaled cotangent tuples have identity classical reduction and all full relations, yet their generic centralizer is module-finite exactly when the underlying Keller map is invertible; a universal planar assertion of this finiteness would imply JC2. QNI1 supplies higher-rank nonfinite instances. Exact controls check Taylor extraction, compatible dual-number presentations and Fitting minors, escaping support, a three-variable radial primitive, momentum-dependent finite identity positions, nonzero curvature and its degree-bounded finite correction, parity module bases, a Keller shear and a birational nonfinite map. Universal statements use written proofs and the stated external covering theorem. No actual Long pair passing individual-mate and centralizer-finiteness gates, finite full Long carrier, bounded Long lift, all-representative nonlifting, scalar or matrix counterexample, DC2 or JC2 resolution, independent theorem replay, formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: Quartic determinant-three infinity exclusions, exact linear S4 lifts and etale sign-surface cyclic triple gate
entries.scope: For EVERY surviving actual plane Keller quartic normalization, retain the original source A2 and both omitted primes R,D. PF2RULED45/46 leave sole index-two ramified R, unramified D, residue degrees one, zero excess and immersive image normalizations. The full branch curve C=pi(R) has normalization A1 and actual S4 monodromy; its knot K at affine infinity therefore has a surjective transposition S4 representation, using the primary Leidy-Maxim infinity epimorphism without a general-position-at-infinity hypothesis. The quotient S4/V4=S3 sends meridians to transpositions, giving a nonconstant Fox3 colouring. Consequently 3 divides det(K)=abs(Delta_K(-1)). ALL determinant-prime-to3 knot candidates are excluded, uniformly in SOURCE pole orders, TARGET image degrees and common/complementary pencils. This determinant condition is quartic; no corresponding S3 quotient is asserted for S_d with d>=5. For an actual cable C_(w,p)(J), with winding w and coprime signed other parameter p, the satellite Alexander formula gives det_new=abs(p) if w even, w*det(J) if w odd and p even, and det(J) if both odd. This closed recurrence handles every finite number of cable stages and excludes, for example, every final even-winding stage with3 not dividing p, independently of all inner complexity. A stronger exact group test is proved: for an epimorphism phi:Gamma->S3 with transposition meridians, lifts through S4=F2^2 semidirect GL2(F2) are crossed homomorphisms z with (I+phi(mu))*z(mu)=0. Modulo coboundaries, their parabolic H1 is nonzero iff a SURJECTIVE transposition S4 lift exists. The proof uses irreducibility of the S3 module F2^2 and H1(S3,F2^2)=0 by averaging over C3, not a finite example census. This is linear once phi is fixed and applies to either a knot group or the full global Orevkov quotient with its actual relations. At least one infinity colouring must pass it. A knot solution need not extend globally. Complete controls distinguish trefoil, with determinant3 but zero parabolic H1, from T(3,4), with a one-dimensional parabolic H1 and actual S4 lifts; neither supplies a Keller realization. There is also an intrinsic global obstruction: the normal sign surface S:zeta^2=G_R must carry a connected ETale cyclic degree3 cover T->S, with nonzero anti-invariant class in H1_et(S,mu3). It is the S3 Galois quotient of the actual S4 closure over the sign subfield, not a cubic subfield of the quartic source. At a finite double C value, the disjoint S4 transpositions project to the SAME S3 transposition; the local sign kernel is trivial, so T->S is etale even at tangency/ADE singularities, not merely in codimension one. The Kummer exact sequence retains units modulo cubes before Pic(S)[3]; nonzero Pic3 is required only if all units are cubes. Smoothness alone cannot exclude the etale triple: Oka's smooth C* curve f=(xu-2)^2-u^3 has the irreducible S3 cubic s^3-3u*s-2(xu-2), discriminant -108f, and thus a connected etale triple over its smooth sign surface. This negative control has two normalization ends and is not an allowed quartic branch curve. 85 exact controls cover all S4 quotient products, the reflection colour law, complete finite F2 cocycle systems and affine lifts, full cable determinant identities and the smooth C* counter-control. Imported primary topology and Kummer facts are not independently reproved. These are actual determinant-class exclusions plus necessary lifting and sign-cover gates, not a full quartic/higher-degree exclusion, a finite Keller pair, formal verification, independent full reproof, external review, novelty priority or goal completion.

entries.title: Finite weighted-jet rectification by an explicit unipotent triangular polynomial automorphism in every dimension
entries.scope: For every polynomial G:A^(r+1)->A^(r+1),r>=1,G0=0,DG0=I, the weights e0=1,ei=r+i admit an actual polynomial source automorphism phi=(t,h(t)+A(t)u), detDphi1, such that each G_i composed withphi has weighted order>=ei. The univariate h is the implicit zero-curve jet computed by2r contracting iterations modulo t^(2r); A is a lower unitriangular polynomial matrix obtained by right Gaussian elimination of D_u G_high(t,h) modulo that same finite power. Its inverse A^-1(u-h) is polynomial. Pure-t terms vanish to2r; lower-index linear high-variable terms vanish by the Gaussian flag; terms involving two high variables exceed every output weight. These cases prove the statement in every rank, independently of bounded controls. No constant-Jacobian hypothesis on G is needed, no arbitrary full formal inverse is algebraized, and truncating a general formal automorphism is not asserted to preserve invertibility. Exact inverse/Jacobian/weighted checks throughrank4 supplement the written proof; no formal or independent whole-proof review.

entries.title: All-rank normalized polynomial tautological sweep completion criterion on ordinary affine space
entries.scope: For every r>=1 polynomial S=X(p)+gamma(1,p),detDS=gamma^r,rankDX=r over algebraically closed characteristic0, the following are equivalent: the sheet stabilizer H normally generates the geometric closure group G; d(S)=gamma^(r+1)h for the reduced ramification-surface equation has nonconstant h; an actual generic branch value has a regular preimage with gamma0 nonzero; and the exact field pair after one common independent variable has a globally polynomial Keller model on ordinary A^(r+2). For finite degreeN and branch degree delta this is exactly N>(r+1)delta. The proof centers a branch value, triangularizes its nilpotent matrix, uses source weightsr..2r-1 and output weights1,r+1..2r, and applies KMFI103 at the regular zero. The finite algorithm gives explicit polynomial inverses, polynomiality atx0, entire constant Jacobian gamma0 and two-sided generic field reconstruction. The marked-point sufficient construction also works for rank-deficient X, while the equivalence and numerical criterion require full rank. Constants may require finite algebraic extension; no arithmetic descent or minimum-dimension claim. A fully serialized rational A6 control has whole expanded Jacobian-3, exact S3 cubic field and three identity spectators; it is rank-deficient and is not an index5 PSL candidate. Full-rank companion cyclic inputs correctly fail the tail gate. The theorem generalizes KMFI59, but does not prove presentations for every abstract permissible action. Written all-rank proof and88 exact controls; no formal or independent whole-proof review.

entries.title: Exceptional PSL2(11) full-rank tautological fields reduce to a nonfinite rank-four birational ramification surface with one missing index5 prime
entries.scope: For either exceptional11 PSL2(11) action, every full-rank normalized polynomial tautological sweep S=X(p)+gamma(1,p),detDS=gamma^r,rankDX=r, in any rank, must have r4. Its nontrivial A5 stabilizer normally generates the simple group, so KMFI104 would automatically give an actual A6 Keller completion once the field input is proved. Fixed-sheet affine inertia requires r+1 in{2,3,5}; rank1 gives only symmetric generic linear pencils, and rank2 is closed by KMFI102. At r4 inertia is5, whose centralizer in G isC5, so tame decomposition equals inertia. The two ramified normalization primes each have residue degree1, and the unique unramified prime has degree1. Hence the visible single gamma0 divisor has degree delta1 ontoD; a second index5 prime is omitted, making S nonfinite. The unramified tail h in d(S)=gamma^5h is squarefree irreducible and maps birationally toD. Compactifying the line family shows D must be covered by horizontal straight lines; all graph-boundary components are retained. The rank2 horizontal-ruling rigidity is not assumed inrank4. This is a complete necessary reduction within full-rank normalized sweeps and a constructive sufficiency once such a field exists; no PSL11 input, absolute Keller action obstruction, rank-deficient higher-dimensional classification or full spectrum is supplied. entries.title: Exact two-sheet exceptional hyperplane fibers in the full-rank higher-weight affine completion
entries.scope: For KMFI104 full-rank normalized sweeps of rankr>=2 with generic branch centering and a regular Jordan frame, the specified weights1,r+1,...,2r give a Keller representative whose target C0 has actual source preimage x0 disjoint union gamma0. The first component is A^(r+1) mapping isomorphically onto all C0; the second is G_m timesA^r mapping isomorphically onto C0 minusZ0=0. Hence all ofC0 is in the affine image, with exactly two points offH={C=Z0=0} and one onH. Differentiating tr(P^r)=0 at a regular upper Jordan block kills the only possible nonlinear last-stage term u1^2. Thus E(0,u)=(1,(I+J)u); the finite jet rectifier gives x0 coordinates y0,y1,...,yr+beta*y0^(2r), an actual triangular automorphism. The source components are disjoint because gamma restricts to nonzero gamma0 onx0. This is a property of the specified full-rank higher-weight representative, not rank-deficient controls or every affine realization of the action. Written polynomial proof and exact symbolic controls; no formal or independent whole-proof review.

entries.title: Exceptional-divisor inertia powering and trivial residue extensions in the all-rank completion
entries.scope: In the KMFI106 setting let sigma generate full normal-closure inertia at the original smooth branchD, with orderm, and e=r+1 its visible cycle length. Then e dividesm, and at the new target hyperplaneC0 decomposition and inertia are equal to the cyclic subgroup generated by sigma^e. Every normalization prime has residue degree1, and ramification indices are precisely cycle lengths of sigma^e. The lowest weighted part of the reduced branch equation is aY0^e: stage E(0,u) dominates the chartY0=1, while the Y1 linear coefficient vanishes because the branch normal is the last coordinate andr>=2. The regular target substitution reduces the local Kummer equation to t^m=(CZ0)^e, whose e factors are totally ramified degree m/e with unchanged residues. Thus if sigma^e is identity the whole normal closure splits overC0. Exactly Fix(sigma^e)-2 unramified primes are omitted there, always at leastr. The proof requires generic centering away from other branch components and concerns this higher-weight representative; no residue enlargement is inferred merely from missing sheets. Written local Kummer proof with pinned primary input and exact algebraic/group controls, not formal or independently whole-proof reviewed.

entries.title: Every ramified divisorial curve of a plane Keller intermediate field is a polynomially parametrizable nonproperness component
entries.scope: Let K=(f,g):A2->A2 be complex Keller, F=C(f,g), L=C(s,t), and F subset E subset L finite, with no Galois hypothesis on E/F. If the finite target normalization in E has a ramified divisorial place over an irreducible target curve C, then C is a component of the nonproperness set S_K and admits a nonconstant polynomial A1 parametrization. The source A2 is a dense open in the finite normalization in L. A divisor above the ramified intermediate place has total index greater than one by multiplicativity, whereas every visible source divisor has index one. Thus this whole divisor is omitted. Approaching a general boundary point through the source open forces source coordinates unbounded and puts a dense subset of C in S_K. Clearing denominators makes K finite over a dense principal open, so S_K has dimension at most one; the retained Jelonek-Lason arXiv:1411.5011v2 Theorem 3.2 supplies its qualitative polynomial-curve covering. Other unramified sheets may remain visible: no omission of every target preimage is asserted. In particular a primitive horizontal curve u(T)V+v(T)=0, gcd(u,v)=1 and u nonconstant, cannot branch an intermediate field: its ring is C[T,1/u], which admits no nonconstant polynomial A1 map. This is a plane-only result; punctured-curve cylinders have free polynomial directions in higher dimensions. All degrees are unrestricted. No arbitrary target-cover preservation, endpoint resolution or unrestricted HC4/JC2 conclusion is asserted.

entries.title: Every rational parameter affine in the second target coordinate stays relatively algebraically closed under plane Keller pullback
entries.scope: For every complex plane Keller K=(f,g), q=(Q(T)V+C(T))/D(T), with Q,D nonzero and gcd(Q,C,D)=1, C(q(K)) is relatively algebraically closed in C(s,t). No denominator square-freeness, exceptional-value-count or multiplicity bound is required. If Q is constant the retained reduced finite-pencil test applies. Otherwise the retained Petravchuk-Iena Lemma 2(1) turns nonclosedness into q(K)=Phi(h), deg Phi>1. F=C(f,q), and E=C(f,h) is its degree-deg(Phi) intermediate cover, since f is an independent transcendental over C(h). At each finite branch value lambda the primitive horizontal factor [Q V+C-lambda D]/gcd(Q,C-lambda D) has q-lambda valuation one, so the same ramification persists over its generic C(T) point. HC4MYII0 forces Q to divide C-lambda D. At most one finite lambda has this property; two would contradict the triple gcd. Projective Riemann-Hurwitz forces the remaining two-branch cover to be a power map. But its primitive horizontal source factor has valuation one by HC4MYHW0, contradicting a nontrivial power; equivalently HC4MYIB0 forbids the resulting cyclic intermediate field. Every finite Galois parameter cover retains its full group, and HC4MYIG1 supplies the filtered class-action consequence with all global filtration and affine height-one fibre hypotheses retained. This theorem is plane-only. The all-dimensional HC4MYIH0 strict multiplicity test and its equality counterexample remain valid in their separate scope. It does not preserve arbitrary two-variable target covers. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Rational affine fixed-polynomial outputs, including rational output translation, preserve irreducibility and full monodromy in every degree in the plane

entries.title: Nonparametrizable branch inertia controls all source factors; a nilpotent residual quotient preserves full groups and closes pure-power nonadjacent binomials in all degrees
entries.scope: For a complex plane Keller field L/F and any finite Galois M/F with group G, let N_bad be the normal subgroup generated by actual divisorial inertia over target curves admitting no nonconstant polynomial A1 parametrization. If H is the source group image in G, then N_bad is contained in the normal core of H, hence in H: M^H=M intersect L is intermediate and HC4MYII0 makes it unramified at all places over every such curve. Thus transitivity of N_bad on an irreducible separable target root set implies source irreducibility. A primitive faithful root action with one nontrivial bad inertia is a sufficient instance. Transitivity alone does not imply full group preservation. If G/N_bad is nilpotent, HC4MYIA0 preserves its full quotient group; together with N_bad subset H this gives H=G and full group preservation. The same holds for any separately certified preserved quotient. If the retained filtered component class group has zero N_bad-fixed subgroup, the source component class vanishes and the unchanged global filtered criterion forces a carried plane inverse. All degrees are unrestricted; discriminant factors alone are not asserted actual inertia. An explicit family closed with full group preservation is P=(T-c0)^r z^m+z^q+d(T), r>=1, 1<=q<m, d polynomial, for every m,q,r and every carried closed stable plane embedding through (T,xy-P), r_stable>=1. After translating T and shearing V, all non-axis finite branch curves lie on T^(rq)V^(m-q)=(-1)^m q^q(m-q)^(m-q)/m^m, whose components admit no polynomial A1 map. Killing their inertia leaves a quotient ramified only on the axes; purity makes its normalization finite etale over (C*)^2, and the retained forward finite-cover comparison makes its group a quotient of Z^2, hence abelian. No primitivity or generic-group classification is needed, including imprimitive cases. No closure for arbitrary coefficient pairs a(T)z^m+b(T)z^q is asserted. This is plane-only. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Every cubic triangular output closes for plane Keller maps, without any leading-coefficient or critical-discriminant restriction
entries.scope: For every cubic P=a(T)z^3+b(T)z^2+c(T)z+d(T) in C[T,z], a nonzero, and every complex plane Keller pair (f,g), P(f,Z)+g is irreducible over C(s,t). Therefore every carried closed stable plane embedding through (T,xy-P), r>=1, forces the Keller inverse by HC4MYHZ2. All leading, coefficient, source and embedding degrees are unrestricted. Set Delta=b^2-3ac, the critical-point discriminant rather than the root discriminant. HC4MYIC2 already excludes roots when its nonzero square-free part has degree at least two. Delta=0 is a rational translated cube; Delta=H^2 nonzero has P=A(Y^3-3Y)+B0 with Y=(3az+b)/H, A=H^3/(27a^2), B0=d+(2b^3-9abc)/(27a^2), so HC4MYII2 applies despite rational B0. For the remaining Delta=H^2 ell with ell=T-c0, the same change gives P=A(Y^3-3ell Y)+B0. A rational source root would embed the cubic root field in L. Its genuine ramified horizontal curve has normalization T=tau^2+c0, V=-B0(T)+2A(T)ell(T)tau. HC4MYII0 forces a polynomial A1 parametrization; tau is integral and polynomial in that parameter, so the displayed V has no finite tau pole. Even and odd parts force B0 polynomial and A ell polynomial. At any zero of A of order n>0, a square-free source f-fibre gives constant-term valuation -n, forcing 3 to divide n. The only possible pole of A is simple at ell=0, but valuations (3v,1+v,1) have a unique minimum for every integral v, excluding it. Thus A=C(T)^3 with C polynomial. W=C(f)Y is integral over the normal original source ring, hence polynomial, and satisfies W^3-3ell(f)C(f)^2 W+g+B0(f)=0. Its Jacobian identity J(f,W)[3W^2-3ell(f)C(f)^2]=-J(f,g) contradicts the nonconstant multiplier, since f,W are independent. A reducible cubic has a rational root, completing all cases. Full cubic splitting-group preservation is not asserted by this theorem. No algebraic parameter-cover source is replaced by A2. General higher-degree coefficient variation, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Arbitrary polynomial coefficient directions have injective scalar trace response
entries.scope: Characteristic zero, retained normalized compiler, any block number N>=1 and any finite higher indices j>=4. entries.title: One auxiliary return direction forces every effective polynomial coefficient to be a first integral
entries.scope: Characteristic zero. For any determinant-one polynomial auxiliary map G:A^m->A^m, m>=2, any nonzero constant output direction mu, any nonconstant beta=b(sum_i(3*x_i^2-x_i)/2), and all polynomial effective coefficient profiles g_ij(U,sigma), the whole-source map (Phi(P;g),G(U)-beta(P)*mu) is Keller iff its determinant is one iff Delta(g_ij)=0 for every profile, where Delta=(DG)^(-1)*mu acts with sigma fixed. This permits any number of independently presented controls and all finite active degrees. UARESPINJ1 makes the exact Schur response injective; UAPARALLEL1 supplies the frozen map. Redundant controls need not themselves be invariants. The rank-one condition is the auxiliary return beta*mu, not the number of controls entering Phi. No output-recovery, absolute atomicity or canonical fibre is inferred for a general auxiliary G without the separate kernel gate. For an arbitrary different polynomial beta(P), the same Schur identity gives the exact common-first-integral condition beta in the intersection of kernels of the finitely many U-coefficient derivations of W=(D_P Phi)^(-1)*V*Delta g. This is a reformulation, not a computed kernel or a general classification. Signal-only selectors beta=b0(sigma) permit non-invariant effective coefficients but have explicit forward factors of degrees product d_i and deg(G); both are nontrivial for the cubic. A possible atomic different-selector cubic candidate therefore needs W nonzero and a separating common invariant outside k[sigma], with exact marked-fibre conditions still to prove.

entries.title: Geometric generic-line connectedness exactly characterizes output-recoverable feedback invariants
entries.scope: For any characteristic-zero determinant-one polynomial G:A^m->A^m and constant nonzero mu, let R be a linear target quotient annihilating mu and Delta=(DG)^(-1)*mu. The rational kernel is the relative algebraic closure of k(R) in k(U). The smooth geometric generic fibre of R is connected iff integral iff k(R) is relatively algebraically closed iff the polynomial kernel is k[R]. The regular-descent argument uses constant affine units and smooth divisor dominance; the converse clears denominators of an algebraic constant. Under this condition UARANKONE1 effective profiles are output-recoverable and have actual reverse Keller factors of degrees deg(G) and product d_i, by UAPARALLEL1. They are both nontrivial only when deg(G)>1; automorphism auxiliaries do not by themselves give two nontrivial factors. Every auxiliary plane Keller map satisfies recovery by classical one-generator closedness, and every auxiliary automorphism does too. A rank-one escape from recovery for another G requires failure of the particular generalized closed-subring assertion JC_sub(m-1,m;k), not a proved failure of ordinary JC(2). No general closedness conjecture is assumed, and disconnectedness alone is no atomic or canonical construction.
