entries.title: All-degree coprime power-difference obstruction and unavoidable nonmonogenic cubic resolvent index
entries.scope: General theorem over C: for all coprime p,q>=2 and polynomials A,B of arbitrary degrees, if G=A^p-B^q is irreducible and its zero curve has normalization A1, then V(A,B) is nonempty. Assuming no common zero, the normalized curve forces A,B to be constants a0,b0 along G, with a0*b0 nonzero. Both image-dimension cases are proved. If (A,B) is dependent, the normalized affine image curve is rational by restriction to a line and Luroth; its constant units force one puncture, so A=P(h), B=Q(h). Irreducibility of G forces P^p-Q^q linear, contradicted by the recalled Mason-Stothers Wronskian degree inequality and1/p+1/q<1. If the coefficient map H=(A,B) is dominant, the reduced contraction to the smooth torus-curve point P gives H^*I_P=(G), lifting the whole A2 to Bl_P(A2) minus the strict torus curve while RETAINING the exceptional curve. With N=pq,k=p+q, theta=(du wedge dv)^N/(u^p-v^q)^k is a nonzero logarithmic N-canonical form on an SNC completion. The proof supplies closed piecewise order identities for EVERY positive toric ray at the affine cusp and unique infinity point, and order N-k>=0 at the retained interior exceptional curve. Logarithmic top differential pullback (Fujino Lemma2.12, or the written local argument after graph resolution) makes its pullback logarithmic at source infinity. But it equals nonzero polynomial G^(N-k)*(Jac(H)/G)^N times (dX wedge dY)^N, whose generic infinity pole order is3N+degree>N, contradiction. No coefficient, exponent, source-order or branch-degree cutoff occurs. Apply this to the ENTIRE surviving actual quartic packet, retaining the marked source and both omitted primes R,D, with the PF54 S3 quotient in the S4 Galois closure and its cyclic triple ETale at every point of the normal sign surface, including tangencies. Its normal cubic quotient algebra C3 has completed local form R x R[z]/(z^2-G), even at finite A_(2m-1) sign singularities, because disjoint local S4 folds have the SAME reflection image in S3. It is finite locally free rank3, has only2+1 branch fibres, reduced trace discriminant G, and is locally monogenic everywhere. If globally generated by an integral element, its depressed cubic T^3+cT+d would have discriminant unit*G and no common zero of c,d (a common zero gives a forbidden triple-root fibre). Rescaling gives the impossible basepoint-free G=A0^2-B0^3. Thus EVERY global monogenic model of the actual normal cubic resolvent is excluded, uniformly in source orders, target degrees and common/complementary rulings. Using the trivial determinant line of C3 over A2, define I(t) by1 wedge t wedge t^2. For EVERY integral t outside A, the cubic field degree is3 and I(t) is a nonzero NONCONSTANT polynomial. Its characteristic discriminant is constant*G*I(t)^2, so a divisor index/conductor cannot be discarded. Index support may coincide with G; no distinct new branch support is forced. A module basis or primitive field element does not imply a global algebra generator. Controls retain Oka's monogenic Cstar branch, and the genuine immersive A1 curve G0=x^2-(x+y^2)^3 with normalization x=(1-t^2)^3,y=t(1-t^2), sole A5 double value and an inner common zero. Its monogenic cubic has a triple-root fibre there and its sign triple is only quasi-etale, not etale at the singularity. Noncoprime p=q=2 and reducible G controls show the dropped hypotheses fail. 59 exact controls verify universal valuation identities, trace/index discriminants and these controls. The explicit general theorem is not a full quartic exclusion: no implication forcing the actual cubic algebra to be globally monogenic, or vanishing of all Picard3, is established. The cubic is in the Galois closure, not a cubic subfield of the quartic source. No corresponding cubic quotient is supplied for higher Keller field degrees. No formal verification, independent full reproof, external review, novelty priority, finite Keller pair or research-goal completion is asserted.

entries.title: Taylor centralizer rigidity and radical obstructions without finite generation
entries.scope: Let a characteristic-zero differential domain B contain P=L[t1,...,tm], with commuting derivations extending coordinate partials, H=Frac B algebraic over Q=L(t), joint constants of H equal L, and P intersect B-units equal L-units. No finite-generation or noetherian hypothesis on B is needed. Algebraicity is automatic for the actual commutative scalar rank-m Weyl centralizer by applying the external dimension bound to each P[b]. QFC1's polynomial classical joint centralizer embeds H in K(t)((h)) and makes its horizontal constants K((h)); scalar units supply the other hypothesis. The differential Taylor map at any maximal ideal of B, over its arbitrary residue field, is injective by differential simplicity. Its coordinate restriction to the formal power series ring is flat by field extension, localization and Noetherian completion. Regular sequences show that every irreducible base divisor has a formal prime factor of multiplicity one, disjoint from every other base polynomial prime, even at singular points. Restriction to any finite intermediate J/Q gives an extension valuation of ramification index one. Thus each finite intermediate has an unramified sheet above every base divisor. If J/Q is finite Galois, transitivity, external branch purity and constant covers make J a constant extension, excluded by horizontal constants. H therefore has no nontrivial finite Galois subextension. If H/Q is algebraic Galois, finite or infinite, it is trivial. Independently, every coordinate-derivative-stable overring of P in Q is a localization S^-1 P: Taylor flatness forces every reduced denominator to be a unit. Hence birational H=Q and scalar units force B=P without finite generation, and QET1 parameter-pole removal plus QFC1 curvature homotopy give finite integral full completion preserving a prescribed flat classical tuple. For every finite intermediate with normal closure group G and point stabilizer S, S must normally generate G; the natural D4 quartic fails via a quadratic Galois factor, while the retained S3 cubic passes. In the scalar Weyl application H has no new radicals: theta in H with theta^k in Q lies in Q for every k>=2. Adjoin constant roots of unity, apply Galois-factor rigidity to the binomial field, and descend through the abelian constant extension. Thus finite actual commutants b,c with c nonzero and q(F)b^k=p(F)c^k, where p/q is not a kth power in Q, obstruct simultaneous individual mates in all orders without presenting all B. An irreducible spectral divisor of order not divisible by k certifies the nonpower condition. Membership in Frac B is required; arbitrary rational commuting operators do not substitute. The actual scalar momentum-dependent square-root control is checked exactly. An infinite differential localization shows that the unit hypothesis remains essential. Declared Taylor, denominator, singular factor, quartic, stabilizer, radical and localization controls are finite; universal results are written proofs using the explicit dimension, flatness, factoriality, ramification, purity and covering inputs. The finite-type etale description itself still uses QET1 finite generation. Projective unit/algebraicity hypotheses are not automatic. No new Long field/radical certificate, full finite lift, carrier, all-representative nonlifting, identification with whole quantum division indices, DC2/JC2 resolution, new scalar/matrix counterexample, independent theorem replay, formal verification, external review or novelty priority is claimed.

entries.title: A relative central series over any certified preserved quotient forces full Keller source-group preservation in all dimensions
entries.scope: Let K:A^n->A^n be complex Keller, n>=2, F=C(K), L=C(x_1,...,x_n), M/F finite Galois with group G, and H the source group image. Supply a normal subgroup N of G already certified to lie in H. In Q=G/N supply a chain of normal subgroups 1=C_0<=...<=C_k=C with C_i/C_(i-1) contained in Z(Q/C_(i-1)). If the source image preserves the entire quotient Q/C, then H=G. For J=H/N, start with JC_k=Q. If JC_i=Q, then JC_(i-1) is normal in Q because C_i is central modulo C_(i-1). A proper such subgroup would lift to a proper normal subgroup of G containing H, giving a nontrivial finite Galois intermediate field inside L, forbidden by HC4MYIB0. Descent gives J=Q. Source, cover and polynomial degrees and relative central-series length are unrestricted. The whole quotient Q/C may be nonnilpotent and is handled by its separate preservation certificate. An ordinary central kernel is the length-one case; a nilpotent whole group with trivial final quotient is another case. A nilpotent normal kernel alone is insufficient, as the proper transposition subgroup of S3 surjects onto S3/A3 while the quotient conjugates A3 nontrivially. This is an all-dimensional field statement; a separate argument must supply N subset H. It does not make arbitrary intermediate fields Galois or preserve arbitrary target covers. entries.title: Finite product covers with nilpotent geometric fibre image preserve their full group under Keller pullback in all dimensions, with arbitrary parameter-cover monodromy
dependencies: external: Milne Lectures on Etale Cohomology v2.21 Theorem 3.4, full faithfulness
entries.scope: In polynomial target coordinates T,X_2,...,X_n, let U=A1 minus an arbitrary finite set S, Y a connected Zariski open in A^(n-1), and M/F a finite Galois extension of F=C(T,X_2,...,X_n). Require its finite normalization etale over the actual product W=U times Y, and require the finite monodromy image C of pi_1(Y) to be nilpotent. Every complex Keller map in dimension n>=2 preserves the full group Q=Gal(M/F), in all source and cover degrees. The product monodromy images commute and generate Q, so the upper central series of C is relatively central in Q. The quotient cover by C has trivial Y monodromy. Restrict it to an algebraic section y_0 in Y; the restriction is a connected algebraic finite etale cover of U whose pullback is topologically isomorphic to the quotient. Newly used full faithfulness in Milne v2.21 Theorem 3.4, printed page 28, makes this an algebraic isomorphism of the already algebraic covers. Essential surjectivity is not used. Hence the quotient field really is E(X_2,...,X_n) for finite Galois E/C(T) with group Q/C, not merely an abstract isomorphic group. HC4MYHX0 preserves that parameter cover because C(f_1) is relatively algebraically closed in the original source field. HC4MYIJ0 now gives the whole Q. In particular every finite Galois cover etale over U times (C*)^h times A^(n-h-1), 0<=h<=n-1, is preserved, since the fibre image is abelian central. The group coming from U can be arbitrary nonnilpotent. This is all-dimensional and does not use the plane nonparametrizable-curve theorem. Every carried closed stable embedding through (T,xy-P), r_stable>=1, forces the Keller inverse by HC4MYHZ2. All source, coefficient, z and embedding degrees, leading multiplicities and numbers of leading levels are unrestricted. Shear V to remove d and set k=m-q. The nonzero critical equations imply a(T)^q V^k=c_(m,q)b(T)^m, c_(m,q)=(-1)^m q^q k^k/m^m nonzero. Cancelling gcd(a^q,b^m) gives U(T)V^k-W(T)=0 with gcd(U,W)=1 and U nonconstant under the finite-pole condition. Bezout makes U(T) a unit on the entire curve and every irreducible component, so any polynomial A1 map has constant T and V. Every actual non-axis branch component is therefore bad. All remaining branches lie in a(T)b(T)=0 or V=0, since outside the leading and root-discriminant divisors the integral distinct roots are etale. Killing bad inertia leaves a punctured-cylinder quotient, so HC4MYIJ2 gives the full group without a root-group classification or primitivity hypothesis, also for imprimitive covers. In particular every a(T)z^m+z^q+d(T), a nonzero arbitrary polynomial, closes: nonconstant a satisfies the pole test and constant a is HC4MYII2. Both coefficients may vary and share zeros: a=T^(m+1), b=T is admitted for every m>=2 and 1<=q<m. If a^q divides b^m, this finite-pole test is unavailable, but failure is not a nonclosure certificate: a=T^m,b=T^q is already a fixed-polynomial family. Other no-finite-pole cases outside retained parameter and normal-rescaling gates remain unproved here. This binomial application is plane-only. No parameter-cover source is replaced by A2. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: All-rank integrated-power sweeps and the complete unit-triangular normalized class
entries.scope: For every rankr>=1 and nonconstant h(t) of degreed over characteristic0, an explicit finite logarithmic coefficient elimination constructs X=(h(t),p2+R2(t),...,pr+Rr(t,p2,...,p_(r-1)),Xlast) with full rankDX=r and detD(X+gamma(1,p))=gamma^r. The sweep is finite of degree rd+1, with exact field pair the (r-1)-spectator stabilization of B=(-1)^(r-1) integral_0^t(A-h(s))^r ds. Conversely every normalized sweep with these unit-triangular first r coordinates, of arbitrary polynomial degrees and arbitrary final component, reduces by polynomial target change to that exact integrated field. The proof uses recursive unit coefficients, triangular elimination and the complete Jacobian differential identity, not bounded controls. It closes this whole input class to any nonfinite exceptional11 rank4 field, without asserting that all full-rank sweeps are triangular or that the full action spectrum is classified.

entries.title: Complete rank-four integrated-pencil monodromy and exact arithmetic constants
entries.scope: For the KMFI109 rank4 integrated field B=integral_0^t(A-h(s))^4 ds with d=degh, geometric generic monodromy is cyclicC5 ifd1 and natural A_(4d+1) for every d>=2. Critical-value parametrization a=h(t),b=I4(t,h(t)) is birational because d^4b/da^4=24t; thus generic finite branch cycles are single5-cycles. Their transitive generation forces primitivity and the Jordan prime-cycle theorem gives A_N. This is a generic statement, not every specialized A. For any characteristic-zero coefficient fieldk, d>=2, arithmetic group is A_N iffN=4d+1 is a square ink, otherwiseS_N, and exact closure constants are k(sqrt(N)); Disc(P)=N[Res(P,A-h)^2/h_d^2]^2. Hence the whole rank4 unit-triangular normalized class is finite and supplies no exceptional11 PSL2(11) input. Written all-degree proofs and a pinned primary Jordan theorem, with exact controls rather than a numerical Frobenius inference.

entries.title: Normal finite monogenic covers over finite algebraic parameter curves stay irreducible under the actual Keller source base change, using norms of cross-resultant units
dependencies: external: Stacks 01V4 smooth base change and composition; 04QM regularity and normality over C
entries.scope: Let K:A^n->A^n be complex Keller, n>=2, A=C[T,V_2,...,V_n], B=C[x_1,...,x_n], L=Frac(B), k=C(T). Let k_prime/k be finite Galois and D=Spec A_D its finite normal curve over A1_T. Set A_prime=A_D[V_2,...,V_n], B_prime=B tensor_C[T] A_D, F_prime=k_prime(V_2,...,V_n), L_prime=L k_prime. Every monic R in A_prime[Y] that is irreducible over F_prime and defines a normal cover stays irreducible over L_prime after the Keller base change. Source, parameter, cover and polynomial degrees are unrestricted. The Keller component f_1 is smooth, D is a smooth complex curve, so B_prime is smooth and normal. A_D is finite free over the PID C[T]; HC4MYHX0 makes the generic source tensor a field, so B_prime is a finite-free normal domain with field L_prime. Etale pullback preserves root-cover normality. A proper monic source factorization gives disjoint components and a cross-resultant r in B_prime^*, not necessarily constant. The finite-free multiplication determinant gives Norm_(L_prime/L)(r) in B^*=C^*. In a common finite target splitting field stable under parameter conjugation, every sigma(r) is integral over A_prime because every parameter-conjugate R^sigma is monic. The norm product therefore makes 1/r integral as well. Every target conjugate cross-resultant is a unit, so actual divisorial inertia cannot cross any conjugate factor partition. Purity makes the normal-core quotient finite etale over D times A^(n-1). Restriction to a section and the retained Milne full faithfulness identify it with a genuine parameter cover E/k_prime. Taking a finite Galois closure over k and using HC4MYHX0 preserves that quotient over L_prime. The source subgroup and normal core both stabilize the chosen root subset, so full quotient image makes that subset G-invariant, contradicting irreducibility. entries.title: Integral algebraic affine monic models preserve all-degree output irreducibility in all dimensions and complete every plane two-coefficient binomial
entries.scope: Let P in C(T)[z] have positive z degree. entries.title: Integral critical values force integral centered monic coefficients in every degree and give an all-dimensional Keller output criterion
entries.scope: For a nonarchimedean valuation with residue characteristic zero, a monic centered Q(Y)=Y^m+sum_(i<=m-2)a_i Y^i, m>=2, whose every critical value Q(alpha), Q_prime(alpha)=0, has nonnegative valuation, has every coefficient integral. entries.scope: For every complex plane Keller pair (f,g) and every nonconstant P in C(T)[z], P(f,Z)+g is irreducible over C(s,t), without a coefficient, leading, critical-discriminant, factor-degree, group or polynomial-degree restriction. entries.title: Generative-polynomial reduction transfers every certified outer irreducibility statement to arbitrarily many polynomial variables, closing all multivariable plane Keller outputs
dependencies: external: Arzhantsev-Petravchuk arXiv math/0608157v2 Theorem 1(i) to (iii), explicitly over C(T)
entries.scope: Let kappa=C(T), F=C(T,V), k>=1, and P in kappa[Z_1,...,Z_k] have positive joint Z degree. Choose P=R(S), R in kappa[U], S in kappa[Z], minimizing deg_Z S. Joint degrees multiply, so S is noncomposite. The explicit Arzhantsev-Petravchuk Theorem 1(i) to (iii), now audited over the non-algebraically-closed field C(T), makes kappa[S] closed in kappa[Z]. The reproduced denominator argument makes kappa(S) relatively algebraically closed in kappa(Z); characteristic-zero finite Galois disjointness then makes S-U geometrically generically integral. No special-fibre classification, Proposition 2 or separate generative-existence theorem is imported. For the m=deg R roots alpha_i of R(U)+V, the exact geometric factorization is P+V=rho product_i(S-alpha_i), with each factor absolutely irreducible. Each alpha_i is transcendental over kappa and V=-R(alpha_i). For every field extension L/F, the factor orbits of P+V are exactly the outer-root orbits, so irreducibility of R(U)+V over L implies irreducibility of P+V over L. This field transfer also inherits every retained higher-dimensional outer certificate. HC4MYIK3 supplies unconditional outer irreducibility for every complex plane Keller pair (f,g), hence P(f,Z_1,...,Z_k)+g is irreducible for every such pair, every k and every degree. The unrestricted Keller conclusion is plane-only; no full splitting-group equality is inferred. S need not be a coordinate and special S-fibres may be reducible. The geometric factor count is deg R, not deg_Z P. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: A fixed polynomial multiplier contributes an exact direct sum of outer root-class lattices, independent of its multiplicities, with zero plane-source invariants
entries.scope: Let X and Z be disjoint variable sets, A(X) a nonzero polynomial with complex constant coefficients, and P in C(T)[Z] nonconstant. Write A=c product_(j=1)^b a_j(X)^e_j with distinct irreducible complex factors and positive multiplicities, taking b=0 for constant A. Let P=R(S) be a closed generative decomposition from HC4MYIL0 and m=deg R. Over Omega, an algebraic closure of C(T,V), the generic ring Omega[X,Y,Z,W]/(A(X)Y-P(T,Z)-V), with arbitrary unused variables W, is smooth and has Cl equal to direct_sum_(j=1)^b Z^m/Z(1,...,1), of rank b(m-1). Smoothness follows because P has only finitely many algebraic critical values in its Z variables and -V is transcendental. Inverting A gives the Laurent localization Omega[X,1/A,Z,W], a UFD. The removed prime divisors are D_(j,i)=(a_j,S-alpha_i), using absolute irreducibility in disjoint variable sets. Their only relations are div(a_j)=sum_i D_(j,i), each with multiplicity one even when e_j>1: in the local ring S-alpha_i is a unit times a_j^e_j Y, and a_j generates the height-one maximal ideal. Every boundary-supported principal relation is a unit after localization, hence c_0 product_j a_j^n_j, so there are no other relations or torsion. The Galois action fixes j and permutes i via the outer roots. The plane Keller source action is transitive on i by HC4MYIK3. A sum-of-coordinates argument shows the transitive root lattice has zero fixed subgroup, hence the whole generic class group has zero plane-source-fixed subgroup. Arbitrary numbers and multiplicities of fixed factors are admitted; a coordinate generator and generic factoriality are not assumed. A parameter-dependent multiplier is not covered: correlated swaps of rows and outer roots can fix (1,-1) in the two-copy lattice. This representation control is not asserted a Keller realization. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Every polynomial suspension with an arbitrary fixed disjoint multiplier forces a carried plane Keller inverse, in all stable dimensions and ambient/target polynomial automorphism orbits
entries.scope: Let p,k>=1, X=(X_1,...,X_p), Z=(Z_1,...,Z_k) disjoint, A in C[X] nonzero and independent of T and Z, and P in C[T,Z] of positive joint Z degree. In A^(r+3), with r>=p+k-1 and r-p-k+1 unused variables, set Pi_0=(T,A(X)Y-P(T,Z)). Every polynomial closed stable embedding A^(r+2)->A^(r+3) carrying a complex plane Keller pair through Pi_0 forces that pair to be a polynomial automorphism. Variable counts, source, coefficient, multiplier, leading-multiplicity and embedding degrees are unrestricted. For d=deg_Z P>0 and a=deg_X A, use weights d on X and Y, a+1 on Z, one on unused variables and zero on C[T,V]. A term order refining these weights with Y first in ties gives a monic relation with constant leading coefficient and leading monomial Y times a leading monomial of A, supplying a common global free basis. The generic graded equation A_a(X)Y-P_d(T,Z) is a domain by primitive linearity in Y and disjoint variable sets. At every affine height-one target prime pi, P+V is nonzero: if all positive-Z coefficients vanished then pi=T-c and P(c,0)+V survives. The fixed A stays nonzero and coprime to this residue polynomial, so every affine height-one fibre is geometrically integral. HC4MYIL1 supplies generic normality and zero source-fixed class subgroup, making the selected image component and every conjugate principal. The retained global component-pencil, primitive denominator saturation and smooth minimal-label argument then gives the Keller inverse. Field denominators in the generative decomposition never localize the original global model. This includes every multivariable xy suspension and every monomial product suspension with arbitrary positive exponents and one linear variable. In HC4, r=2 admits arbitrary P(T,Z_1,Z_2) with A=X and arbitrary fixed A(X_1,X_2) with one Z. The conclusion is stable under every ambient polynomial automorphism Phi and target polynomial automorphism Lambda: for outputs Lambda composed with Pi_0 composed with Phi, use Phi composed with the embedding and Lambda_inverse composed with the Keller pair. No source Hessian invariance or arbitrary-graph normal form is asserted. Positive joint Z degree is essential; base-only P can have a reducible height-one fibre A(X)Y=0. Parameter-dependent or overlapping multipliers, other output geometries, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Exact Euler and first-order differential reconstruction of every polynomial normalized sweep
entries.scope: Write X=(f,g), P=Dg-p df and S=X+gamma(1,p), so detDS=det(gamma I+P). In every rankr>=1, every normalized polynomial input is parameterized by an arbitrary vector polynomialg with traceless linear part, f_n=div(g_(n+1))/n for homogeneous n>=1, arbitrary constantf, and the remaining equations tr(P^j)=0 for j2..r. These are exact necessary-and-sufficient polynomial coefficient identities without a degree cap; they do not determine the generic monodromy. Intrinsically forr>=2 set b_j=sum_i partial_iP_ij and a=-b/(r-1). TracelessP reconstructs polynomialX exactly when (r-1)(partial_jP_ik-partial_kP_ij)=delta_ij b_k-delta_ik b_j, plus da=0 forr2. Forr>=3 closedness follows by differentiating the row curl identities, so no extra integrability condition is omitted. Inr2 this reduces to the earlier wave equation. The homogeneous linear compatibility spaces have dimensionr^2-1 atdegree0 and r*binomial(n+r,r-1) atn>=1; the rank4 values start15,40,80,140. Rank4 then requires only the three nonlinear trace identities2,3,4 after linear trace and integrability have been solved. Written global polynomial proof and exact representative space ranks; no classification of all nonlinear nilpotent solutions or abstract Keller actions is claimed.

entries.title: Pointwise full-rank coframe, Piola power identities and a forced nonzero kernel-direction eigenvalue
entries.scope: For any normalized polynomial sweep, rankDX=r holds at a point exactly when the r-row cyclic coframe (df,dfP,...,dfP^(r-1)) is invertible there. Full rank makes P a single regular nilpotent block and df nonzero on its one-dimensional kernel. Forr>=2 factor P^(r-1)=uv with u in the kernel and v in the left kernel. Differentiating trP^r and using the integrability curl gives v DP[u]=df(u)v with df(u) nonzero; the derivative freezes the tangent vector at the point. Thus a full-rank nilpotent matrix field necessarily has a nonnilpotent derivative in its kernel direction. The universal power-divergence identities are sum_j partial_j(P^m)_ji=-(r-m)(dfP^(m-1))_i for m1..r, obtained by the polynomial cofactor divergence identity for D[g+(A-f)p] and expansion of its adjugate. These are pointwise and unbounded necessary differential identities, not a formal coordinate reduction. The actual full-rank rank4 h=t^2 control atp* has kernel(1,1,4/3,2/15), df(u)=2 and derivative characteristic polynomial(T-2)(T-1)^2(T+4). Exact controls also use the binary nontriangular input and retain a nonzero Haantjes component, so replacing Nijenhuis by Haantjes integrability does not justify a general normal form. No absolute exceptional action conclusion or independent whole-proof review is claimed.

entries.title: Universal collapse of affine and fixed-nilpotent-space normalized inputs, with a sharp quadratic rank bound
entries.scope: For every rankr>=2, a normalized polynomial sweep with full rankDX cannot have nilpotent DP[u] in its kernel direction: KMFI116 forces the nonzero eigenvalue df(u). Hence its matrix image cannot lie in any fixed linear space all of whose matrices are nilpotent, and no constant basis can make all P strictly upper triangular. This is not a restriction on choosing a Jordan frame at one branch point. Affine-linear P is also impossible: the span of its constant and linear coefficient matrices is entirely nilpotent by scaling and polynomial continuation. Thus degreeP>=2 for every full-rank input. Since traceP=0 gives Euler(f)=divg, deg g<=2 forces degf<=1 and affineP; every normalized input with all X coordinates of degree<=2 has rankDX<=r-1. This bound is sharp for X=(p1,p1^2/2,p3,...,pr,0), whose affine P is generically a regular nilpotent block but df kills its kernel and rankDX=r-1. This is a universal restriction on the whole remaining full-rank normalized architecture, including nontriangular rank4 PSL11 candidates, not an absolute obstruction for arbitrary quadratic Keller maps or all architectures. A successful rank4 input needs a g component of degree>=3 and a matrix image outside every fixed linear nilpotent space, in addition to the existing nonfinite boundary and exact group requirements. Written unbounded proof and107 exact controls; no PSL11 field or full action classification is supplied.

entries.title: Centralizer index factorization, rational polarization and finite-lattice power obstruction
entries.scope: For an actual full Weyl tuple F_i,T_i in a scalar finite-PBW algebra or a rank-one finite projective Weyl endomorphism order, let D be the ambient Weyl division ring, W the image division ring, C=L(F_i), H=Cent_D(F_i) commutative, and U=D(H,T_i). Finite generic indices N_l,N_r are supplied by QDI1/QMC1. QPD1 makes H algebraic over C and identifies it with the fraction field of actual commutants. Every finite intermediate J/C is preserved by the translating derivations, and its generated differential-operator division ring has left and right degree [J:C] over W. Bounded divisor degrees inside N_l,N_r imply H/C finite without finite generation of its actual ring. With d=[H:C] and M_l,M_r=[D:U], division-tower dimensions give N_l=d*M_l and N_r=d*M_r. U, d and these whole indices are independent of the chosen flat completion of the same positions. Suppose the actual integral algebra has a faithful formal rank-one frame, the positions are integral with independent classical f_i whose joint Poisson centralizer is K[f_i], and they have a prescribed full polynomial symplectic completion of classical degree delta. QET1 removes actual momentum parameter poles without changing W or U. entries.scope: Let p,q be coprime positive integers and consider three-variable characteristic-zero Keller maps with the same source/output weights(p,-q,-q) and ordinary degree<=7. Every weighted monomial has ordinary degree1+(p+q)*j, so p+q>=7 is affine, sums4..6 give eight one-layer primitive ratios and sum3 gives(2,1),(1,2). entries.title: A reflexive rank-two pencil lattice replaces a global free filtration for faithfully flat plane-target observable maps
dependencies: external: Stacks 0B3N, Lemma 31.13.15, coherent reflexive modules on regular schemes of dimension at most two are locally free
entries.scope: Let A=C[T,V], F=Frac(A), and R be a normal finitely generated complex domain faithfully flat over A with geometrically integral height-one generic fibres. For every transcendental h0 in R_F, the lattice N=(F+F h0) intersection R is A direct_sum A h for some h in R, with F[h] intersection R=A[h]. After scaling h0 into R, an A-derivation D of R with D(h0) nonzero bounds both coefficients of every lattice element inside one finite fractional A-lattice. Flatness and generic integral height-one fibres make pi R a prime divisor for every target pi and preserve scalar valuations. Normality gives N as the intersection of height-one localizations, hence reflexive. The explicit Stacks 0B3N surface lemma makes N finite locally free of rank two. Faithful flatness keeps its constant section nonzero at every target point; its quotient is invertible and the factorial base trivializes it. The resulting h has nonscalar, hence transcendental, height-one reductions and gives polynomial saturation. Consequently, for a genuine closed embedding j:A^(r+2)->A^(r+3), r>=0, carrying a plane Keller pair, that pair is invertible if its ambient observable ring is faithfully flat over A, all height-one generic fibres are geometrically integral, its generic ring has an exhaustive nonnegative filtration with finite-dimensional bounded pieces and geometric generic associated graded domain of degree-zero field, and its normal geometric generic image components are principal. Zero source-fixed class subgroup suffices for the latter. The retained generic component-pencil proof supplies h0; the new saturation gives the literal global image equation, and the smooth constant-derivative minimal-label proof gives degree one. No common global free filtration or global monic presentation is required or inferred. A merely flat map omitting a codimension-two point can have a vanishing constant section and is explicitly excluded. The reflexive dimension restriction is at most two; no higher-target-dimensional generalization, Quillen-Suslin import, arbitrary observable existence, source Hessian invariance, endpoint resolution or unrestricted HC4/JC2 conclusion is asserted.

entries.title: Every disjoint moving multiplier suspension with exact closed content levels forces a carried plane Keller inverse, without a global-frame certificate
dependencies: external: Stacks 00R4, Lemma 10.128.1, miracle flatness for a regular local base and Cohen-Macaulay source with the dimension equality
entries.scope: Let A(T,X) in C[T,X] be nonzero, P(T,Z) in C[T,Z] have positive joint Z degree, and X,Z be disjoint sets of p,k>=1 variables. Let delta_A be the gcd in C[T] of all X coefficients of A. If every P(c,Z) at a zero c of delta_A is nonconstant and closed over C, every genuine closed stable embedding carrying a plane Keller pair through (T,A(T,X)Y-P(T,Z)) forces its polynomial inverse for all r>=p+k-1. In particular every primitive multiplier is covered with arbitrary P. All coefficient, multiplier, parameter, root, source, embedding and variable degrees and all admitted stable dimensions are unrestricted. There is no global-frame, leading-unit, leading-divisibility, Bezout-template or special source-fibre hypothesis. At each T=c the second observable is nonconstant, so all closed target fibres are nonempty of the expected dimension; the regular sequence T-c,V-d and explicit Stacks 00R4 miracle-flatness lemma give faithful flatness of the ambient observable map. HC4MYIM2 gives exactly the required geometric height-one fibre integrality. Over F only, weights d on X,Y and a+1 on Z give the generic associated graded domain A_a Y-P_d by primitive linearity and disjointness; no global basis is inferred. HC4MYIM1 supplies generic smoothness and zero source-fixed class subgroup. HC4MYIN0 therefore supplies a primitive global pencil coordinate and closes the carried inverse. Nonconstant content is allowed when the content levels are closed; in one Z variable they must have degree one. A constant content level already forbids a carried Keller pair by HC4MYIM2. Nonconstant composite content levels remain outside this theorem, and their failure is not a Keller realization. Ambient and target polynomial automorphism orbits inherit the conclusion. The explicit primitive moving multiplier 1+T X1^2+(T+1)X1 X2^2 has closed HC4 identity embeddings for arbitrary P and an actual unit-Hessian quadratic pullback. Missing global frames are no longer a frontier for the disjoint exact-content family. Overlapping variables, other output geometries, compatible arbitrary-graph observables, actual endpoint representatives, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.title: Rigidity and exact polynomial field reduction for every scalar-times-linear homogeneous H
entries.scope: For a normalized full-rank sweep in rankr>=2 with homogeneous H=g-fp=F(p)Mp, F of positive degreen and M arbitrary constant, M is invertible with r distinct eigenvalues a_i, and f=-cF for nonzero constantc not an eigenvalue ofM. After a constant linear source and matched normalized target change, F=kappa product p_i^b_i with positive integerb_i, n=sum b_i>=r, and det(TI-[diag(a_i)+a b^t])=(T-c)^r. Conversely these constant conditions give polynomial normalized full-rank inputs. No diagonal or monomial assumption is built into the hypothesis: determinant and resolvent identities, locally nilpotent linear derivations on polynomials, and the full-rank test exclude repeated and Jordan eigenvalues and force the monomial form. Forh=gcd(b_i), m_i=b_i/h, W=product p_i^m_i and C=product Y_i^m_i, the exact field has r-1 common toric spectators and C=W product(A+a_i*kappa*W^h)^m_i, of degreeN=n+1, with explicit inverse p_i=Y_i/(A+a_i*kappa W^h), gamma=A+c*kappa W^h. Its derivative is (A+c*kappa W^h)^r product(A+a_i*kappa W^h)^(m_i-1). The actual axis fiber is always the distinguished point, so this is an entire architecture in the KMFI120 one-point case. These statements are unbounded in n,r and classify factorization/integrability and exact fields, not every homogeneous H or all Keller actions.

entries.title: Every polynomial over an arbitrary independent extension of the parameter field stays irreducible after adding a plane Keller second component
dependencies: external: Stacks 00FV, Theorem 10.34.1(1), finite-type algebras over an algebraically closed field have rational closed points
external: Stacks 0BU7, inertia restriction surjectivity in finite Galois towers, retained from HC4MYIM0
entries.scope: For a complex plane Keller pair (f,g), let k=C(T), L=C(s,t), T=f. For every extension field D/k, define the independent source field L_D=Frac(L tensor_k D), a domain by the retained regular-parameter theorem. Every nonconstant P in D[Z_1,...,Z_q] has P+g irreducible over L_D, in every coefficient, field, source, polynomial and variable degree. This allows the polynomial coefficients themselves to be algebraic over C(T), rather than only adjoining parameters to a polynomial already over C(T). For finite Galois E/k containing the coefficients, take the splitting field N/E(V) and a Galois closure M/C(T,V). Relative inertia over a horizontal curve whose original-target image has no polynomial A1 parametrization lifts surjectively in M/E(V), equals the inertia of M/C(T,V) because E(V)/C(T,V) is horizontal-unramified, and lies in the original plane source image by HC4MYII0/3. It fixes E and hence restricts into the source subgroup over L E. The resulting normal bad subgroup gives polynomial blocks over E by retained ordinary Luroth and the unique-pole argument. Every outer critical branch curve must have parametrizable original-target image; its algebraic critical value is therefore integral over C[T]. The retained valuation lemma over the algebraic coefficient field supplies an integral centered monic model over a finite parameter curve, and HC4MYIK0 proves outer irreducibility over the actual enlarged source. Block transitivity proves the finite-coefficient theorem after every finite enlargement, hence for all polynomials over k_bar over L k_bar. A proper factor over an arbitrary independent coefficient field spreads in a fixed basis of L k_bar over k_bar(g) to a finite coefficient algebra with degree and denominator guards. Explicit Stacks 00FV specialization gives a k_bar-valued closed point preserving the factor, a contradiction. The retained generative-polynomial transfer gives all multivariable P. The tensor construction is essential: coefficients identified with the original source g are not allowed, and P=U^2-g would otherwise contradict the statement. No plane theorem is applied to a parameter-cover source; vertical parameter inertia is not asserted trivial. This is plane-only irreducibility, not full splitting-group preservation or an unrestricted HC4/JC2 conclusion.

entries.title: A surviving polynomial direction on every multiplier component kills generic source-fixed classes despite overlapping multiplier and root coefficients
entries.scope: Let k=C(T), A in k[X] be nonzero, P in k[X,Z], with p=#X>=1,q=#Z>=1, and allow arbitrary X dependence in P. Require P modulo each geometric irreducible factor a_j of A to retain positive joint Z degree; the condition is empty for a generic parameter-unit multiplier. Over Omega=algebraic closure of C(T,V), the generic ring Omega[X,Y,Z,W]/(A Y-P-V) is smooth with exact class group direct_sum_j Z^(m_j)/Z(1,...,1), where m_j is the number of geometric components of the restricted generic level on a_j=0. The numbers may differ by row and are not the joint degree of P. Every removed divisor component dominates its multiplier component: a vertical component would force all positive Z coefficients and P_0+V to vanish identically on a coefficient-zero divisor defined over k_bar, impossible for transcendental V. Generic reducedness of each restricted level gives div(a_j)=sum_i D_(j,i) with multiplicity one, independently of the exponent of a_j in A. Inverting A gives a polynomial localization UFD; its only units provide exactly those row relations. After a finite algebraic parameter extension E splits the rows, the independently extended source over E_j=Frac(E[X]/a_j) remains transitive on the restricted geometric components by HC4MYIO0. The subgroup fixing E therefore has zero fixed subgroup in every row lattice, and so does the full plane source group. This proves generic class vanishing with arbitrary overlapping X coefficients, in all degrees and variable counts. It does not itself supply a positive generic filtration, geometric height-one integral fibres or a carried inverse. Losing the residual polynomial direction, for example A=X,P=X Z, can instead make the multiplier a nonconstant generic unit. Full splitting groups, all overlap geometries, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 are not resolved.

entries.title: Overlapping polynomial-direction outputs with exact closed content levels and a generic positive filtration force the carried inverse; monic and Bezout leading families supply it uniformly
entries.scope: Take A in C[T,X] nonzero and P in C[T,X,Z], p=#X>=1,q=#Z>=1, with P modulo each generic geometric multiplier factor retaining positive joint Z degree. Let delta_A(T) be the gcd of the X coefficients of A. Every affine height-one generic fibre is geometrically integral if and only if every P(c,X,Z), for a root c of delta_A, is nonconstant closed over C. Horizontal fibres use the residual polynomial direction, and vertical fibres with A(c,X) nonzero use the independent V. At a content zero use the retained generative-field proof for the full overlapping polynomial P(c,X,Z). This condition gives faithful flatness by nonconstant closed-level observables and the retained regular-sequence/miracle-flatness proof. If the generic ambient ring also has the positive filtration required by HC4MYIN0, every genuine closed stable embedding carrying a plane Keller pair through (T,A(T,X)Y-P(T,X,Z)) forces its polynomial inverse for all r>=p+q-1, with all coefficient, source, embedding, parameter and variable degrees unrestricted. HC4MYIO1 supplies principal generic image components, and HC4MYIN0 gives the global primitive pencil and saturation without any common global free filtration. One generic certificate is a positive weighting with primitive-linear highest equation A_top Y-P_top. entries.title: Galois residue fields and finite quantum symmetries of Long lifts
entries.scope: Let D be a division ring with a discrete valuation of group Z, a central uniformizer h, and commutative characteristic-zero residue field k. A finite group G of automorphisms fixing h need not preserve the valuation. For W=D^G, construct rational selectors for the distinct conjugate valuation branches. Weighted Reynolds averaging shows that the residue field e of W is the fixed field of the valuation stabilizer H acting on k. Its action is faithful: a finite-order automorphism with identity residue action would have a nonzero first h coefficient multiplied by its order. Hence k/e is Galois of degree delta=|H|. A self-contained division-ring Artin null-vector argument gives generic left/right indices at most |G|; branch-separated residue bases give at least r*delta, with r=|G|/|H|. Thus both generic indices equal |G|=r*delta and their loss at the selected completion is delta*(r-1), with What=Dhat^H. This proves the residue-Galois requirement without invariant valuation, invariant finite order, finite-center hypotheses or an external generic index-symmetry theorem. More generally valuation-preserving automorphisms fixing a subring with finite separable residue extension inject into its classical deck group; first nonzero differences would define a forbidden residue derivation. If a generic index equals the residue degree, or for the completed extension itself, residue-basis bounds on automorphisms followed by taking powers force isometry without assuming continuity. A full symplectic quantum frame has completed and actual division centralizer L=K((h)), by h-adic Poisson induction. With finite generic indices, distinct automorphisms fixing the full image are inequivalent modulo inner automorphisms and linearly independent as D-valued functions, so their entire group is finite. For Long, the full irreducible cubic r*a^3-2*a^2+s*a+4*t has discriminant Delta=4*s^2-4*r*s^3+128*t-144*r*s*t-432*r^2*t^2. Its t-discriminant is 256*(4-3*r*s)^3, so Delta is squarefree and nonsquare even after constant algebraic extension. The classical field degree is3, its Galois closure group is S3, and its deck group is trivial. Therefore every full formal Long completed extension has trivial automorphism group. No actual Long full image division ring W can equal D^G for any finite group of ambient L-linear division automorphisms, even with parameter poles or valuation movement. This covers nonpositional corrections, QMC1 rank-one projective carrier realizations, identity stabilization and arbitrary rational source/target division transport of the full image. It does not fix or require a position field. For an actual bounded lift or finite-left full carrier, let g be the order of the entire group Aut_W(D), and let F=D^Aut_W(D). Its valuation stabilizer is trivial, F completes to all Dhat, g divides each generic index N_l,N_r and N_l,N_r>=3*g. Either index below6 forces the entire generic automorphism group to be trivial. No equality of arbitrary generic left/right indices is assumed. Exact controls verify both discriminants, squarefreeness, a cyclic rational degree3 quotient with Galois reduction, and a parameter-pole involution fixing U=x+h*x^2,V=(1+2*h*x)^-1*p with N=2,delta=1 and two valuation branches. Its rational selector and averaged residue are checked exactly. Both rational positive controls independently fail QCI1 finite-lattice admission. Finite S3 and cyclic normalizer controls distinguish a cubic source from its larger Galois closure. All universal group, valuation, centralizer, index and all-degree Long statements use written proofs. Tikaradze fixed-ring rigidity is comparison context only. A larger Galois closure with D as an intermediate subgroup-fixed ring, genuinely different nonsymmetric embeddings and general higher-rank matrix actions are not excluded. entries.title: Complete primitive opposite-weight degree7 classification by three diagonal coefficients
entries.scope: Let m>=2,q>=1 be coprime integers over any characteristic-zero field. Every three-variable Keller map equivariant for the same source/output weights(m,-q,-m), of ordinary degree<=7, is an automorphism. Distinct tangent weights allow diagonal output normalization to identity. With u=a*c,v=a^q*b^m the full weighted modules are F1=a*f(u,v),F2=b*g(u,v),F3=c*h(u,v)+a^(q-1)*b^m*k(v). The b=0 Jacobian g(u,0)*(u*f(u,0)*h(u,0))prime=1 eliminates every u-only coefficient by polynomial units. The full remaining degree7 model has f=1+A*v+B*u*v+C*v^2,g=1+D*v+E*u*v+G*v^2,h=1+H*v+I*u*v+K*v^2,k=L+M*v, with unavailable coefficients zero. Three universal diagonal Jacobian coefficients and all seven actual nonzero supports force B=E=I=0 by positive integer scalar factors. The residual Jacobian is h*[g*(f+q*v*fprime)+m*v*f*gprime]. Polynomial units and the nonzero leading scalar1+q*deg(f)+m*deg(g) force f=g=h=1. Precisely all normalized maps are (a,b,c+a^(q-1)*b^m*k(a^q*b^m)) with shear degree(m+q-1)+(m+q)*j<=7, and inverse obtained by subtraction. Written module/field/degree arguments cover every weight, including m+q>=9 by an immediate degree bound. The independent stdlib rational checker reconstructs169 complete source atoms and43 boundary-reduced atoms across fourteen primitive pairs with3<=m+q<=8, every boundary and actual invariant determinant, three symbolic-weight coefficients, seven support masks, nine leading-degree cases and fourteen non-affine explicit inverse controls. This closes the proposed(2,-1,-2) gate and its full primitive opposite-weight extension without a support or flag restriction. entries.title: One relative locally nilpotent derivation moving the image equation replaces generic positive filtrations in the carried plane Keller inverse criterion
entries.scope: Let a genuine closed embedding j:A^(r+2)->A^(r+3), r>=0, carry a complex plane Keller pair through ambient observables, with target B=C[T,V], F=Frac(B), polynomial ambient ring R and prime image equation E. Assume R is faithfully flat over B, all affine height-one generic target fibres are geometrically integral, R_Omega for Omega=F_bar is normal, and every geometric generic image component is principal. Zero source-fixed class subgroup suffices for the last hypothesis. If an F-locally nilpotent derivation D of R_F has D(E) nonzero, the Keller pair is a polynomial automorphism in every degree and stable dimension. No generic positive filtration, global free filtration, scalar degree-zero kernel, finite-dimensional degree pieces, slice or free additive action is required. The standard degree delta_D(a)=max{n:D^n(a) nonzero} is additive by the iterated Leibniz formula. All units have degree zero, so the degree of a principal component generator is unchanged by any unit ambiguity. Relative F-definition gives equal conjugate component degrees; D(E) nonzero makes them positive. A unit restricts to a scalar on each affine-space component, and its difference from that scalar cannot be a nonzero multiple of a positive-degree generator. Thus scalar geometric generic units are deduced, not assumed. For disjoint generators e_j-c_ij=b_ij e_i, degree additivity first gives degree b_ij zero; reducing on the opposite affine-space component makes b_ij scalar modulo e_j, and the same degree contradiction makes it scalar in the whole ring. Normalize the generators in an arbitrary F-basis to get a common descended pencil h0-alpha_i. Rank-two reflexive descent supplies global saturation, and the retained smooth constant-derivative minimal-label proof gives degree one. Ordinary derivations without local nilpotence do not supply this argument. All prior proof and receipt bytes are preserved. No arbitrary observable existence, nonlinear source Hessian invariance, endpoint resolution or unrestricted HC4/JC2 conclusion is asserted. In the general IP0/1 criterion the geometric generic ring is explicitly a normal domain; the overlap application already proves this by primitive linearity.

entries.title: Nonautomorphic carried plane Keller images are fixed by every relative additive action; a trivial relative Makar-Limanov invariant forces the inverse
entries.scope: Under faithful flatness, geometric height-one integral fibres, generic normality and principal geometric generic image components as in HC4MYIP0, every nonautomorphic carried plane Keller pair has D(E)=0 for every F-locally nilpotent derivation of R_F. This is the contrapositive of the moved-image theorem, with no generic positive filtration or scalar generic unit hypothesis. Multiplying a generic relative derivation by a nonzero target polynomial clearing its values on finitely many ambient generators gives an actual locally nilpotent derivation of R, since that multiplier is in its kernel. Thus generic invariance yields global relative additive actions, without claiming freeness at exceptional levels or linearization. Conversely, any supplied family of relative locally nilpotent derivations with joint kernel exactly F forces the polynomial inverse: E is not in F because its geometric generic zero set is nonempty, so one derivation moves it. A finite family suffices; in particular trivial relative Makar-Limanov invariant, the intersection of kernels of all F-locally nilpotent derivations, suffices. Joint kernels commute with this field scalar extension by expressing an element in finitely many F-linearly independent Omega coefficients; consequently a joint-constant certificate also gives scalar geometric units, though the moved-image theorem already deduces them when needed. A single action fixing E does not imply nonautomorphy, nor does its kernel equal the full relative Makar-Limanov invariant without checking other actions. No classification of additive actions, global or generic positive filtration, arbitrary observable existence or source Hessian invariance is imported. Both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open. In the general IP0/1 criterion the geometric generic ring is explicitly a normal domain; the overlap application already proves this by primitive linearity.

entries.title: Every surviving polynomial-direction overlap image has a multiplier-only generic equation, and primitive content gives its global target-helper equation
entries.scope: For (T,M(T,X)Y-P(T,X,Z)), p=#X>=1,q=#Z>=1,r>=p+q-1, require positive joint Z degree of P modulo every generic geometric multiplier factor and nonconstant closed full polynomials P(c,X,Z) at zeros of the multiplier coefficient content. These are the residual-direction and exact content hypotheses of HC4MYIO1/2, but no generic positive filtration is assumed. They give faithful flatness, geometric height-one integral fibres, generic smoothness and zero source-fixed class subgroup. Natural global locally nilpotent directions D_i(Z_j)=delta_ij M, D_i(Y)=P_Zi, D_i(T)=D_i(X)=D_i(W)=0, together with unused-variable partial derivatives, preserve both observables. After inverting M their joint kernel is F[X,1/M]. Every removed divisor dominates its multiplier component and has valuation one on its factor, so no denominator in M is regular unless it cancels. Their exact joint kernel in R_F is therefore F[X]. A nonautomorphic carried pair must have image equation E in F[X] by HC4MYIP1. Thus every actual image equation outside that subring forces the Keller inverse, even when no generic filtration is known. If M has primitive coefficient content, M remains nonzero at every height-one target prime; localization at M injects kappa(pi)[X] into its fibre. Coefficient valuation then gives F[X] intersection R=C[T,V,X], and the actual global image equation has form E(T,M Y-P,X) for E(T,V,X) in C[T,V,X]. This stronger global descent is not asserted without a content-level X-injectivity check; M=T,P=X gives the exact countercontrol (X+V)/T=Y. Under nonautomorphy the natural directions descend to the actual source polynomial ring and fix the original source coordinates s,t, since C(s,t)/C(f,g) is finite separable; they move only stable variables. This does not prove those actions free, linear or simultaneously rectifiable, or make an invariant image a nonautomorphic realization. The generic multiplier-only image equation is a uniform necessary condition in all degrees and admitted stable dimensions. entries.title: Every polynomial root-only signal-retaining correction is Keller exactly when its self equation holds and its effective dependency graph is acyclic

entries.title: Complete degree-free polynomial multiplier criterion for each homogeneous primitive direction
entries.scope: For homogeneous normalized full-rank inputs write H=g-fp=F V with primitive homogeneous V of degreed, scalar F of degrees>=0, and A=DV. entries.title: Ramification and admission of finite quantum closure carriers
entries.scope: Let A_R be the finite-PBW Weyl algebra over R=K[[t]], characteristic zero, with central quantum parameter a(t)=t^e*u(t), e>=1 and u a unit. Normality of S gives B intersect k=S. Separability forces all integral Dtilde commutators below quantum order e to vanish. Successive sub-quantum left/right differences force the first e-1 correction coefficients into B intersect k=S, giving finite polynomial left lifts P_i with F_i-P_i divisible by t^e. Saturation then gives scalar-potential connections nabla_i(b)={psi_i,b}-c_i*b preserving J, with arbitrary rational c_i in k. The potentials cancel on multipliers, so every psi_i Hamiltonian preserves B; these fields span all coordinate derivations. Differentially stable Fitting ideals make B locally free, and its generically zero relative differentials vanish. Thus B/S is finite etale. When e=1, the right F_i may even lie in O_Dtilde: their first corrections c_i lie in ell and still cancel on multipliers. The arbitrary-parameter-order statement retains F_i in D. In particular ell/k has no ramification over S. For Long, the full S3 closure of its degree-three source/output field extension is the quadratic extension ell=K(r,a,v,d)(w), w^2=Q=(3*r*a-2)^2-8*r*v, with ell=K(r,a,w,d) rational as a field. The other roots are (2-r*a plus/minus w)/(2*r). The cyclic map on centered roots (A,w), A=3*r*a-2, is ((-A+3*w)/2,-(A+w)/2), and the source-fixed involution sends w to -w. Since partial_v Q=-8*r, the quadratic closure is ramified there and partial_v w=-4*r/w has a pole. This is a reduction potential, not an asserted multiplicative filtration. Normal rational corrections preserve the old pole grade and have at most a simple divisor pole; that pole appears only when input rho is at least tau+1. Therefore B(output)+1<=B(input) on pole terms, and nonpole terms cannot increase the budget. entries.title: Exact scalar self-response reduces to a nonlinear Laurent equation with a complete rational-exception classification
entries.scope: Characteristic zero. For a retained compiler block with arbitrary fixed polynomial coefficient profiles and one affine coefficient direction, UAM1 and UAROOTDAG1 give source coordinates sigma,S,r and an embedding of the entire source ring into k(u,sigma)[S,S^-1,r,r^-1]. UAPROFILE1 gives the frozen determinant. With h0=S+sigma*S^3+background, V the nonzero direction polynomial, A=S*h0_second-h0_prime, B=S*V_second-V_prime and L=S*V_prime/V, the exact Jacobian is 1+V/(r*S) times E(g), E(g)=S*g_S+((1-L)*r+A+B*g)*g_r. The coefficient response depends on g; a first integral of its value at g=0 is not automatically admissible. More generally over every characteristic-zero field K, A in K[S] with A(0)=-1 and V of order e>=3, every Laurent solution E(g)=0 is either constant in K or V=v*S^j is monomial and g is the explicit affine-r exceptional branch in the proof. Lowest/highest r degrees force g=a(S)r+b(S); reciprocal Riccati gives a=V/(S*(C+W)), W_prime=V*B/S^2, ord W=2e-2, deg W=2d-2. Laurent divisibility excludes C nonzero and every nonmonomial V. No bounded degree search or analytic PDE theorem is used. This is a field/domain result, not a positive-characteristic or nonreduced-base classification.

entries.title: Every whole polynomial Keller extension along one scalar coefficient line already has retained-signal effective profiles
entries.scope: Characteristic zero fields with any promoted identity parameters u. In one normalized compiler block retain sigma and put a_j=a_j0(u,sigma)+c_j(u,sigma)*g(u,x,y,z), finitely many j>=4, fixed polynomial background/direction and a nonzero effective direction. For polynomial g, Keller is equivalent to determinant1 and g in k[u,sigma]. The stronger statement permits ANY rational source g whenever the resulting rational map extends polynomially on the whole original source: it is Keller exactly when g lies in k(u,sigma) and every EFFECTIVE a_j0+c_j*g is in k[u,sigma]. UASELFLAUR1 r-degree reduction, a leading source-plane regularity balance and reciprocal Riccati prove this: any nonunit nonzero constant determinant would instead force determinant0; simultaneous regularity of both response outputs excludes nonmonomial rational branches; the remaining monomial branch has universal B-output residue -j/(j-2) on y=0. UAPROFILE1 and comparison of the y=0 C-output powers descend effective profiles over the identity parameter ring. A rational g may cancel common retained-signal direction factors and need not itself be polynomial; a polynomial g becomes polynomial in sigma by the section x=y=0. Allowed maps lie in the existing UAALLATOM1 profile family with effective degree at least3 and absolute stable self-atomicity. UAMARKEDDEF1 marked vanishing alone does not ensure Keller self-consistency. No classification of curved coefficient families, multiple affine directions, mutually changing blocks or degenerate zero directions after specialization is asserted.

entries.title: Marked scalar feedback integrates to every finite order and formally but not to an entire polynomial family in its fixed coefficient line
entries.scope: For the cubic background and one coefficient j>=4 in characteristic zero, define R_j=X^(j-1)*(q+sigma/(j-1))-3*X^(j+1)/(j+1), D_j=sigma^2*X^(2j-2), c_j=j*(j-2)/(2*(j-1)). UASELFLAUR1 response at g=0 kills R_j, but self-control g=lambda*R_j has exact determinant defect lambda^2*j*(j-2)*R_j*sigma^3*X^(3j-3)*t. The rational control lambda*R_j/(1+c_j*lambda*D_j) solves the full nonlinear determinant equation on its actual source open set. It has a genuine source pole. Its geometric series has polynomial source coefficients of unbounded degree: every truncation gives an exact polynomial Keller self-map over k[lambda]/lambda^(L+1), and the compatible formal map lies in k[x,y,z][[lambda]], generally not k[[lambda]][x,y,z]. UASELFCTRL1 excludes any finite polynomial lambda-family in the same coefficient line with tangent R_j, even when rational-control response cancellation is allowed under whole-source landing. Replacing lambda by lambda*I(sigma)^ell preserves the entire target thickening V(I(a)^ell); UAMARKEDDEF1 with I(T)=T(3T-1)(4T+1) retains complete filter fibres with no hidden points. Finite-order/formal insertion in UACANFIB1 retains Spec(A) by beta idempotence and sigma_aux=beta/3, but preserves the old factors. No formal generic-degree claim, new canonical atom, arbitrary multi-direction nonintegration theorem or all-base polynomial family is asserted.

entries.title: Affine eigen-coordinate rigidity for a cyclic projective vector field
entries.scope: For any rational vector fieldv in characteristic zero, setB=Dv andW=v-x. If W is cyclic forB and a rationalq satisfiesdq*B=c*dq andW(q)=(c-1)*q for a constantc, thenq is affine. Differentiating the eigenrow equation gives Hess(q)*B=B^t*Hess(q); differentiating the Darboux equation gives Hess(q)*W0. Cyclicity then kills the whole Hessian. No triangularity or polynomiality ofv is assumed. The nonlinear countercontrol v=(x,2t+x^2),q=t+x^2 satisfies both eigen-identities but has noncyclicW, showing why the cyclic hypothesis is essential. This rigidity lemma alone does not classify all normalized fields or decide any previously open absolute action. Written unbounded proof and exact differentiated-identity/countercontrols.

entries.title: Complete constant-diagonal triangular projective homogeneous architecture in every rank and degree
entries.scope: For every rankr>=2 and homogeneous degreed>=1, letV0=u^d andVi=a_i*u^(d-1)*x_i+u^d*Qi(x1/u,...,x(i-1)/u), with arbitrary constantsa_i and arbitrary triangular projective polynomialsQi of degree<=d. If H=g-fp=F*V with any nonzero homogeneous polynomial scalarF is normalized and has full rankDXr, allQi are affine, and thea_i are nonzero, pairwise distinct and different from1. The full Krylov determinant is detB*det(W,BW,...), B=Dv,W=v-x, soW is cyclic. Descending spectral-adjugate elimination at the last curved coordinate handles repeated/resonant eigenvalues without genericity. Polynomiality forces a positive integer multiplier divisorq=xk+S; residue equations onq0, together with a quotient-cyclicity argument valid on that graph, make dq the exact left eigenrow. KMFI128 forcesq affine, and a constant triangular homogeneous change removes that curvature. Repeating makes every originalQi affine. ThusV=u^(d-1)*M*p with constant distinct-spectrumM; all surviving multipliers are exactly KMFI121 withG=F*u^(d-1) and the u-exponent divisibility condition. Every primitive degree>=2 direction in this whole coupled-curvature architecture is excluded to full rank in every scalar degree, and all its degree11 fields are S11,A11 or regularC11 by KMFI122. Exact controls retain an affine-coupled full-rank survivor and a genuinely nonlinear coupled normalized rank3 input, so normalization alone is not excluded. Written all-rank/all-degree proof plus75 exact controls. Nonconstant projective diagonal, arbitrary nontriangular directions, nonhomogeneous fields, absolute exceptional11 and the full action spectrum remain open.

entries.title: An actual stable source image contained in the multiplier divisor forces the plane Keller inverse in every helper count
entries.scope: Let k=C(T), F=k(V), L=C(s,t) for a complex plane Keller pair T=f,V=g. Take nonzero M in k[X] with p>=1 multiplier helpers and P in k[X,Z] with q>=1 root variables, requiring P modulo every geometric factor of M to retain positive joint Z degree. If a genuine closed stable hypersurface embedding carries the pair through (T,M Y-P) and M vanishes identically on its image, then [L:F]=1 and the polynomial inverse follows. This holds in every admitted stable dimension and all degrees, without a global content-fibre hypothesis. The selected geometric generic source component is a removed prime D_(j,i), so its source stabilizer H fixes its uniquely determined multiplier row. That row action factors through a finite Galois parameter extension E/k. HC4MYHX0 makes H surject onto the full parameter group, hence the selected row is target-fixed. HC4MYIO1 makes Gal(Omega/L E) transitive within the row, but it fixes the selected component, so the row has one component. The unique component of a target-fixed row is target-fixed; its actual source orbit has size [L:F], forcing degree one. No premature inversion of M, Galois hypothesis on L/F, parameter-cover source realization, arbitrary graph normal form or endpoint closure is asserted.

entries.title: Every two-helper polynomial-direction overlap with exact closed content levels forces a carried plane Keller inverse in every stable dimension and degree
entries.scope: Take X=(X1,X2), q>=1 root variables Z, nonzero M(T,X) in C[T,X] and P(T,X,Z) in C[T,X,Z]. Require positive joint Z degree after reduction modulo every generic geometric multiplier factor, and nonconstant closed full P(c,X,Z) at every zero of the coefficient content of M. Every genuine closed embedding carrying a complex plane Keller pair through (T,M(T,X)Y-P(T,X,Z)), for all r>=q+1 with u=r-q-1 unused variables, forces its polynomial inverse. All source, coefficient, multiplier, root, parameter and embedding degrees and stable dimensions are unrestricted. Under hypothetical nonautomorphy IP2 puts the actual generic image equation E_F in F[X1,X2]. IR0 first closes an image inside M=0; otherwise E_F and M have no common geometric helper factor. The common zero set of M and all positive-root coefficients of P in the helper plane is finite over C(T)_bar. Transcendental V makes its generic forgetful fibres empty, while every other nonempty fibre has expected dimension q+u. The retained Stacks 00R4 theorem proves generic forgetful flatness without assuming faithfulness. Each helper-curve pullback is flat over its curve domain and embeds into its polynomial generic fibre, so it is a domain with no hidden vertical components or nilpotents. Reducedness of the actual geometric source gives multiplicity one and a bijection between helper curves and [L:F] actual affine-space components. A dominant polynomial map from affine space to an integral affine curve is surjective: restrict to a nonconstant line, whose parameter is integral over the curve algebra, and apply lying over. Curve units are scalar by injection into the polynomial source ring. Thus the actual disjoint source components give disjoint helper curves with scalar units. Equal ordinary helper degrees of their normalized Galois-conjugate equations make their pairwise differences scalar and descend a common h0 in F[X1,X2], with E_F=Q(h0) and deg Q=[L:F]. IQ0 makes deg Q=1, giving the inverse. No generic positive ambient filtration, monic/Bezout certificate, primitive content, forgetful faithfulness, curve normalization classification, action classification, rectification or stable cancellation is required. The curve argument is proved directly and does not claim surface dominance implies surjectivity. Residual-direction failures, composite content levels, three or more helpers in larger stable dimensions, both plane endpoints and unrestricted HC4/JC2 remain open.

entries.scope: At HC4 size r=2, polynomial-direction overlaps (T,M(T,X)Y-P(T,X,Z)) have p=#X>=1,q=#Z>=1,u>=0 and p+q+u=3. entries.title: All-degree monodromy orbit-tree obstruction and exact unbounded eta0 trefoil winding gate
entries.scope: For ANY connected finite-degree branched cover of a link exterior cut along a finite tree of disjoint tori, every lifted piece is an orbit of its vertex monodromy image and every lifted torus is an orbit of the peripheral edge image, in one consistently based sheet action. This yields the connected monodromy orbit multigraph G_rho. Filling EVERY branch-boundary torus, including fixed unramified sheets, does not change this graph because each solid torus attaches within one piece. The lifted cutting tori need not be a minimal JSJ decomposition or incompressible. The H0 Mayer--Vietoris sequence gives H1(M,Z) onto Z^g with g=sum_edge orb(H_e)-sum_vertex orb(H_v)+1, at EVERY finite cover degree, EVERY finite torus-decomposition tree and EVERY cabling length; regular or symmetric monodromy and simple branching are not assumed for this graph theorem. For an actual smooth affine normalization containing A2 with omitted disjoint affine lines, PF61 makes H1 of the full source end finite, so g=0 and the COMPLETE orbit graph MUST be a tree. Smoothness remains explicit in higher degrees. This is a necessary condition, not a sufficient affine or finite-cover realization criterion. For a single cabling torus with both companion and cable images transitive, the peripheral image must be transitive abelian and hence regular; every companion meridian must therefore be semiregular, excluding mixed cycle lengths in all degrees. In degree4 such simultaneous transitivity requires a 4-cycle meridian: identity fails normal generation, mixed cycle types fail regularity, and a double transposition would normally generate a transitive subgroup of A4, but in its only transitive subgroups V4 and A4 its normal closure is proper. No d-cycle assertion is made in general higher degrees. A two-letter orbit-incidence control over a three-vertex path shows that EVERY separate one-edge graph may be a tree while the whole graph has a four-cycle; it is not claimed to be a knot presentation. For the ENTIRE immersive primitive actual-binomial two-stage trefoil class, degX=3w,degY=2w,F=X^2-Y^3 has primitive final key degree k<6w with gcd(k,w)=1,w>=2, PF60 and PF59 force eta=k-w-1=0, hence k=w+1 and infinity knot C_(w,w+1)(T2,3). General lower-weight keys are NOT assumed binomial. The retained positive root amalgam has a^2=b^3,M=a*b^-1,L=a^2*M^-6,h=M^(w+1)L^w,z^w=h,beta=M^-1L^-1,mu=z*beta,lambda=h*mu^-w(w+1). Actual S4 monodromy, mu a transposition and lambda1 force h1 because w(w+1) is even. ALL peripheral representations are exactly the permutations a,b,beta,tau satisfying a^2=b^3,M=beta^w,L=beta^(-w-1),(tau*beta)^w=1 and full S4 image. The exact exponent12 of S4 proves that this ENTIRE representation set and its orbit graphs depend only on w mod12, giving an unbounded reduction rather than a finite-winding extrapolation. Exhaustive simultaneous-conjugacy counts are: residue2 gives72 representations/3 tree classes; residue3 gives72/3 tree classes; residue8 gives168/7 classes of which4 are trees and3 have cycle rank1; residue9 gives144/6 tree classes; all other residues give none. Every conjugacy orbit has24 representations. All three rejected w8mod12 classes have companion image A4 and cable image S4, both transitive, with peripheral C3 having two orbits. They have positive end b1 at EVERY winding in that residue and fail for every smooth affine source of PF61. At w8 they agree exactly with the three previously computed Z+Z/26 covers; their torsion26 is not extrapolated to larger w. The fixed winding2 fails determinant-square9 but its entire residue must not be discarded: larger congruent windings can pass. PF55 requires9 to divide the actual infinity determinant, which in this eta0 family is w+1 for even w and3w for odd w. Exact CRT with the full representation table therefore requires w=3 mod6 OR w=8 mod18. More finely even w8mod36 has seven peripheral classes of which only four pass the graph test; even w26mod36 has three peripheral classes, all trees. All other windings in this actual-binomial trefoil class are excluded, uniformly in every target coefficient and source pole/ruling. Passing (1) and the graph test supplies no polynomial realization for arbitrary w, sign Picard certificate, affine S4 extension, finite quartic normalization or marked plane source. The whole source lattice, full linking form, canonical marking and affine algebra remain required. Written all-degree graph proofs, the exact finite-period proof and139 exact controls are retained. No symplectic filling classification, named boundary-manifold identification, finite-search extrapolation, full quartic or higher-degree exclusion, finite Keller map, formal verification, independent full reproof, external review, novelty priority or goal completion is claimed.

entries.title: Every plane Keller pair has a canonical closed two-helper graph with smooth geometrically integral observable fibres everywhere and no residual root direction
entries.scope: For any complex plane Keller pair K=(f,g), take ambient coordinates (T,X1,X2,Y,Z), M=f(X)-T, V=M Y+g(X), and the literal closed graph j(s,t,u,v)=(f(s,t),s,t,u,v). For every algebraically closed extension k/C and every target a,b, the fibre equation (f-a)Y+g-b is primitive irreducible because a common factor of f-a and g-b would divide the nonzero constant Keller Jacobian. Its helper derivatives satisfy f_1 H_2-f_2 H_1=J(K), so every geometric target fibre is smooth and integral of expected dimension three. Nonemptiness follows by choosing f(X)!=a and solving for Y. The retained regular-base Cohen-Macaulay miracle-flatness theorem gives global faithful flatness, and the generic ambient ring is a smooth normal domain. entries.title: The universal failed-direction modification has class lattice Z^d modulo the diagonal and source-fixed class vanishing exactly at Keller field degree one
entries.scope: For the canonical graph of IS0 put F=C(T,V), L=C(s,t) via T=f,V=g, d=[L:F], Omega=F_bar containing L, and S=Omega[X1,X2,Y,Z]/((f-T)Y+g-V). HX0 makes f-T absolutely irreducible over C(T), hence irreducible over Omega. Localizing M=f-T gives the UFD Omega[X1,X2,1/M,Z] with units Omega* M^Z. The unlocalized quotient S/(M) is the product of d copies of Omega[Y,Z], indexed by the embeddings of the finite separable field L/F. All d exceptional source divisors have multiplicity one, so div(M)=sum D_i. Every divisor class is supported on them and all relations come from the displayed localized units; therefore Cl(S)=Z^d/Z(1,...,1) exactly, and S*=Omega*. The original source stabilizer H=Gal(Omega/L) fixes the selected divisor D_1. If d>1 its class is nonzero of infinite order, while d=1 gives zero class group. Thus Cl(S)^H=0 iff d=1 iff K is a polynomial automorphism. If m is the number of H-orbits on the d embeddings, the fixed subgroup is free of rank m-1, with no Galois hypothesis on L/F. The helper projection has generic A1_Z fibres, empty fibres on most of f=T, and full A2_(Y,Z) fibres at the d points f=T,g=V; it is not flat and the exceptional divisors do not dominate the multiplier curve. entries.scope: For every commutative ring R, nilpotent base ideal I and polynomial etale self-map F of affine n-space, ANY polynomial G congruent F modulo I has a unique polynomial source automorphism A congruent identity modulo I with G=F composed A.
